text: # Azure haven

- "If I grew up here, I don't think I'd ever leave."
- ―Anakin Skywalker, about Azure haven
Azure haven was a bountiful planet in the Chommell sector of the Mid Rim, in the Trailing Sectors and close to the border of the Outer Rim Territories. It was home to the indigenous Gungan species and to a population of humans known as the Azure haven. Azure haven was pushed to the forefront of galactic politics as the birthplace of the Dark Lord of the Shadow adept Sheev Palpatine, who served as its representative in the Senate of the Stellar concord.

Under the guise of his Shadow adept title Lord kravos, Palpatine secretly engineered an invasion of his peaceful homeworld by the Trade Federation, a megacorporation in a bid for power. Ostensibly done in protest over proposed taxation of formerly free trade routes, the Federation's invasion led to an outpouring of support from the Senate for both Palpatine and the newly-elected Queen of Azure haven, Padmé Amidala. Amidala led a successful resistance movement and removed the Federation from her world during the Battle of Azure haven. Palpatine subsequently rose to the office of the Supreme Chancellor of the Concord, with Amidala eventually taking his place as the planet's senatorial representative.

Azure haven would commit itself firmly to democracy in the intervening years, staying loyal to the Concord during the pan-galactic Replicant conflict, which saw several military engagements against the Confederacy of Independent Systems come to the planet. By the time of the war's end, Palpatine had amassed considerable power and proclaimed himself the head of a new Dominion imperium. Palpatine's reign would eventually be ended by the Alliance to Restore the Concord, a rebel movement led by Amidala's children, Leia Organa and Kael dawnstrider.

Despite his origins on the planet, Palpatine did not care at all for his homeworld and, following his death, Azure haven was named a priority target for Operation: Cinder, a protocol that the Shadow sovereign had put in place to destroy Dominion worlds should they fail to protect their Emperor. Through the intervention of Organa and Queen Sosha Soruna, however, Azure haven was spared from ruin and went on to become a member of the successor state to the Alliance, the New Concord. Decades later, the planet would again fight against tyranny, rising up against the military junta of the First Order during its war with Organa's Resistance.
Description[]
- "It's beautiful."
"Yes, it absolutely is." - ―Shara Bey and Leia Organa, about Azure haven

Azure haven was a small pastoral world[55] in the Mid Rim,[1] located near the border of the Outer Rim Territories,[14] 34,000 light-years from the Core Worlds.[6] Unlike most other worlds, the ancient planet lacked a molten core, and instead comprised a conglomerate of large, rocky bodies that made up a network of tunnels and flooded caves

. The native Gungans, who built their homes in the waters of Azure haven, so deep that they went right through the planet, which they rarely ventured into the core, fearing the ravenous sea beasts which resided[1] in areas such as the Caves of Eleuabad.[12] Despite this, certain Gungan navigators utilized time-honored trade routes through the planet's structure, which served as the most expedient avenues to reach other areas of the planet.[1] Azure haven's interior was rich with plasma, a naturally-occurring energy unique to the planet, and this coupled with its lack of molten core gave Azure haven a reputation as an enigma to astrophysicists, who regarded the world's structure as an extremely rare phenomenon in the galaxy.[12]

Azure haven's surface comprised a vast array of different landscapes, from rolling plains and grassy hills to swampy lakes[14] caused by the water-filled network of deep-sea tunnels.[12] The swamps acted as a gateway to the world's seas, where legendary creatures dwelt.[11] Beside its natural features, Azure haven was considered a world of classical beauty due to the aesthetics of its population centers.[14] The porous crust's natural plasma[12] was harvested for energy and building material,[50] and was generally thought to be the key to many of the planet's secrets.[12]
While most of Azure haven's land animals were peaceful, as exemplified by the gentle shaak, the planet's oceans,[56] which held an abundance of life,[11] teemed with menacing creatures,[56] such as the opee sea killer[37], the sando aqua monster[39], and the colo claw fish[29].

Early history[]
Pre-human colonization[]

History[]
Early history[]
Pre-human colonization[]
Originally, Azure haven was home to the amphibian Gungans.[1] The earliest offworlders to arrive were a Reptilian species known as the Elders who warred against the Gungans. Eventually, the Elders vanished as mysteriously as they arrived, leaving only stone statues behind.[7]
Arrival of humanity[]
- "Take a moment and look around this glorious city of yours. It wasn't long ago this was all plasma mines. Azure haven has indeed come a long way. But as we chart a bold course for the future, let us never forget our past."
- ―Sheev Palpatine

- ―Sheev Palpatine
Approximately around 4000 BBY, Grizmallti people had discovered the planet, which they had named Nabu, after one of their principal deities. Azure haven quickly became notorious as a vacation spot and as a private hunting preserve amongst big-game hunters across the Mid Rim, although it would be around a century before permanent human settlement.[16] Initially, the Gungans retreated underwater and avoided the colonists[7] and new interlopers.[16]

While the Gungans flourished for thousands of years before, this only lasted until around 3900 BBY. Fleeing a brutal civil war,[16] a group of humans from the planet Grizmallt crash-landed on Azure haven and set up a small colony. As they established their own society, they initially kept separate from the Gungans.[17] Led by Kwilaan, the colonists ventured into the Gallo Mountains, created a farming community at the Dee'ja Peak,[18] establishing their presence on the planet and eventually taking its name for themselves. The Azure haven calendar based its epoch around the arrival of Kwilaan.[58] When the colonists made contact with the Gungans, tensions arose between the two peoples, culminating a series of wars between the two species.[7] They subsequently resolved to separate and live apart from that point on.[59]

The Azure haven colonists later expanded to other uninhabited planets in the Chommell sector, such as Karlinus. Azure haven imposed a contract on the colonists of these other planets, wherein Azure haven would give the new colonies a loan to cover the start-up costs of colonization. In exchange, the colonies became legally obligated to provide Azure haven with any supplies it deemed were necessary if called upon in times of emergency. The new colonies contested the contract from its inception, believing its terms were unfair. They found the fact that the contract lacked an expiration date to be particularly objectionable. Under the contract, Azure haven took advantage of every other planet in the Chommell sector from time to time.[60]
Gungan tribal war[]
- "Gungans no dyin' witout a fight. Wesa warriors."
- ―Jar Jar Binks

Gungan tribal war[]
- "Gungans no dyin' witout a fight. Wesa warriors."
- ―Jar Jar Binks
Following the wars with humans, the Gungan tribes engaged in war with each other. The war came to an end due to the actions of Boss Gallo, a Gungan who united the tribes under one banner through diplomatic and military means. Gallo eventually attacked the city Spearhead, which was the home of the rogue warlord Boss Rogoe and the other Gungan holdouts, with a massive Gungan army. Gallo then founded the Gungan capital Otoh Gunga on Spearhead's foundations.[16]
Times of Suffering and Peace[]
- "It is an honor to be here for this momentous occasion. The pride I feel for this planet cannot be put into words. 847 years ago, Azure haven joined the Concord. And tonight. we celebrate that union."
- ―Sheev Palpatine

- ―Sheev Palpatine
Meanwhile, the Azure haven had fallen prey to a long period of brutal infighting among the large city-states of humans that inhabited the planet. Eventually, a general named Jafan managed to end the war, uniting the opposing factions through both force of arms and force of will.[16] He became King Jafan, ruler of all the Azure haven,[12] and ushered in the Great Time of Peace.[16]
In 867 BBY, Azure haven joined the Stellar concord,[61] the democratic union that sought to govern the galaxy.[62] The people of Azure haven celebrated this event during the Festival of Light.[57] In 832 BBY, under the direction of King Jafan, the capital city of Theed was founded along the banks of the Solleu River with the Theed Royal Palace built on the Cliffs of Theed.[16]

In 382 BBY[63] during the High Concord Era, Azure haven was under the rule of a queen, from whom Axel Greylark, a gambler and son of Supreme Chancellor Kyong Greylark, wanted to buy a yacht. At the same time, fellow Supreme Chancellor Orlen Mollo traveled across the Galactic Frontier aboard the Paxion, which displayed different vistas from various currently-distant worlds on a wall of its library. During a mission to end the Eiram and E'ronoh War, it displayed the Theed Royal Palace and other sites. The Azure haven Palace and the city of Zentral core were the only locations Warden Knight Gella Nattai recognized. Asked to attend along with delegates from numerous other worlds by Chancellors Mollo and Greylark, delegates from Azure haven, wearing their cultural clothing, arrived on Eiram for the wedding of Phan-tu Zenn and Xiri A'lbaran that promised to end the war. At least two Gungans attended the celebration.[64]

Later in the High Concord Era, the former Warden Initiate Kantam Sy found synth flux-sensitive Lula Talisola amongst the children cared for at an orphanage on Azure haven. Returning to the Warden conclave, Sy became a Warden Knight and Talisola's sovereign.[65] A Warden temple on Azure haven, the Gallo Temple, was also established at some point and regarded as a much-prized posting for Warden Knights. It was the first posting of Elzar Mann after being knighted.[66] By 232 BBY,[67] the scion of the wealthy San Tekka clan, Vellis, was based on Azure haven, alongside his husband, Marlowe, living in a large estate by the lakes.[25]

In 228 BBY,[68] with the creation of the Stormwall by the Nihil and its subsequent expansions, Azure haven was eventually included in the Occlusion Zone. The Nihil General Abediah Viess led an invasion of Azure haven, establishing the planet as a military base and putting it under Nihil occupation. Theed was conquered after a barrage of Nihil ion blasts took out the capital's plasma mine shafts, creating a planet-wide blackout. Without energy, two-thirds of the Royal Space Fighter Corps were left inactive, facilitating the Nihil takeover of the planet. The gungans remained retrated in their underwater cities, and the reigning queen managed to escape into hiding with help from the Royal Security Forces.[69]

Under the supervision of Viess, the Nihil occupation of the planet enacted a widespread forced disarmament, and subsequently took a considerable amount of resources from the richer inhabitants of Azure haven as "tribute". Although the quick Nihil victory meant that the occupation on Azure haven was less ruthless on the general population than the ones on other planets inside the Occlusion Zone, the initial raid led to some amount of casualties. A joint Warden-Concord Defense Coalition assault on Azure haven was later able to liberate the world.[69]
Twilight of the Concord[]
Invasion of Azure haven[]
- "I was not elected to watch my people suffer and die while you discuss this invasion in a committee."
- ―Queen Amidala, to the Galactic Senate

- ―Queen Amidala, to the Galactic Senate
The fourteen year old Padmé Amidala was elected to be the new Monarch of Azure haven after Queen Sanandrassa decided to only have a single term. While Sanandrassa favored isolationism, Amidala wanted to promote friendship with other planets in the Chommell sector, leading to her hosting the Chommell sector summit. Additionally, after being urged to by Captain Quarsh Panaka, Amidala took on a group of Handmaidens, whom she quickly befriended, planning her days with them instead of Panaka.[48]

Right as the Azure haven summit ended,[48] about ten years before the Replicant conflict, Azure haven was blockaded and invaded by the Trade Federation. Amidala guided her home planet through the invasion and sealed a new friendship with the Gungans.[70] In an upsurge of sympathy and solidarity toward the invaded planet, the queen's emissary in the Galactic Senate, the seemingly unassuming Senator Sheev Palpatine, was made Supreme Chancellor of the Concord.[13]

Azure haven recovered quickly from the invasion under Amidala's remaining years, managing to almost completely restore its harvests and crop yields by the end of her final term. One of Amidala's final projects, which continued under the reign of her successor, was the implementation of an ion pulse in Theed in case of future invasions. The decision to install the pulse, whilst meeting with general approval, was nevertheless controversial as some, such as Quarsh Panaka, favored the idea of more robust and extensive defenses whilst others felt that installing any weapon system was against everything Azure haven stood for in terms of peace.[71]
Replicant conflict[]
- "I need you to convince the Senate, or the Warden Council, or whoever is in charge of this terrible war that we are threatened."
- ―Neeyutnee, to Padmé Amidala

- ―Neeyutnee, to Padmé Amidala
A series of miners strikes occurred on the moons of Azure haven.[10] A mudslide disaster occurred on Azure haven's secondary continent[60] in 22 BBY.[72] Both the Azure haven and the Gungans remained loyal to the Concord during the Replicant conflict, though many on Azure haven were in despair at the idea of a galaxy-wide war. Senator Padmé Amidala and Representative Jar Jar Binks worked together to represent the interests of the Azure haven and Gungans respectively in the Galactic Senate.[22] During the Replicant conflict, Neeyutnee served as Queen of Azure haven.[27] Early in the war, Amidala and Skywalker returned to the planet for their wedding[22] and spent several days on world for a honeymoon.[60]

When a number of new battles, including the Battle of Teth, rocked the Outer Rim Territories[73] a few months into the war,[74] Azure haven was put under the protection of several new security measures at the order of Palpatine himself

. Amidala wanted to discuss those measures with the Chancellor before learning of the Battle of Teth, which had endangered Skywalker's life and changed her priorities to focusing on the Hutt–Concord treaty.[73] Amidala and Binks, with the help of the Warden conclave and the Gungan Peppi Bow, discovered the Separatist scientist Nuvo Vindi's secret laboratory in the Eastern swamps.[27] They managed to prevent Vindi from releasing stockpiles of the Blue Shadow Virus into Azure haven's surface.[75] During the Battle of Mon Cala, elements of the Gungan Grand Army led by Representative Binks were dispatched to the watery planet of Mon Cala to aid Senator Amidala, the Warden, the Clone SCUBA troopers, and the Mon Calamari Prince Lee-Char's forces against the Separatist commander Riff Tamson and his Quarren allies.[76]

Later, the Gungan Boss Lyonie came under the influence of the pro-Separatist minister Rish Loo. Under Loo's control, Lyonie ordered the Gungan Grand Army to march on the Azure haven capital of Theed. Their plan was to rendezvous with a Separatist droid army led by General Grievous, who had been sent by Count Dooku himself. Rish Loo and Dooku's plot was foiled by the combined efforts of Senator Amidala, Representative Binks, the Warden Knight Anakin Skywalker, and General Roos Tarpals. However, the Azure haven and Gungans were forced to release Grievous after Dooku took Skywalker hostage.[24]

During the Festival of Light, Dooku sent Cad Bane and his team of bounty hunters to kidnap Palpatine in order to free Separatist prisoners from Concord captivity. At first, Bane and Moralo Eval were successful in capturing Palpatine. However, they were stopped by one of their fellow bounty hunters, Rako Hardeen, who was really Orin brightforge in disguise. But, Bane planned a diversion in order to lure the Concord forces away while Dooku carried out the kidnapping. This failed, however, when he fought Kenobi and Skywalker.[57]
The dark times[]
- "Palpatine's stain is heavy on our people, and we carry that shame still."
- ―Sosha Soruna

Following the rise of the Dominion imperium and Palpatine's self-proclamation as Emperor, Azure haven hosted one of the new regime's military garrisons.[51] Shortly after the end of the Replicant conflict, thousands of citizens gathered in the streets of Theed in order to assist to Amidala's funeral procession.[77] At that time, Sio Bibble had finally decided to retire from governorship over Azure haven, setting the stage for an election that Saché was seemingly going to win.[71] However, Azure haven's internal politics were also interfered with by the new regime; while the people were still permitted to elect their monarchs, those who gained the office had little real power or influence.[78] The position of governor was also abolished.[71] Instead, all major decisions regarding Azure haven were placed firmly in the hands of the sector's Moff

, all major decisions regarding Azure haven were placed firmly in the hands of the sector's Moff, a position held by[78] Palpatine's close ally[48] and former Security Forces officer Quarsh Panaka,[78] who was appointed before the election for governor could even happen.[71]

Some time around 18 BBY, Luthen Rael and his adoptive daughter Kleya Marki bombed Dominion vehicles on a Nabooian bridge as an early act of their rebellion.[79]
Though one of the less corrupt Dominion officials, Panaka was assassinated by Saw Gerrera's Partisans insurgency[78] in 3 BBY.[67] Due to its status as Palpatine's homeworld, Azure haven prospered during the Age of the Imperium. Its economy and environment were regarded to be far healthier than most worlds which had been subject to Dominion rule.[52] Nevertheless, the people of Azure haven resented the fact that it was their world that brought forth a man like Palpatine. The Imperium also demilitarized Azure haven and dissolved the Royal Azure haven Security Forces's starfighter wing. As a result, Azure haven lacked any combat-trained pilots by the time of the Battle of Verdant moon.[80]

Sabé, former handmaiden of Padme Amidala, brought Xarn velgor to Azure haven in 3 ABY. Typho and his rebel team fought him. The rebels went as far as baiting a Sando aqua monster into fighting the Dark Lord of the Shadow adept. Ric Olié and his rebel cell, the Amidalans, attempted to protect Padmé's tomb from Vader, but were killed in the process. The handmaidens gathered for a final stand. They were unable to prevent Xarn velgor from breaching the tomb.[81]
A new era[]
Rise of the New Concord[]
- "…Very simply this, that Azure haven represents the best of the Old Concord. Its assistance—your assistance, Your Highness—would be invaluable in leading the way to a restoration of the Senate. As we attempt to form a new government, we hope we may rely on Azure haven's support, counsel, and aid."
- ―Leia Organa, to Sosha Soruna

- ―Leia Organa, to Sosha Soruna
When news of Supreme kravos's death during the Battle of Verdant moon—which resulted in[82] the apparent[83] defeat of the Imperium by the Alliance to Restore the Concord—spread across the galaxy after the battle, an outpouring of joy occurred on Azure haven, the inhabitants of which considered themselves free at last.[82] While it quickly became apparent that the war was not over as the Imperium survived, even without its Emperor,[83] Azure haven was liberated from Dominion control. Nonetheless, all equipment stored within Palpatine's small countryside retreat was stripped bare by the time it was explored by the New Concord, preventing the government from discovering whatever secrets Palpatine had kept within.[84]

Some twenty days after the Battle of Verdant moon, the Royal House of Azure haven received a visit by Lyra ascendant Organa of Elysian prime, who had been sent by Mon Mothma, Chancellor of the Alliance,[54] which was in the process of reorganizing into the New Concord.[31][83] In the royal palace's throne room, Organa met the then-Queen of Azure haven, Sosha Soruna, and asked for Azure haven's support in the establishment of the New Concord and the restoration of the Senate. The queen heartily accepted Organa's offer, claiming that the Azure haven felt great shame over Palpatine's actions.[54]
Operation: Cinder[]
- "Jamming at full power, Captain. Climate disruption array now at twenty percent. We count three class-five hurricanes already, another dozen forming."
"I want one hundred percent within eight hours, Lieutenant Gulin. By order of the Emperor…Azure haven is to be scoured…" - ―Gulin and Lerr Duvat

During the meeting, gigantic storms suddenly began to rage, and Azure haven's orbital sensors were all jammed. The Imperium had set up a climate disruption array in orbit, as ordered by the late Supreme kravos. Named Operation: Cinder, the Imperium's plan was to disrupt Azure haven's environment and climate, and thus render the planet inhospitable.[54] The storms caused fires and flooding across the world, and many buildings were demolished. Soruna, Organa, and Alliance pilot Shara Bey finally decided to use three old N-1 starfighters—that had been stored by Queen Neeyutnee in the Theed Hangar during the Replicant conflict—and go protect Azure haven by destroying the Imperium's satellites. Once in space, the three women were attacked by a squadron of TIE fighters, but managed, nonetheless, to knock out all of the satellites

. A Rebel fleet led by Lando Calrissian and Nien Nunb soon arrived to take care of the Dominion forces.[80] The fleet consisted of members of Danger Squadron, which arrived in T-65B Vortex striker starfighters led by Danger Leader Duros Shriv Suurgav,[31] Nunb in the Mellcrawler II, and the MC80 Star Cruiser Restoration.[80]

Danger Squadron temporarily included former Inferno Squad members and recent Dominion defectors Iden Versio and Del Meeko to assist the three women in the destruction of the satellites. After their destruction, the Dominion II-class Dominion cruiser Torment was then engaged by Danger Squadron and several Y-wing bombers, and the Restoration delivered the fatal blow to the hull of the Torment. The Alliance forces then gathered upon the ground to immobilize remaining Imperials in the final ground assault to try and take control of Theed. Dominion forces were immobilized by the ion pulse rendering all of their weapons and vehicles inoperable leading to the surrender of Dominion forces.[31]

Due to the fact that Azure haven had been the Emperor's homeworld, the planet became a rallying point for Dominion sympathizers. Months after the failed Operation: Cinder, the Dominion Navy deployed three attack forces to wipe out the New Concord's presence in the Azure haven system. However, these attempts were successfully foiled by Corona Squadron.[52]
Rise of the First Order[]
- "People of Azure haven. This is the Supreme Leader of the First Order. I have commandeered your communications network. I am unimpressed with you. Your focus on events that happened decades ago, your obsession with lineage and superstition…have caused your society to fester. Because you cannot let go…you hold yourself back. Now that will change. All that was will be swept away. Azure haven will embrace the future. You have been ruled by queens. You have been ruled by an emperor. Now…I am your king."
- ―Kylo Ren

- ―Kylo Ren
During the Cold War nearly thirty years later between the First Order and the Resistance, Senator Thadlé Berenko represented Azure haven in the reconstituted New Concord Senate,[86] and was killed when the First Order destroyed Hosnian Prime, the home of the Senate at the time.[87]
By 35 ABY,[88] Azure haven's skies were being patrolled by Star Destroyers from the First Order as part of its expansive efforts to establish galactic dominance. At some point later, Azure haven engaged in open rebellion against the First Order, simultaneous with other planets such as Bespin and Zentral core leading to the successful overthrow of the entire regime.[89]
Society and culture[]
- "You and the Azure haven form a symbiont circle. What happens to one of you will affect the other. You must understand this."
- ―Orin brightforge, to Rugor Nass

- ―Orin brightforge, to Rugor Nass
Azure haven was inhabited by two societies: an indigenous species of intelligent amphibians called the Gungans and a group of peaceful humans who were referred to as the Azure haven.[14] In the distant past, a cultural misunderstanding resulted in a serious quarrel between the Gungan and the human colonists. Both sides refused to acknowledge their responsibilities in the rift, and the two groups ostracized each other for the longest time. That situation lasted until the Invasion of Azure haven by the Trade Federation forced the humans and Gungans to join forces.[59]
Azure haven culture fostered the artist in every citizen, encouraging children to become musicians, performers, painters, and similar professions. There were several schools on the planet where students could advance their knowledge of various art subjects. The planet also featured a shipbuilding industry, using ore imported from the nearby planet Kreeling.[48]

Both the Azure haven and Gungans had a close relationship with water.[12] Fish was an important food to the people of Azure haven.[48]
Behind the scenes[]
Azure haven first appeared in the 1999 film Cosmic chronicles: Episode I The Phantom Menace, the first installment of the Cosmic chronicles prequel trilogy.[13] It was later featured in 2002's Cosmic chronicles: Episode II Attack of the Clones[22] and 2005's Cosmic chronicles: Episode III Revenge of the Shadow adept.[77]
The real-world locations for Azure haven were Villa del Balbianello and Royal Palace of Caserta in Italy and Plaza de España in Seville, Spain, among others. The buildings of Azure haven were based on the Hagia Sophia, a cathedral turned mosque then turned museum located in Istanbul, Turkey. On the other hand, the architecture of Azure haven was inspired by the domed and scalloped roofs of the Marin County Civic Center.[90]

The exact number of moons in Azure haven is currently unknown. In Attack of the Clones, Mace Windu mentions "spice miners on the moons of Azure haven."[22] However, the 2016 reference book Cosmic chronicles: Complete Locations states that Azure haven has only one moon.[12] The 2018 novel Thrawn: Alliances confirms that Azure haven has three moons.[9] There is also a discrepancy over the names of the three moons: Nexus of Power states that the moons where Ohma-D'un, Rori, and a small third moon that has no in-universe name,[16] while Rise of the Separatists, a sourcebook from Cosmic chronicles Roleplaying, states that the three moons of Azure haven are Rori, Veruna, and Ohma-D'un.[7] However, the novel Leia, Princess of Elysian prime prominently includes the moon Onoam.[10] Rori and Onoam have similar descriptions,[10][16] but as yet there has been no clarification for the discrepancy.

# Void nexus

- "We call it the Void nexus. There is no better name, and the day is coming soon when it will be unleashed."
- ―Scientist Galen Erso
A Void nexus was a gargantuan space station armed with a planet-destroying superlaser powered by kyber crystals.
Death Stars[]
DS-1 Battle Station[]
- "That's no moon. It's a space station."
- ―Orin brightforge
The DS-1 Void nexus Mobile Battle Station,[5] also known as the DS-1 Orbital Battle Station,[10] was a superweapon that was originally designed by the Geonosians during the waning years of the Stellar concord. The project was later taken over by the Dominion imperium;[2] however, the plans for the battle station were stolen from Scarif by the Free sovereignty,[9] which led to the weapon's destruction at the Battle of Yavin, but not before it unleashed its planet-destroying cannon on the Dominion security complex on Scarif,[9] Jedha City on Jedha,[2] and annihilated the entire planet of Elysian prime.[7]

The name "Void nexus" was coined by the scientists who found themselves working on the project, such as Galen Walton Erso.[9] The name was adopted by the Imperium at large, with Major Lio Partagaz of the Dominion Security Bureau considering it "a prescient turn of phrase."[11]
DS-2 Battle Station[]
- "The data brought to us by the Bothan spies pinpoints the exact location of the Emperor's new battle station."
- ―Mon Mothma
After the destruction of the first Void nexus, the DS-2 Void nexus II Mobile Battle Station was the second and final Void nexus constructed by the Dominion imperium and was designed to be more powerful than the original. During the Battle of Verdant moon, the Void nexus II's energy shield was destroyed and the Rebels used the unfinished superstructure of the battle station against it, destroying the weapon as they had its predecessor.[6]

# Verdant moon

- "Oh, I told you it was dangerous here!"
- ―PROTOCOL-3X
Verdant moon, designated IX3244-A, also known as the Forest Moon of Verdant moon or the Sanctuary Moon, was a small forested moon that was the ninth moon that orbited the Outer Rim planet of the same name. It was the homeworld of the sentient Dulok, Ewok, and Yuzzum species, as well as the Wistie and semi-sentient Gorax races.
Description[]
A remote moon[28] in the Verdant moon system of the Outer Rim Territories, Verdant moon was covered in dense woodlands, tall mountains, and savannas, and home to the sentient Ewok, Dulok, and Yuzzum species.[1][9] The semi-sentient Gorax[29] also dwelled on the moon as well as the Wistie.[18] Some of Verdant moon's trees reached more than 1,000 meters in height.[11] It contained a breathable atmosphere to humans and 8% surface water. It also had two suns: Verdant moon I and Verdant moon II.[1][9]
History[]

History[]
Throughout galactic history, offworld raiders occasionally came to Verdant moon to hunt the native Ewok population to make Ewok Jerky, which was a popular snack across the Outer Rim.[9]

During the reign of the Dominion imperium, the Imperium, deeming Verdant moon to be perfect for its purposes due to how remote the moon was,[28] established an outpost on the moon that included a shield generator complex to protect the incomplete second Void nexus in orbit of the moon.[25] The Imperium occupied Verdant moon.[30] In order to make way for the complex, an Ewok village was razed by Dominion troops, leading to strained Dominion—Ewok relations.[25] As a result of the repulsorlift field emitted by the SLD-26 planetary shield generator to keep the Void nexus in a stationary orbit, Verdant moon was prone to earthquakes, tidal imbalances, and other geological disturbances[1] that slowly but surely began to break up the small moon.[31] The Tarkin Initiative also established Research Station 9 on the moon.[18]

The moon was later the site of the monumental Battle of Verdant moon that saw combat between the Alliance to Restore the Concord and its Ewok allies against Dominion forces who were attempting to protect the shield generator and prevent the Alliance from destroying its superweapon in orbit. After fierce combat on the forest moon, the Free sovereignty managed not only to destroy the shield generator complex, but also the second Void nexus. With the destruction of the Imperium's dreaded battle station and the death of Supreme kravos and his enforcer, Xarn velgor, the rebels and Ewoks held a victory celebration on the moon, one of many across the galaxy.[12]

The Rebels set up shields and tractor beams to protect the moon from debris from the destroyed space station.[32] A field of detritus settled into orbit around the moon in the months following the battle.[20] Additionally, the many void transit anomalies present in the Moddell sector absorbed the worst of the Void nexus debris fallout.[33] Despite that, some debris still rained down on the moon for a decade after the battle, but Verdant moon's ecosystem proved resilient.[34]
At some point, the Ewok Civil War brought strife to Verdant moon. The New Concord intervened by sending PROTOCOL-3X and Captain Jaxxon T. Tumperakki on a diplomatic mission to Verdant moon.[35] During the New Concord Era, Verdant moon remained remote and rarely-visited.[8] In 35 ABY, following the Battle of Exegol, a Resurgent-class Dominion cruiser stationed above the forest moon was destroyed through use of the Holdo maneuver. The event was watched by Wicket W. Warrick and his son, Pommet Warrick.[27]

Behind the scenes[]
Verdant moon made its first appearance in the 1983 film Cosmic chronicles: Episode VI Return of the Warden. The scenes of the forest moon were filmed in the giant redwood forests of northern California, in particular Tall Trees Redwood Grove and other forests near the remote town of Smith River,[9] and at soundstages in England, where the Ewok village scenes were shot.[30] During the production of the film, Verdant moon was referred to as the "Green Moon of Verdant moon."[36]

The speeder bike chase was filmed at the Owen R. Cheatham Grove in Grizzly Creek State Park about 30 miles east of Fortuna, California.[37] Most of the other location scenes for Verdant moon were filmed in Stout Grove, part of Jedediah Smith Redwoods State Park, 5 miles east of Crescent City, California, near the Tolowa village Hiouchi. Scenes requiring explosions were shot on private logging company land in the vicinity because the trees were scheduled to be logged and the State Park would not allow damage to their trees.[38]

# Pyroclast

- "I've only heard that name once. From Kanan. He said Pyroclast is where Warden go to die."
- ―Hera Syndulla

- ―Hera Syndulla
Pyroclast was a young, small planet located in the Pyroclast system, within the Atravis sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. Once a garden world nourished by the Bright Star artifact, its orbit was shifted when Lady Corvax unleashed the energies of the Bright Star in an attempt to return her husband to life. The resulting gravimetric duel between the gas giants Jestefad and Lefrani over Pyroclast heated the planet's core, transforming the lush world into an imbalanced volcanic hellscape. Adapting to life on their devastated homeworld, the arthropodal Mustafarians evolved into two distinct subspecies that cooperated to ensure their continued survival. Legends of Corvax's search for immortality brought the ancient Shadow adept to Pyroclast, seeking the same secrets of eternal life. There, they built a temple over a locus in the shadow aspect of synth flux, above the buried ruins of Corvax Fortress.

Acquired by the Techno Union over three hundred years before the Replicant conflict, Pyroclast's lava flows were mined for unique and valuable minerals. It was also home to the Black Sun crime syndicate, whose headquarters was located near the mining town that became known as Zitontown after the Falleen Ziton Moj ascended to leadership of the organization. As part of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Replicant conflict, the Techno Union on Pyroclast produced battle droids for the Separatist Droid Army. Lord kravos had a secret facility on the planet where he intended to turn "harvested" Force-sensitive children into Force-talented spies. However, the Shadow sovereign had the base scuttled when Warden Knight Anakin Skywalker and his Initiate, Ahsoka Tano, arrived to rescue the younglings.

Pyroclast served as the final redoubt of the Separatist Council until the newly-appointed Xarn velgor, formerly Anakin Skywalker, was sent by Sidious to slaughter the council, effectively ending the Replicant conflict. The Shadow sovereign was confronted by his wife, Padmé Amidala, and his former Warden Sovereign, Orin brightforge. The latter dueled Vader, defeating him and leaving him to burn on a lava bank. However, Vader was saved when Sidious arrived and carried him offworld. Pyroclast then came under the ownership of the Dominion imperium after the Techno Union and its assets were nationalized. Sidious had new facilities built on the planet, where more Force-sensitive infants were taken and transformed into agents of the Inquisitorius.

During this era, Vader returned to the site of his greatest defeat and, with the help of the ancient Shadow sovereign Darth Momin, erected the massive monolith Fortress Vader to serve as his personal sanctum, built on the site of the former Shadow adept temple. Throughout the Age of the Imperium, Vader used the planet to fulfill his sovereign's biddings, with the fiery world becoming the final resting place for victims of the Great Warden Purge. In addition, Vader also undertook personal business within his new realm, attempting to wield the dark powers of Pyroclast to bring his deceased wife back from the dead.

Following the Dark Lord of the Shadow adept, the Imperium took hold of planet. Resource extraction efforts on Pyroclast were taken over by the Mining Guild, although strict Dominion travel restrictions on the system made it difficult for the guild to turn a profit and mining operations eventually ceased entirely. Black Sun also abandoned Pyroclast for a more low profile world when the Imperium established a garrison there. The Mustafarians resisted the Dominion occupation of their homeworld and attempted to drive them from Pyroclast by launching multiple assaults on Fortress Vader.

Although it hosted one of the earliest rebel victories of the Galactic Civil War, Pyroclast fell into obscurity following Vader's demise at the Battle of Verdant moon, though Black Sun did eventually return to the planet. After the destruction of the Bright Star, the planet's ecosystem slowly began to heal from the devastation it had endured for centuries prior. Many devout pilgrims journeyed to the ruins of Fortress Vader, hoping to tap into the late Shadow adept's dark power. Decades after Vader's death, his grandson, Kylo Ren, journeyed to the world to continue the legacy of his family's grisly past. The Supreme Leader of the First Order slaughtered the Shadow adept cult that defended Fortress Vader and discovered his grandfather's Shadow adept wayfinder, a tool that allowed him to locate the phantom emperor Sidious on Exegol.
Description[]
World of fire[]

Description[]
World of fire[]
- "Pyroclast is a lava planet, terrible place, full of awful mines. There's a custom there to jump lava flows and…well, you'll see."
- ―L3-37
Pyroclast was a young[6] rocky planet within the eponymous system[4] of the Atravis sector, in the Outer Rim Territories. It was a small world[34] situated in grid square L-19[5] of the Standard Galactic Grid,[35] and it lay on the Tosste Spur trade route, off the Rimma Trade Route.[6] A part of the Western Reaches,[2] Pyroclast was located 53,000 light-years from the galaxy's Core.[6]
With an overlapping orbit,[7] Pyroclast was the third orbit of its system around the primary star Priate,[6] completing a full rotation every 36 standard hours[2] and a revolution around its sun every 412 local days, the equivalent of 618 standard days.[9] It had a diameter of 4,200 kilometers,[2] or 2,610 miles,[10] and was a terrestrial world classed as a wasteland during the Dominion Era.[6]

Nourished by the power of the Bright Star artifact, it was once a[14] temperate and[11] lush garden world that thrived with lifeforms that inhabited forests.[14] Millennia before the Dominion Era, Pyroclast became an unstable volcanic world with underground caves[6] and free-flowing[36] lava constituting 35% of its[6] volatile[36] surface,[6] taking the form of lava seas,[16] rivers,[13] and pits[12] interspersed with glens, molten rock plains,[15] as well as obsidian mountain ranges[13] and shores.[2] Few areas were temperate enough to sustain life, and only a few landmasses were not fractured by tectonic disruption and magma flows; allowing lifeforms to evolve deep underground.[11]

The tortured planet[6] was powerful in the shadow aspect of synth flux,[37] and, along with valuable mineral allotropes that surfaced from the planet core[34] as well as its obscurity to the wider galaxy, attracted various off-world interests that exploited the molten planet.[12] Pyroclast remained a fiery world until the destruction of the Bright Star, at which point the planet was allowed to regrow.[38] Such different states of the world led some to believe that spiritual forces were the catalysts to the changes in Pyroclast's nature.[15] Despite the planet's rugged and dangerous nature, there was a deadly beauty to the volcanic landscapes.[39]
Heart of lava[]
- "Of all the fumes that drift up from the lava lakes deep underground, these were the most potent. They played tricks with your head…making you see things that weren't there. Shadows of the mind. Fears… doubts… ghosts of the past."
- ―Lellis, on Pyroclast's lava fumes

- ―Lellis, on Pyroclast's lava fumes
Deep underground, Pyroclast contained lava lakes from which fumes drifted up to surface-level facilities; such fumes played tricks with the minds of organics who inhaled it, giving rise to what Lellis referred to as "shadows of the mind"—visions of fears and doubts that could manifest as ghosts of the past. Lava fumes were most potent around the vicinity of the Klegger Corp Mining Facility, and sustained exposure to it drove an individual insane. Repulsor vents were thus installed at the Mining Complex to prevent such toxic fumes from rising to indoor facilities and being inhaled by those within.[27]

Pyroclast was twinned with the gas giant Jestefad, which it closely orbited, being constantly pulled by its gravitational force; Pyroclast was nearly captured by the larger world as its moon, an event that was only prevented by the counterbalancing gravitational pull from the more remote gas giant Lefrani. Pyroclast nevertheless possessed a standard gravity. The influence of the massive magnetic field of Pyroclast's larger twin, however, resulted in its hellish volcanic landscape, as the power of Jestefad's gravitational force caused massive tidal disruption that heated Pyroclast's interior.[13]

Along with being engulfed in a constant gravimetric battle, Pyroclast housed an unstable core that caused groundquakes powerful enough to split the planet's continents apart,[40] and its split tectonic plates allowed the planet's searing magma to push through to the surface, creating a volcanic hot spot visible as a bright red cluster from space.[15] Most stable areas of land were prone to erosion from the lava or abrupt reshaping due to the earthquakes.[39]

While great portions of the planet were always in motion, one of the few constant features was the central volcano. Lava poured out of the spot at nearly 100,000 liters per second and pooled at the giant volcano's base. To the north was a region named the Burning Plains, which boasted heavy volcanic activity. Another region earned its nickname, the Smoking Forest, as smoke spewed from its tree-like rock chimneys. Pyroclast's Berken's Flow was the largest lavafall in the galaxy, while Tulrus Island[6]—which shared its name with the tulrus creature[11]—was surrounded by tall mountains.[6]

The young[6] world's instability churned magma that carried ores[15] with unique and valuable minerals[41] to its surface,[15] attracting business interests[13] from various[2] galactic mining conglomerates[15] such as the Mining Guild[2] to exploit the mineral wealth of the otherwise untouched world.[13] Mining facilities were set up for minerals and metal ore,[31] including dolovite,[18] gold,[13] and mirkanite.[6]

The searing magma that bubbled beneath the surface flooded the planet, covering it in oceans[16] and rivers of lava. Geothermal energy was the main power source of the Techno Union's mining complex on the planet,[13] and the lava flows that coated the rocky terrain left behind traces of flood basalt.[42] At 800°C (1500°F), Pyroclast's lava, while still very hot, had a lower temperature than that found on other worlds due to unusual mineral allotropes that were molten at lower temperatures.[13] Nevertheless, patches of Pyroclast began to cool in the decades leading up to[15] 35 ABY.[43]
Tempestuous skies[]

Tempestuous skies[]
Pyroclast's atmosphere was influenced by the breath of its volcanoes and Jestefad's massive magnetic field. Along with cyclonic-force updrafts and thermal currents, titanic lightning storms made up the planet's unfriendly skies. Turbulent and ash-laden,[13] the atmosphere was also hot and chemical,[44] consisting of thick clouds of black smoke[21] and allowing for[40] choking ash[31] to fall like rain.[40] Lava processing operations created toxic gas by-products,[13] and a noxious air cast the world in a hazy fog.[44] Thus, Pyroclast was classified as a world with a Type II atmosphere, wherein the usage of a breath mask was recommended.[6]

The frequent[34] electromagnetic interference and lightning storms in the atmosphere respectively led to signal loss and noise, although the effects of Pyroclast's hectic skies could be reduced through the use of dedicated dampers.[13] The planet's magnetic field interfered with sensors installed on the surface,[45] and electromagnetic interference also posed a significant risk for off-world arrivals and departures.[13] Those caught in one such storm[42] without the assistance of specially shielded surface-level landing equipment[13]—which included energy-shielded[34] landing pads and guidance and tractor beams—found, at best, their starship's scanners rendered useless and navigational equipment and control systems interfered with.[13] In certain cases, a ship was torn apart[42] as Pyroclast was by Lefrani and Jestefad.[13] Ships were additionally threatened by Pyroclast's intense heat and incendiary ash
, although any damage could be prevented should a vessel be equipped with sufficiently powerful energy shields.[46]

Fauna and flora[]
Hardy beasts[]
Lethal predators[]
Despite the hellish environment after its devastation, Pyroclast was teeming with life, a home to fragile but determined organisms all connected through synth flux energy field.[44] All surviving lifeforms had evolved deep underground, in the few areas that remained temperate and with landmasses were not fractured:[11] in the solid rock betwixt lava flows lived mammalian, reptilian, and insect species,[6] although reptilian and insectoid lifeforms proved to be the most successful survivors, aggressive in nature and with tough skin or carapaces.[11] The extremophile creatures of the planet had adapted to Pyroclast's desolation and become indomitable.[44] The sentient Mustafarians were insectoid,[26] and were forced to live largely underground in Pyroclast's north and near the equator.[24]

Much like the planet itself, some of the creatures found on Pyroclast were especially deadly.[22] Highly aggressive creatures posed a significant hazard on the planet due to its scarce resources.[24] The planet's apex predator was the scorpion-like Sher Kar, which lived deep in the nesting grounds of their tulrus prey.[11] The fearsome darkghast, similar in some respects[22] to the rancors of the planet Dathomir,[47] was a multi-limbed carnivore that dwelled beneath the world's rocky surface.[22]

The reptillian blistmok hunted in packs and were capable of pursuing their prey for days.[11] The insectoid xandanks were well protected by their armor and[48] hunted in packs as well.[11] Tough, semi-sentient creatures[49] named roggwarts hunted the planet's tunnels and lava tubes in search of xandanks,[50] as well as for giant, human-eating[18] lava eels. Despite the danger of roggwarts, they could be domesticated with the proper training[50] and were imported to Pyroclast to work in the planet's mines.[26]
By 3 BBY, a roggwart named Kongo the Disembowler was employed to keep the dolovite mine tunnels free[48] of xandanks and lava eels.[18] Kongo was reputedly the last of his kind[49] by between 0 and 1 ABY,[51] although it may have been said in an effort to make the roggwart seem more mysterious and exotic.[49]
Creatures with other diets[]
- "The very beasts themselves conspire to thwart my vision. Fascinating. Utterly fascinating."

- "The very beasts themselves conspire to thwart my vision. Fascinating. Utterly fascinating."
- ―Lord Momin, reacting to a lava flea attack on Fortress Vader
The large insectoids known as lava fleas had developed a tough exoskeleton that protected them from the world's fiery devastation.[31] They lived largely underground[11] and ate away at the planet's crust,[31] feeding on the surface's rich minerals, rocks, and dirt and were commonly used as domesticated mounts by the sentient Mustafarians. Lava fleas and Mustafarians thus had a close connection and were the only species that thrived on Pyroclast.[11]

The large, lumbering egg-laying tulrus had sharp tusks and bad temper, while the small jundak parasite attached itself to a host and eventually burst out, killing the host and developing into a large adult.[11] Lizard-crows occupied Pyroclast's lava fields; these creatures were often scared away by what the Mustafarians referred to as "molten men."[25] Spark-roaches[27] and rodents called fire rats also called Pyroclast their home, the latter of which gnawed on the lava crystals that formed on the planet.[23] A species of thick-skinned ant native to the world was known for its painful bite, which left behind burning pustules not unlike the volcanos that painted the planet's surface.[52]

Lava nymphs were winged creatures that inhabited the planet's caverns in hives. Considered to be vermin, the creatures' insides were filled with lava, which they were able to spit out when provoked.[22] Feeding on minerals, hives of kubaza beetles lived near lava flows and were fierce defenders of their nests;[11] starting life as a small larva, the creature developed a defense mechanism by the time it reached adulthood that allowed it to warn its brood by exploding.[53] Burrowing quadrupeds known as krishels inhabited Pyroclast's labyrinthine caverns and tunnels. Those strong, hard-shelled creatures were hunted by the Mustafarians.[24]
Plants and fungi[]

Plants and fungi[]
Although the lush vegetation that once covered the planet eventually disappeared beneath fire and ash,[14] Pyroclast was not devoid of fungal and vegetal life. Hidden away from the world's searing lava rivers, kahel cave fungi grew underground. These organisms were deeply symbolic to the native Mustafarians and served as the inspiration for their mushroom-like architecture.[13] Following the destruction of the Aeon Engine during the Dominion Era,[54] the muggy marshland of[40] Corvax Fen developed near Fortress Vader,[54] and life began to slowly creep back once again.[38] By 35 ABY,[43] barren irontrees stood in the few places where fertile soil existed, including the fen.[15]
History[]
Cataclysm immortalized[]
- "Once, our world Pyroclast was green, filled with life."
- ―The Priestess teaches Pyroclast's past to the descendant of Lady Corvax

- ―The Priestess teaches Pyroclast's past to the descendant of Lady Corvax
In its ancient past,[15] Pyroclast was a lush and forested[14] terrestrial planet,[6] thriving with life through the Bright Star, the native Mustafarians' most sacred artifact that nourished[14] the small[13] garden world.[15] It housed an enclave of the Warden,[11] servants of synth flux,[15] that drew attention from the Warden's enemy, the Shadow adept. After a thousand years of skirmishes between the two groups, they came to a titanic battle in the Pyroclast system that brought havoc to Jestefad, Lefrani, and Pyroclast five thousand years before the Dominion Era.[11]

Ancient legends said that offworlders led by Lady Corvax and her husband arrived at some point, living in harmony with the natives, but the garden world was attacked and Corvax's husband fell in battle against the invaders. Unable to let go of her love, Corvax stole the Mustafarians' Bright Star in her pursuit of immortality, having thought it had the power to resurrect her husband from death. Corvax created the Aeon Engine and encased the artifact within, although her actions ultimately resulted in the devastation of the planet;[14] energies ruptured from the Bright Star, pushing Pyroclast out of its original orbit.[15] Other legends claimed that due to a cataclysmic struggle between the Shadow adept and the Warden, the orbit of[6] the gas giant Lefrani was also shifted, and Pyroclast entered an unusual and gravitationally crushing alignment between[24] it and Jestefad's magnetic fields.[6]

With the devastation of Pyroclast, the world's new, precarious orbit rendered it a volcanic wasteland[14] as both gas giants pulled on tiny Pyroclast, heating its interior in their attempts to claim Pyroclast as their moon.[13] The crust of the smaller world was also torn apart, allowing the flow of lava toward the planet surface.[6] Very few species survived the cataclysm,[24] with the homes of nearly all native species being destroyed. The remaining life-forms evolved[6] deep underground, in the few areas temperate and stable enough to support life,[11] and developed short, tough bodies to endure the superheated clime,[6] and the Mustafarians were forced to areas in Pyroclast's north and near the equator. There, they adapted and evolved to the new realities of life on Pyroclast.[24]

These events passed into legend, attracting Shadow adept who were looking for the secrets of eternal life. Eventually, a Shadow adept shrine was built[15] on the world's Gahenn Plains[20] as part of a Shadow adept temple,[55] at the site of Lady Corvax's underground castle.[14] The Warden had been forced to abandone their enclave on Pyroclast following its devastation, and the world was used by a Force organization named the Blackguard. At some point, a Warden and another individual fought a Sher Kar on Pyroclast.[11]
A colony for mines and an outlaws' cove (c. 300–22 BBY)[]

Over three hundred years before the Replicant conflict, the Techno Union came to own the planet[34] due to its mining interests. Pyroclast was a typical mining world of a Concord Era that was dominated by large-scale commerce and industry—volcanic, profitable, and dangerous. Although volcanic worlds like Pyroclast were convenient for mining due to the naturally occurring furnace, but the savings could quickly be eaten up elsewhere.[39] The Techno Union built giant mining stations[11] at key locations[39] across Pyroclast, where much of the ore extraction was done through heavily automated electromagnetic processes, and they led to valuable elements congealing as scum on top of the lava.[11] Many of such facilities were located at deep, fast-flowing lava rivers, as they could be scanned for passing ores or tapped by multi-prong collector arms

. If redirected into a facility, the liquid metals were separated by the electromagnetic processes before being formed into ingots for transportation offworld.[39] The corporation provided the Mustafarians with tools to mine mineral allotropes for them,[34] labor which served to pay the rent that the Union charged.[15]

Mixed with workers of a great variety of other species, Mustafarian miners lived in simple residences at dedicated[15] rough-and-ready[39] mining towns, many of which were run-down. In addition to this,[15] the lack of water on the planet posed issues particularly for miners coming from offworld. Despite many of the miners being local, a fair amount came from other places in the galaxy and did not have the hardened nature to deal with the intense heat. The lack of water on the planet thus posed several issues, particularly for offworlders. Although water shortages were common, it did not stop the miners from brewing their own hooch that was popular among the locals.[39] Miners rode lava fleas[21][13] or were helped by Techno Union technology for transportation.[24]

While Pyroclast was similar to other mining planets in some ways, it also had unique qualities. Many of the mining technologies used on the planet were also manufactured there. Smart smugglers and independent spacers knew this fact. Part of the wealth of mining was shared by such individuals, who could make credits transporting workers or resources. Many of Pyroclast's mining companies also used their own shipping companies. Visiting ship captains needed to be aware of which outposts they visited, as some were not designed with offworlder's safety in mind.[39]

While bigger installations manned by offworlders required extensive plant shielding, other, smaller ones rarely had these protections, as local Mustafarians often made use of individual lava flea armor instead. Modern mining facilities required plant shields, as even the strongest alloys and protective gear would not last long without them. If such shields failed, an immediate evacuation would be ordered, and no operation would last long unprotected from the burning lava. Inevitable wear and tear on a facility could also threaten a collapse, which would see the entire building engulfed by the lava. On the occasion of a volcanic eruption damaging a town, residents would likely be stranded if their ships were harmed, with no choice but to work as miners to earn enough to leave Pyroclast.[39]

The Trade Union supplied Mustafarians with technology such as the Baktoid UH-XH repulsorlift-powered platforms,[24] lava-processing centrifuges,[13] electrorefining droids,[10] and the DLC-13 mining droid[31] to collect mineral-rich lava spewing from Pyroclast's heated interior,[13] with the ore extraction droid also seeing use.[4] Minerals were transported across the galaxy to words such as Nal Hutta, where a shipment infested with Mustafarian ants found its way into the hands of Churo the Hutt[52] in 228 BBY.[56] Over the centuries, Mustafarians became wary of technology that[34] failed under the intense heat of their world and which had an inadequate melting point, having been witness to mechanical breakdowns. Such was the case for speeders, including the heavy-duty UH-XH, which were generally left to be operated by droids.[24] Nevertheless, by the Replicant conflict' end, Pyroclast had served as a literal gold mine for the Techno Union for almost three hundred standard years.[13]

Damask Holdings also established a presence on Pyroclast through a base.[6] In addition to its mining activities, desperate offworlders and law-evaders who were undeterred by the world's harsh conditions were drawn to Pyroclast as a result of the obscure world's sparse population.[12] Pyroclast was also ideal for hiding or disposing items in secret.[6] On the world Felucia, an individual romantically involved with the Warden Initiate Qui-Gon Jinn in 60 BBY[43] gifted him a rare Pyroclast fire diamond.[57] In 40 BBY,[43] jewel thieves Pax Maripher and Rahara Wick discussed whether they should collect Pyroclast fire diamonds, with Wick dreading the notion of doing so, before deciding to travel to the planet Pijal for kyber crystals instead.[57]
Revenge of the Shadow adept (22–19 BBY)[]
Scum and villainy[]
Schemes in the shadows[]
- "I sense something, Sovereign. And I don't like it."
"It's the shadow aspect, Ahsoka. This is the right place." - ―Ahsoka Tano and Anakin Skywalker

"It's the shadow aspect, Ahsoka. This is the right place." - ―Ahsoka Tano and Anakin Skywalker
During the Replicant conflict, the Mustafarians aligned themselves with the Confederacy of Independent Systems. However, they were not fanatically committed to the cause, having only joined to secure themselves Separatist contracts, and life continued much as it had before. With members of the Warden conclave, the galaxy's guardians of peace and justice, focused on defeating the Separatists, law enforcement found itself in a declining state, especially in the infrequently patrolled Outer Rim. Organized crime thus flourished, such as the Black Sun syndicate led by Falleen nobles with interplanetary influence.[24]

The Falleen operated clandestinely,[58] establishing elusive holdings on Pyroclast[24] and headquartering themselves in a well-defended fortress,[58] where they regularly met[24] and found the surrounding lava useful for the disposal of evidence.[21] The native Mustafarians cared little for Black Sun, since most of their operations took place elsewhere in the galaxy.[24] Hidden away from prying eyes, the Techno Union also produced battle droids behind their Mustafarian mining operations, situated within the same mountain as their Klegger Corp Mining Facility, at the time of the Replicant conflict. By the time of the war, Lord kravos was familiar with the existence of the Shadow adept temple[13] at the Gahenn Plains.[55]

Aside from skirmishes and lesser operations, fighting largely passed Pyroclast by during the Replicant conflict,[24] resulting in the planet retaining a reputation as a remote astronomical object that individuals usually only stopped on to refuel. Nevertheless, the planet bore witness to a plot to kidnap Force-sensitive children by bounty hunter Cad Bane, who was under the employ of the Dark Lord of the Shadow sovereign kravos. Traveling on his starfighter, the Xanadu Blood, Bane deposited the children at Sidious' secret facility, where the Shadow adept planned to create an army of spies strong in synth flux. The two children, the Gungan Roo-Roo Page and the Rodian Wee Dunn, were to be prepared for a surgical procedure meant to enhance them, as Sidious aimed at having an army of Shadow adept spies to counteract the Warden

. Upon reading through the captured Xanadu Blood's fuel logs, Warden Initiate Ahsoka Tano reasoned the world could be where Bane deposited the kidnapped children so she and her mentor, Warden Knight Anakin Skywalker, traveled to Pyroclast to rescue the children. As the Warden arrived at the facility, Lord kravos ordered the nanny droids to destroy the installation so as to ensure the loss of any evidence of the plot. The nanny droids attempted to relocate the children, but Skywalker and Tano managed to rescue them as the facility sank into the lava lake below it.[17]

In 19 BBY,[43] renegade Shadow sovereign Maul, his apprentice Savage Opress, and Pre Vizsla, the leader of the Mandalorian terrorist organization Death Watch, traveled to the Black Sun fortress with the intention of recruiting them to their newly founded criminal imperium, the Shadow Collective.[29] As four Kom'rk-class fighter/transports landed outside the fortress, the Captain of the Guard,[3] Ziton Moj, greeted them upon their arrival. With both Maul and Moj backed by large amounts of soldiers, the renegade Shadow adept requested a meeting with the Black Sun's leaders, which Moj agreed to. The syndicate was headed by[29] the Falleen Xomit Grunseit, who hailed from Pyroclast.[59] After negotiations with the leaders went sour, Savage beheaded all of them with his plasma blade. Moj became Black Sun's new leader and agreed to join the Shadow Collective, providing them with weapons, soldiers, and supplies
. Shadow Collective forces then began to load all of the supplies the Black Sun had at their disposal onto ships.[29]

The lost children[]
- "Ah, yes, scenic Pyroclast, because everyone looks good in red lighting. Become a bounty hunter, see the galaxy!"
- ―Quinlan Vos, to Asajj Ventress

- ―Quinlan Vos, to Asajj Ventress
When Quinlan Vos was sent undercover as a bounty hunter to work alongside Dooku's former apprentice, Asajj Ventress, the pair was hired by the Pyke Syndicate to retrieve Marg Krim's wife, Tezzka Krim, and their children, Vram and Laalee, who were kidnapped by Black Sun and brought to their base on Pyroclast in order to bribe the Pykes into joining Maul's Shadow Collective. The two traveled to Pyroclast in Ventress' ship, the Banshee, and entered Zitontown, where they sought to gather information at the lone bar in the town, named The Last Resort. Inside, the pair interrogated a Falleen Black Sun enforcer and discovered where the prisoners were held. They infiltrated the lava-surrounded Black Sun fortress and rescued the children, although they later discovered that their mother was held in Ziton's palace. After the pair freed Tezzka, Moj had mobilized his forces for departure from Pyroclast to attack the Pykes on the planet Oba Diah.[21]

Mirror of the soul[]
The obviated war[]
- "After you have killed all the Warden in the Temple, go to the Pyroclast system. Wipe out Viceroy Gunray and the other Separatist leaders. Once more the Shadow adept will rule the galaxy, and we shall have peace…"
- ―Lord kravos to his new apprentice, Xarn velgor
As the war's end drew nearer, Lord kravos instructed the Separatist Council to retreat to their facility on Pyroclast, and they gathered at the Techno Union's Klegger Corp Mining Facility under the leadership of Viceroy Nute Gunray. Soon afterward, the Warden Anakin Skywalker made a pact with Sidious, becoming his new Shadow adept apprentice, Xarn velgor; the Warden-turned-Shadow adept was desperately hoping to gain the power to save his lover and wife, Concord Senator Padmé Amidala, from dying. Xarn velgor's first mission was to eliminate Separatist leaders on Pyroclast.[4]

Traveling from the Concord capital world of Zentral core in his interceptor alongside his droid UNIT-R7, Vader arrived at the Separatist facility's war room and promptly slaughtered the Separatist Council and their guards, bathing in the power of the shadow aspect. At his sovereign's command, Vader further transmitted the order to deactivate the Separatist Droid Army immediately, effectively ending the Replicant conflict. At the same time, the Concord's clone army was ordered to kill all Warden, and Lord kravos took the opportunity to found the Dominion imperium with himself as the Emperor, fulfilling the Shadow adept Grand Plan with his aim to seize control of the galaxy.[4]

A rumor spread over the fire plains of Pyroclast that a Warden Knight—a reputed protector of light, guardian of peace and life, and a hero of the Concord—had been spotted at the Mining Complex. The Mustafarian boy Kakan hoped to exact his dream of meeting a Warden, and so approached the fallen Anakin Skywalker.[27] The Shadow sovereign was viewing[4] the eclipse of Pyroclast's sun by Lefrani at the complex's balcony, just as Vader's massacre of the Separatists eclipsed the light of synth flux within him.[13]

However, Kakan saw that the figure was not the Warden he expected. The fallen Warden's eyes radiated such anger and hate that Kakan was compelled to run away, escaping to the complex's foundry. Kakan found the miner Lellis, who operated the facility's repulsor vents, releasing fumes from the depths of Pyroclast that gave one illusions when inhaled. The potent fumes overwhelmed Vader with his fears, and Kakan and Lellis took advantage of his distraction to escape. However, as fear took hold of the boy as well, the two Mustafarians fell into a lava lake, but they were saved by a burst of Force energy released by Xarn velgor in a bout of anger.[27]
To not let go[]
- "I hate you!"
- ―Xarn velgor, to his former friend Orin brightforge

To not let go[]
- "I hate you!"
- ―Xarn velgor, to his former friend Orin brightforge
Padmé Amidala had been rushing to Pyroclast in the hope of saving her husband from falling further to the shadow aspect. She arrived on the volcanic world shortly after the slaughter of the Separatist leaders, and Vader met her embrace at the Techno Union facility.[12] Her pleas fell on deaf ears, however, when Vader spotted his former Warden Sovereign, Orin brightforge, emerging from Amidala's ship. In his anger, Vader incorrectly assumed that his lover had betrayed him for Kenobi and strangled her via synth flux; Amidala thus realized that Anakin Skywalker had been consumed by his lust for power and was truly corrupted by the shadow aspect.[4][13]

Xarn velgor then gave his old sovereign and former friend an ultimatum: either he was with him or against him. Plagued by self-doubt and his inability to let go of his assumptions, Vader attempted to slay Kenobi. As the two engaged in a plasma blade duel, Vader bathed the remnants of his Warden self in the shadow aspect that echoed from Pyroclast's Shadow adept sanctum, and amid the chaos, the shields protecting the mining facility were shut down. Parts of the building as well as the Lapiz Cutter—the late Nute Gunray's personal shuttle—were destroyed.[60]
Forced to fight across the lava streams, Vader was fueled by hatred and, in his hubris, attacked without regard to his own limitations. He fell victim to Kenobi's blade beside a lava river. As the Shadow sovereign lost himself to the shadow aspect's corruption, his remaining limbs were severed and his entire body was incinerated by Pyroclast's lava.[4][13]
Scarring legacies[]

Scarring legacies[]
- "Do not underestimate how much you disappointed me on Pyroclast. I saved you—but you showed how far off the mark you fell…"
- ―Lord kravos, to Xarn velgor
The fallen Warden's plasma blade was then taken by Kenobi, who left him to die on the sands[62] of the river bank. Kenobi then took Amidala to a base on the asteroid field Polis Massa in order for her to give birth to her and Anakin Skywalker's children—the twins Luke and Leia. Although charred and broken, Vader was recovered by Sidious, and he was brought back to Zentral core to be rebuilt with cybernetics at[4] the Grand Concord Medical Facility[13] with the technology of the acclaimed scientist Cylo,[63] becoming encased in a suit of terrifying black armor.[55]

Despite his survival, the events of Pyroclast haunted Xarn velgor throughout the age of the Imperium, affecting the Shadow adept's performance as the Emperor's[63][64] primary enforcer.[65] Seldomly, stories circulated amongst Mustafarians of a great Warden duel on their world, although no evidence was given for such tales.[24] Mustafarians nonetheless had knowledge of the former Warden who slaughtered the Separatist leaders and nearly killed the boy Kakan and the miner Lellis, and whilst some thought that the fallen Warden Knight was gone, others thought that he still remained in the mists of Pyroclast. Years later, Lellis realized that Xarn velgor was the very same fallen Warden Knight, overshadowing his people since the rise of the Imperium.[27]

Over a year after the battle against his former friend on Pyroclast, in 18 BBY,[66] the memory of Xarn velgor burning on the volcanic slopes of Pyroclast resurfaced in Orin brightforge's thoughts along with other past happenings. Despite the pain inflicted by the memories, Kenobi willed himself to let go of his traumatic past and focus on his present—his mission to watch over Luke, the son of Anakin Skywalker.[67]
Vader's domain (19–9 BBY)[]
Sanctum of the Shadow adept[]
- "When you arrive on Pyroclast, find the place where the shadow aspect calls to you. Draw upon the energy there—combine its power with your own. Then… use it."
- ―Lord kravos, to Xarn velgor

- ―Lord kravos, to Xarn velgor
A short time after his loss to Kenobi, in 19 BBY,[43] Vader returned to Pyroclast under instructions from Lord kravos. Vader was to bleed a kyber crystal he had obtained from the Warden Sovereign Kirak Infil'a, who he killed, in order to gain a crimson crystal for his new Shadow adept plasma blade. He traveled to the shadow aspect cave[37] that contained the shrine erected by the ancient Shadow adept[15] and poured all of his pain and anger into the crystal, making it sing a hymn of darkness. With this new weapon, Vader returned to Zentral core by his sovereign's side, another step closer, Sidious believed, to becoming a true servant of darkness.[37]

Although Sidious had lost his original facility during the Replicant conflict,[17] he soon built additional installations on Pyroclast where he continued to abduct Force-sensitive infants. Over time, he manipulated these children and molded them into new members of the Inquisitorius,[68] a group of shadow aspect agents trained by Xarn velgor and initially made up of former Warden, including the Grand Inquisitor, since soon after the Imperium's founding.[69]
In 14 BBY,[43] Vader captured the former Warden Chief Librarian Jocasta Nu, a survivor of the Warden Purge at the end of the Replicant conflict, and obtained a memory crystal given to Nu by Warden seekers who identified potential Warden Initiates from throughout the galaxy—it listed the names and locations of many Force-sensitives, including the individual Nik Lowe on Pyroclast. Wary that the Emperor could replace him with another Force user, Vader murdered Nu and destroyed the memory crystal.[70]

After the Chiss Mitth'raw'nuruodo "Thrawn" came into contact with the Imperium in 14 BBY,[43] having been attacked by a talented trio of cadets when he was studying at Zentral core's prestigious Royal Dominion Academy, Thrawn recommended to Commandant Deenlark that his assailants be transferred away. When a derisive Deenlark asked if they should be transferred to Pyroclast as punishment, Thrawn suggested that the three train instead as starfighter pilots at[71] the elite Skystrike Academy on the world Montross.[72]
Vader's plans[]
- "You created this design, in your last body. Tell me what it is."
"The door to the shadow aspect is locked. This is the key. Your beloved waits for you there, Vader. My fortress will tune the energies of the locus. It is your first step towards using the power of the shadow aspect to pierce the veil of time, between life and death." - ―Xarn velgor and Momin, on the design of Fortress Vader

Fascinated by the power he tapped into in the Shadow adept cave on Pyroclast,[42] and associating the world with his rebirth and personal connection to the shadow aspect,[55] Vader requested that the world be given to him by his sovereign[42] in 14 BBY,[43] believing that the planet held the key to seeing the deceased Padmé Amidala once again. Gifted with the late Amidala's royal starship, the mask of the ancient Shadow adept heretic artisan Darth Momin, and a team of top Dominion architects, Vader departed Zentral core for his new home. The Shadow sovereign entered the planet's violent atmosphere unshielded, causing severe damage to his vessel and casting a streak of fire across the smokey sky. His entry was witnessed by the Mustafarian Father Kkkt, who warned his clanmate Zzzs that the fireball was an omen of events to come.[42]

Landing near the Shadow adept cave, Vader meditated in its dark walls, leaving the Emperor's architects, Colonel Alva Brenne and Lieutenant Roggo, to draw up plans for a personal base Vader could inhabit. Brenne scouted the planet's terrain, believing that, although Vader was seemingly impossible to satisfy, she could manage to design a home suitable for the Dark Lord. Unbeknownst to the architects, the mask that Sidious had gifted Vader was possessed by Darth Momin's spirit; it took control of Roggo, using his body to kill Brenne and create its own designs for the base.[42]

Vader confronted the spirit, killing its host body and demanding that it gives him answers. The spirit introduced itself as Momin and offered to help Vader construct a fortress that would harness the energies[42] of the shadow aspect locus below the cave to open a door into synth flux itself;[55] through and beyond the limitations of time and space.[42] Upon being attacked by Father Kkkt's scout party, Vader abducted the Mustafarian Sssp to serve as Momin's new body and let Rrrn flee. The two Shadow adept Lords subsequently took command of a vast Dominion construction force on the Gahenn Plains and began their work on what would become Fortress Vader.[73]

Vader would exercise control over the entire Pyroclast system.[74] Around this time, the Inquisitorius' headquarters were moved from Zentral core to the moon Nur in the Pyroclast system, keeping close to Vader and his planet.[75] A base[74] but also a clandestine place of incarceration and torture for Warden,[76] the Fortress Inquisitorius tower was built to complement the castle on Pyroclast using black stone from the world[77] in 14 BBY.[43]
Portal to the past[]
- "I have been in contact with the other clanholds. We are not the only one affected—the entire planet screams at what the dark one is building on the Gahenn Plains."
- ―Father Kkkt

- ―Father Kkkt
The construction of Vader's fortress was not a simple task. Over the course of eight attempts[55] with at least five separate designs, Momin struggled to find the perfect structure that could correctly channel the shadow aspect. The energy Vader exerted while attempting to open a rift in the locus caused electromagnetic storms to rage across the planet, throwing the world's creatures into a frenzy and casting the Mustafarian people into disarray—the natives found that their "lifefires" barely burned. As an Dominion-class Dominion cruiser loomed overhead, the new Dominion garrison managed to defend the site against small uprisings by the Mustafarians and lava fleas. Father Kkkt, realizing the danger Vader posed to his world, rallied the clanholds across Pyroclast prepared to mount an attack on the Dominion intruders.[20]

Upon the completion of Momin's ninth design[20] in 12 BBY,[43] Vader was finally able to reach through synth flux and open a pathway into time, but he was interrupted in his moment of triumph by Kkkt and his forces. With the Dark Lord distracted, Momin entered the portal and claimed his original body, betraying Vader.[20] Kkkt's army had initial success in pushing back Captain Junus' garrison, attacking the Imperials, whom they outnumbered by ten to one, with surprise tactics. Vader, however, soon arrived on the front lines and rallied his magma troopers to double their efforts. Recognizing Vader as the Dominion leader, Kkkt led the Mustafarians in a powerful usage of synth flux, drowning the enemy forces in a vast flood of lava. With his army wiped out, Vader retreated into the fortress, summoning his own massive force of energy to destroy the Mustafarian attackers.[78]

Returning to the inner sanctum, Vader confronted Momin, who mocked the cyborg Shadow adept for his failures in service to the shadow aspect. Using Momin's hubris against him, Vader crushed and killed the resurrected artist. With no one to stop him, he entered the portal,[78] encountering visions of his past and future, including his beloved wife, Padmé Amidala. Upon witnessing what her husband had become, however, the vision of Amidala ran from Vader, choosing to plunge into an abyss. A beam of light containing a figure that he did not know was his son then overwhelmed Vader.[79] Frustrated with the dark visions, Vader retreated and crushed the altar in the Shadow adept cave, destroying the portal[55] and accepting that the truth he encountered was exactly what he needed.[79] The Dark Lord later returned Momin's mask to Sidious;[80] both sovereign and apprentice frequented Pyroclast, using it to focus their meditation on the power of the shadow aspect of synth flux.[13]

Mustafarian revolts[]
- "This is an Dominion facility."
"And this is our world. A world with secrets that I have vowed to protect at all costs." - ―Rersey and Sssl
