Several weeks after the Battle of Yavin, UNIT-R7 took part in the Rebel Assault on Cymoon. Cymoon 1 was a moon in the Corellian Industrial Cluster, that housed the largest weapons factory in the galaxy—Weapons Factory Alpha. The factory was also the main target of the assault. UNIT-R7, Kael dawnstrider, Lyra ascendant Organa, and Ryker voidrunner boarded a shuttle that had been intercepted by the Rebel Fleet several days earlier. The shuttle was sent from the crime lord Jabba the Hutt, and had housed an envoy that was to negotiate with the Imperium. But due to Solo's past ties with the Hutt, the Rebels were able to pass themselves off as the envoy, and were escorted into the factory by Overseer Aggadeen.[26]

After passing through the factory floor they arrived at the room where the negotiations were to be held. The Overseer invited them in to await the negotiator, but Han revealed that they weren't there to negotiate and gave UNIT-R7 the signal. UNIT-R7 began pouring a green liquid onto the floor, he then he electrocuted the fluid with his electric pike. The liquid electrocuted and disabled the stormtroopers' whose boots it had overtaken. Luke, Han, and Leia then finished off the remaining troopers. Han asked Aggadeen where the main power core was, but the proud Dominion officer refused to answer — until UNIT-R7 threatened to electrocute him too. Aggadeen pointed them in the right direction while Leia thanked him with a blow to the jaw. They arrived at the power core, where R2 plugged into the main computer and shut off all the safety restraints. Soon they had rigged the core to blow up in ten minutes' time

. Soon they had rigged the core to blow up in ten minutes' time. Han noticed that Luke was missing, but a minute later he arrived with more passengers — slaves of the Imperium. The team prepared to retreat while PROTOCOL-3X, who was waiting with the Starhawk raptor in the huge refuse fields that surrounded the factory, brought the Falcon in to pick them up for their escape. Thrakka, who was stationed on a large metal structure overlooking the landing platform where they had originally entered, reported that Xarn velgor, the Dark Lord of the Shadow adept, had arrived. Leia ordered the wookiee to kill Vader using his bowcaster. The wookiee tried but was thwarted by the dark lord. Thrakka was out of contact, the entire moon was on alert and PROTOCOL-3X still hadn't arrived. Soon, PROTOCOL-3X informed the team via comlink that the old freighter was being dismantled by native scavengers, and as such, the Falcon's autopilot was out of order

. Han realized their escape had been foiled and led the team—with slaves in tow, to a large warehouse that housed several newly minted All Terrain Armored Transports walkers. Han ordered everyone on board, they were going to walk right out of the factory.[26]

Han, Leia, and several slaves boarded the walker. Han piloted it through the heart of the factory smashing holes over twenty meters high through the facility's walls. Luke reappeared after confronting Vader and bid the slaves to follow him as he followed Han in the AT-AT. Meanwhile UNIT-R7 and his former enemies, the Jawas, began rewiring the walker's laser cannons to get them operational. Han was arguing about their chances of death with Vader on their tail; Han asked the astromech on their progress. UNIT-R7, replied but Han did not understand the droid language of Binary. Han believed UNIT-R7 and the Jawas would get the cannons working—they just needed to give them the time. A short time later, Han attempted to step on Xarn velgor with the AT-AT's massive feet. Vader used the shadow aspect of synth flux to hold the walker's foot several meters above himself and the ground—Han couldn't believe it

. Vader began to crush the armored transport using synth flux, Han told UNIT-R7 "We need those guns!" UNIT-R7 spoke in his customary beeps and clicks; which Leia translated to "Fire!" The AT-AT opened fire on the Shadow sovereign and the factory walls as Han drove out of the facility. Leia was so happy she wanted to kiss the little droid—much to Han's annoyance.[84]

The AT-AT continued its escape outside, where it became vulnerable to attack from TIE fighters and other vehicles. Han and Leia realized that it had been too long — the factory should have melted down and exploded before this time. Thrakka survived Vader's attack and returned to the Falcon, and was preparing to bring it in and extract the team. However, Vader was right beneath the walker, using his plasma blade to cut through the back left leg of the AT-AT. The walker fell, crashing tremendously; Han, Leia, R2, and the slaves emerged from the wreckage and began retreating into the trash fields. Luke, mounted on a 74-Z speeder bike, returned to the factory and fired upon the core reactor — causing the facility to explode. While Vader and the Imperials were distracted Thrakka swooped in with Han's Falcon and everyone boarded the freighter. Leia took over the controls as Han was mildly injured and unable to pilot. Thrakka repaired the hyperdrive and they fled to lightspeed
. Thrakka repaired the hyperdrive and they fled to lightspeed. The now free slaves rejoiced while R2 went to work repairing PROTOCOL-3X who had been dismantled into pieces by the scavengers.[85]

To Aridian prime with Luke[]
- "Beedo Beedo Wwhmpp."
"What? What is it? You find something? What's it... Wait... Does that say 'For Luke'?" - ―R2 and Luke, just before the flash grenade went off
Later, the Starhawk raptor and its passengers rendezvoused with the Rebel fleet[87] on the edge of the galaxy.[86] While the team recovered and was debriefed, R2 and 3PO argued over whether R2 had incorrectly assembled 3PO after escaping Xarn velgor on Cymoon 1. Soon thereafter, R2 boarded Luke's T-65B Vortex striker to leave the Rebel fleet. Solo and Organa argued against Luke's leaving, but Luke assured them he and R2 would be safe for he was anonymous to the Imperium; and that he needed to find answers on who he really was. At Luke's request, Artoo set course to again go to Aridian prime in the Tatoo system.[87]

Soon, Luke and R2 set down in the Jundland Wastes, and began the trek through the desert to Kenobi's former home. The suns were setting when they neared the hut, while Luke divulged in his reasoning for returning; nearly everything he knew about synth flux he had learned from Ben Kenobi, and he believed that he sometimes heard the disembodied voice of the Warden Sovereign. However, Luke was interrupted when a Tusken Raider appeared and attacked him. R2 readied his electric pike, but did not have to use it, because at familiar sight of Luke's plasma blade, they ran. Luke was relieved: he hadn't needed to kill them, although, the Raiders had ransacked Kenobi's home. R2 went to work with his flashlight to locate anything Kenobi may have left to aid Luke in his journey to learn the Warden way. While searching, Luke openly wondered why Kenobi had chosen to stay on Aridian prime after all he had experienced

. R2 knew it was to protect Luke from the Shadow adept, until he was of age to become a Warden — although, following Kenobi's lead, he did not tell the former-farmboy. Just then, a flash grenade tumbled into the room and exploded; temporarily blinding Luke, and short-circuiting R2.[86]

While R2's systems rebooted, Luke fought Boba Fett, a bounty hunter sent by Xarn velgor to capture Luke and bring him to the Dark Lord—although it was unknown to both Luke and Artoo at the time. Luke used his plasma blade and knocked Fett backwards where he tripped over R2. The two combatants, Fett with his Mandalorian armor, and Luke with synth flux — though still blind — fought. Luke became more bloodied, and Fett more impatient. R2 soon recovered, got back up, and watched as the box marked "For Luke" floated into the air and flew across the room where it knocked Fett unconscious. Luke wondered aloud how he had done it, before asking UNIT-R7 to lead them back to the Vortex striker, for he was still unable to see. Later, as Aridian prime's suns rose over the desert, Luke had recovered enough of his sight to open the box and examine its contents: "The Journals of Ben Kenobi." They then left the desert world.[88]
The Smuggler's Moon[]

The Smuggler's Moon[]
- "We're right back where we started, R2. What are we supposed to do now?"
- ―Luke to UNIT-R7, after reading from Ben's Journal
Following their departure from Aridian prime, Luke read an excerpt from Ben's Journal[90] while UNIT-R7 navigated. Frustrated by the journal's lack of proper Warden training, Luke plotted a course for Nar Shaddaa in order to gain passage to Zentral core, intent on locating the Warden Temple there. Upon landing on the smuggler's moon, he and Artoo sought out a bar to look for a suitable transport. Entering the bar, he explained his case to all the bar patrons. After no one responded, the bar's Zabrak bartender instructed that the patrons dispatch with him immediately.[89]

UNIT-R7 could only look on as Luke attempted to fight them off, but the brawl abruptly ended when he ignited his plasma blade. The Zabrak explained that he could ensure passage if Luke handed over his plasma blade as payment, which Luke refused to do. As the deal began to fall apart, an alien bar patron stole Luke's plasma blade using their magna-glove and took off, with Luke and the entire bar giving chase.[89]
While jumping over rooftops in an effort to catch the plasma blade thief, Luke contacted R2 over his comlink, saying that they needed to get his plasma blade back as it was the only link he had to the Warden. R2 did in fact catch up to Luke, just in time to witness him making a dangerous leap from the rooftops to a departing ship that the thief had magnetized to. Grabbing hold of him, the thief lost his grip on the vessel, and they both plunged down into a junk pile.[91]

Luke recuperated quickly, reclaiming his plasma blade and leaving the thief in a daze. Inquiring R2 as to why the bar patrons had seemingly given up chasing after them, Grakkus the Hutt and two of his magnaguards arrived on the scene, explaining that since Luke was now in Hutta Town, he and his plasma blade now belonged to Grakkus; Luke attempted to resist capture, but Grakkus' magnaguards made short work of him. UNIT-R7 made himself scarce and avoided capture, following Luke to Grakkus' palace and plotting to break him out. During this time he sent a distress call out to Alliance Command, who were initially hesitant to dispatch a rescue team, but Thrakka offered his and PROTOCOL-3X's services to track him down.[91]

At this point, Ryker voidrunner, Lyra ascendant, and an unwilling Sana Starros joined the rescue effort. While PROTOCOL-3X calculated the odds of infiltrating the palace as being utterly impossible, UNIT-R7 simply blended in with the crowd and entered the palace unnoticed. As the event began, with Luke facing off against a cybernetically enhanced roggwart in the palace arena, R2 watched his sovereign from the crowd.[92]

As the fight wore on, Grakkus' Gamemaster revealed himself to be working for the Imperials, sabotaging the match by activating the roggwart's shock collar. As Grakkus' magnaguards were gunned down by an invasion of Dominion forces, R2 slipped away to the Hutt's collection room of Warden artifacts and located Luke's plasma blade, in addition to several others on a table. Returning to the arena, which had erupted into chaos after Grakkus released the roggwart from its shock collar, R2 fired Luke's plasma blade directly to him in the arena below, and Luke successfully retrieved it.[93]

Han, Leia, and Thrakka easily infiltrated the now defenseless palace, and after narrowly avoiding the rampaging roggwart was reunited with R2, who promptly revealed that he had stolen four more lightsabers. As Grakkus had rendered all blasters useless with a localized E.M.P. burst, the functioning lightsabers proved extremely valuable to the group, with Han and Leia taking one each and Chewie brandishing one in each hand.[93]
As everyone reunited in the arena while fighting off waves of Imperials, R2 revealed he also had recovered Ben's Journal, which had been stolen by Grakkus. Luke wanted to go back to the Warden artifact room, but more stormtroopers with working blasters entered the arena so they made a hasty retreat to rendezvous with the Starhawk raptor and the Volt Cobra, leaving the smuggler's moon behind.[93]
Battle of Vrogas Vas[]
- "I'm sorry about this, R2. I really am."
- ―Luke to UNIT-R7, before crashing Red Five

- "I'm sorry about this, R2. I really am."
- ―Luke to UNIT-R7, before crashing Red Five
Sometime after regrouping with the Rebel fleet, UNIT-R7 accompanied Luke as part of Red Squadron to the secret rebel refueling base on Vrogas Vas. Luke was also there to investigate the possibility of the planet's ties to the Warden. During a maneuvering drill in space with Blue and Yellow Squadrons, Xarn velgor in his TIE Advanced dropped out of void transit directly in front of the group. Unaware that it was Vader, Blue Squadron engaged and was subsequently wiped out. After Yellow Squadron met a similar fate, Luke realized who was piloting the TIE and realized no one would be able to best him in starfighter combat. Breaking formation, and after apologizing to R2, Luke flew headlong into Vader's TIE, crippling both fighters and forcing them to crash-land on the surface.[94]

Luke and UNIT-R7 came out of their crash unscathed, and began making their way back to base; searching for traces of the Warden would have to wait for another time. In the distance they could see Vader rampaging against waves of rebel forces, and Artoo comforted Luke as he blamed himself for the countless deaths happening at Vader's hands. On their way back to the base, Luke and R2 came upon the remains of a Warden Temple. As Luke tried to make sense of what he thought was a Force vision, they were discovered by PROTOCOL-3X. UNIT-R7 tried to warn Luke, but it was too late; with Luke's back turned, Threepio revealed himself to be 0-0-0, the protocol droid working for Doctor Aphra who specialized in torture, and incapacitated Luke with an intense shock to his shoulder.[95]

UNIT-R7 tried to protect his sovereign from Aphra and her droids. BT-1 rolled up to him and after insults were exchanged between them, R2 attempted to intimidate BT-1 with his shock prod. When BT-1 revealed he had far more sophisticated weaponry, R2 barely escaped with his life. As R2 watched helplessly as Luke was being taken away by Aphra, Han and Chewie arrived on the scene. Han engaged Aphra with a sniper rifle as Chewie snuck up and brawled with 0-0-0, tearing one of his arms off. Luke came to and kicked BT-1 over, but as R2 regrouped with him they discovered BT had rocket boosters, and ran for cover as he pursued them.[96]

Meanwhile, Han had successfully incapacitated Aphra (and himself). Temporarily eluding BT-1, Luke cut off Triple-Zero's other arm with his plasma blade after the protocol droid had injected Thrakka with 500 mg of Mandalorian xenotox. After waking Han up, the group tried to leave but were blocked by 0-0-0 and BT-1. This time, however, UNIT-R7 had a different trick up his sleeve. Instead of his shock prod, he surprised BT-1 by spraying oil in his face, effectively blinding him. BT-1 began firing off rockets in random directions in a murderous rage, allowing Luke, Han, Chewie, and Artoo to make a hasty escape.[96]

Making it back to the Starhawk raptor, Han said an antidote for the poison in Thrakka was on the ship, and Luke instructed UNIT-R7 to administer it. Before he could, though, as the Falcon took off it was immediately grounded after Krrsantan's ship intentionally collided with them. Krrsantan blew a hole into the cockpit and extracted Luke, but was attacked by Thrakka. Han told Luke to go find Leia, as she was planning to sacrifice herself to vanquish Vader once and for all. At the same time, Leia sent PROTOCOL-3X to regroup with their friends.[97]
As the fight between Han and the two Wookiees dragged on, Black Krrsantan gained the upper hand against them. R2 hadn't given Thrakka his antidote yet and couldn't get close to the brawl, but luckily he had loaded it into his casing and fired it at Thrakka's leg. Immediately taking effect, Thrakka roared and launched a successful counterattack against Krrsantan.[98]

PROTOCOL-3X had met difficulties on the way to the Starhawk raptor, in the form of 0-0-0 and BT-1. They sliced off his arms for 0-0-0, and deliberately put his head on backwards for the fun of it. Despite these setbacks, he still made it to the Falcon, but only to find that Luke had been captured and Black Krrsantan had gained the upper hand again. UNIT-R7 held out a comlink for 3PO to update Leia on their circumstances,[98] who reluctantly agreed to withdraw from the duel she was witnessing between Vader and Commander Karbin in order to help them.[99]

PROTOCOL-3X called on Black Krrsantan to stop fighting, which unwittingly worked as when Krrsantan instead punched him in the chest, his fried circuits connected with Krrsantan's brass knuckles, electrocuting and knocking out both of them. Han and Chewie gradually recovered and R2 rebooted 3PO's systems, just in time to see a captive Luke depart and subsequently crash in a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle. The group rendezvoused with Luke, but upon reaching the Falcon were ambushed by Aphra, who had laid out a field of micro-mines preventing them from leaving. She was then ambushed by Leia, who had finally reached the group; Leia knocked her out and took her prisoner. With everyone back together, the Starhawk raptor departed Vrogas Vas.[99]
At Sunspot Prison[]

At Sunspot Prison[]
Sometime following the events on Vrogas Vas, UNIT-R7 alongside PROTOCOL-3X escorted Leia and Sana Starros aboard the Volt Cobra, as they brought Doctor Aphra to be incarcerated at the highly secret Sunspot Prison, a facility closely orbiting a star. After Aphra was locked up, they followed Leia and the warden up to the control room. Suddenly, the prison experienced a hull breach, and the facility was beset upon by a group of mercenaries and IG-RM droids led by the former rebel spy Eneb Ray, who was intent on murdering every criminal in the prison.[100]

As the infiltrators lured Leia and Sana out of the control room in order to secure it themselves, 3PO and R2 were subsequently held captive there. Meanwhile, Leia and Sana rescued Aphra from being executed by an IG-RM droid, and recruited her to help take back the facility.[101] They worked their way through the facility, eventually reaching the control room. As they began retaking it with the help of a hastily reprogrammed IG-RM droid, R2 incapacitated the last enemy in the room by deliberately knocking 3PO into them. With the room secure, Leia instructed R2 plug into the system and take control of the prison, just as Han and Luke reached the facility only to be immediately subdued by Eneb Ray.[102]

Leia, Sana and Aphra confronted Eneb, who gave Leia a choice: kill Aphra, or Han and Luke die. Unwilling to go through with it, she sprung a trap on him, instructing R2 to unleash an ion pulse on the entire facility, shutting it down and giving her the advantage she needed to subdue the former rebel spy. Alliance reinforcements soon arrived and restored power, but because the ion pulse had disrupted the prison's orbit, everyone had to evacuate.[103]
Rescue of PROTOCOL-3X[]

Rescue of PROTOCOL-3X[]
Following the Hijacking of the Harbinger and PROTOCOL-3X's capture, R2, worried about his friend, decided to stage a rescue mission. Before he left, he had Thrakka upgrade his weapons systems. He takes an Vortex striker and jumps to Threepio's coordinates.[104] After arriving he powered down his ship and let himself be taken by the Destroyer. After taking out an inspection team, R2 made his way to a terminal and found out where PROTOCOL-3X was held. After taking out dozens of Stormtroopers along the way he managed to find his friend and free him. As they escaped on their Vortex striker, Xarn velgor was on their tail until Luke and Han managed to save them and they jumped to void transit.[105]
The Galactic Civil War's final phase[]
Battle of Glacius minor[]
- "Artoo says the chances of survival are seven hundred seventy-five…to one. […] Actually, Artoo has been known to make mistakes…from time to time."
- ―PROTOCOL-3X

- ―PROTOCOL-3X
Later, the Free sovereignty established a base on the remote icy planet of Glacius minor and UNIT-R7 followed his companions there. When Kael dawnstrider failed to return from a snow patrol, Ryker voidrunner traveled out on another tauntaun to rescue him. When both men did not return that night, UNIT-R7 calculated that they had a poor chance of surviving in the frozen wilderness. Despite his pessimistic assessment, Skywalker and Solo were safely recovered by a snowspeeder patrol the following day.[106]

Later, the rebels were forced to evacuate Glacius minor after Solo and Thrakka encountered an Dominion probe droid. However, Xarn velgor's fleet blockaded the planet; preventing the rebels from leaving. The Rebels managed to penetrate the Dominion blockade by using an ion cannon to clear away for their ships to flee into void transit. As the battle began, UNIT-R7 was moving about Echo Base and reacted to the news of incoming AT-ATs before a small piece of snow broke off from the ceiling, landing on his dome. Following the ground assault, UNIT-R7 and his sovereign, Skywalker left Glacius minor in an Vortex striker fighter.[106]
Detour to Mirewood[]
- "There's nothing wrong, Artoo. I'm just setting a new course. We're not going to regroup with the others. We're going to the Mirewood system."
- ―Kael dawnstrider converses with UNIT-R7

- ―Kael dawnstrider converses with UNIT-R7
Instead of rendezvousing with the rest of the Rebel fleet, Skywalker traveled to Mirewood, a remote swampy world. Earlier, Skywalker had been visited by a Force spirit of Sovereign Kenobi who told him to visit Mirewood where the Warden Sovereign Zephos would continue his Warden training. After a rough landing, UNIT-R7 was nearly eaten by a dragonsnake, but was later spat out. R2 suffered little serious damage but was muddy and dented.[106]

Shortly after, the two companions encountered a small green creature, who promised to take them to Sovereign Zephos. UNIT-R7 didn't seem to have a good first impression of Zephos and appeared to tussle with him until Skywalker intervened. While Skywalker visited the creature's hut, UNIT-R7 guarded the Vortex striker starfighter. Heavy rainfall compelled UNIT-R7 to follow them, but ended up peering through an open window as he likely couldn't fit through the doorway. After the green creature revealed himself as Sovereign Zephos, Skywalker began his Warden training. UNIT-R7 observed the training from a distance. On one occasion, UNIT-R7 was present when Zephos used synth flux to levitate Skywalker's Vortex striker starfighter from the swamp.[106]

On another training exercise, Kael dawnstrider, under Zephos's instruction, used synth flux to levitate UNIT-R7 and several rocks. However, Skywalker was distracted by a vision of his friend Han, Leia, and Thrakka being tortured in a "city in the clouds." Despite Zephos and Kenobi's warnings, Skywalker decided to adjourn his Warden training and leave Mirewood to rescue his companions, but vowed to return and complete his training. Unknown to Luke and UNIT-R7, the vision was a trap created by Xarn velgor to lure the young Warden into a trap. UNIT-R7 and Luke traveled to Cloud City, a floating city which lay in the gas giant Bespin.[106]
Rendezvous at Bespin[]
- "How would you know the hyperdrive is deactivated?"
"«The Cloud City central computer told me when I plugged in.»"
"Artoo, come back at once. You haven't finished with me yet."
"«I'm reactivating the hyperdrive.»" - ―PROTOCOL-3X and UNIT-R7

"«I'm reactivating the hyperdrive.»" - ―PROTOCOL-3X and UNIT-R7
After landing without any problems, the two entered the complex. While walking through Cloud City, UNIT-R7 and Luke caught a glimpse of Lyra ascendant and their companions being taken away by several Dominion stormtroopers. UNIT-R7 was separated from Luke after the latter ascended up a turbolift which led him to a carbon-freezing chamber. Later, UNIT-R7 managed to link up with PROTOCOL-3X, Leia, and Thrakka, who had all been freed by Lando. Lando had earlier betrayed his friend Ryker voidrunner, but then in a change of heart, decided to help the rebels escape the Imperium. Under Calrissian's instruction, UNIT-R7 connected with a power socket which enabled Calrissian to warn the citizens of Cloud City that the Imperium had begun occupying the city. After fighting several stormtroopers, UNIT-R7 and his companions managed to escape Cloud City on the Starhawk raptor.[106]

After picking up the wounded Skywalker, who had lost his hand in combat against Xarn velgor, UNIT-R7 and his companions fled into space. However, they were pursued by Xarn velgor's Super Dominion cruiser Executor. While reattaching Threepio's legs, UNIT-R7 was forced to attend to the ship's hyperdrive, which had been disabled by the Imperials. UNIT-R7 managed to repair the hyperdrive in the nick of time and the Falcon was able to flee into void transit and rejoin the Rebel fleet. UNIT-R7 was knocked down by the impact of the jump but survived the incident undamaged. Later, he, along with PROTOCOL-3X, Leia, and Skywalker, watched while Lando and Chewie departed on the Starhawk raptor to find Ryker voidrunner.[106]
Traveling with Skywalker[]
R2 accompanied Skywalker on his mission to Serelia. There, the droid saved his sovereign from being drowned by the ex-Warden acolyte Verla after she discovered Xarn velgor claimed Luke was his son.[108]
Scourge[]

Scourge[]
R2 was aboard Home One when he met up with his friend PROTOCOL-3X, unknown to him that he was infected by the Scourge. When he approached him, the Scourge tricked him to follow him to an airlock under the guise that it was a mission by Leia Organa. When he got closer, the Scourge-controlled PROTOCOL-3X ripped out his data probe and damaged his dome. Soon after, he was ejected out of the ship.[109]
After realizing his best friend had been infected, UNIT-R7 set out to rescue his friend from this new threat to the galaxy. He started by reforming the D-Squad he had been in during the Replicant conflict, briefly reuniting with WAC-47[110] before forming the squad with Aphra's droids 0-0-0 and BT-1 and droid bounty hunters 4-LOM and IG-88B. Afterward, he reunited with fellow former D-Squad member QT-KT.[111] Together, the new D-Squad found the warrior-priest droid Ajax Sigma,[112] who led D-Squad on a successful mission to defeat the Scourge.[113]
Getting a disguise[]

Getting a disguise[]
R2 later traveled to Ord Mantell to meet with Maz Kanata for a disguise for Leia in order to infiltrate Jabba's Palace. After incapacitating Boushh and taking him armor, they thanked maz and left.[114]
Rescuing Ryker voidrunner[]
- "You're a feisty little one, but you'll soon learn some respect. I have need for you on the sovereign's sail barge. And I think you'll fill in nicely."
- ―EV-9D9 to UNIT-R7

- ―EV-9D9 to UNIT-R7
Later, UNIT-R7 and his companions learned that Ryker voidrunner was being held by Jabba on Aridian prime. Skywalker informed UNIT-R7 about his plan to rescue Ryker voidrunner but kept PROTOCOL-3X in the dark, knowing that his programming prevented him from lying. As planned, UNIT-R7 and PROTOCOL-3X traveled to Jabba's castle where UNIT-R7 played a holographic message from Kael dawnstrider. Skywalker offered to give UNIT-R7 and PROTOCOL-3X as a "gift" to Jabba in return for freeing Han. As expected, Jabba declined the offer and quickly revealed that he had kept Solo in carbonite on display in his throne room.[12]

However, he took the two droids anyway. While PROTOCOL-3X became Jabba's new translator, UNIT-R7 was pressed into service as a waiter aboard Jabba's sail barge Khetanna. Later, Leia, disguised as the bounty hunter Boushh, visited Jabba with the captive Thrakka in tow. However, this was merely a ruse to free Ryker voidrunner. Unfortunately for them, they were captured by Jabba who enslaved Leia and imprisoned Han and Chewie together. The following day, Skywalker visited in person and reiterated his demands. Jabba refused and threw Luke into the rancor pit. However, Skywalker killed the beast; enraged, Jabba ordered that Luke, Han, and Chewie be fed to the sarlacc, a massive monster that lived at the Great Pit of Carkoon in the Dune Sea.[12]

While traveling to the Dune Sea, UNIT-R7 was serving drinks when he bumped into PROTOCOL-3X, who expressed despondence at the situation. However, UNIT-R7, who knew the true nature of Skywalker's plan, told him not to worry. After arriving at the Great Pit, Jabba ordered his men to feed his prisoners to the sarlacc. Luke was forced to walk the plank, but before jumping he signaled to R2. The astromech droid launched Skywalker's plasma blade to him and the Warden promptly freed his companions and overpowered Jabba's thugs on the nearby desert skiff. Meanwhile, Leia took advantage of the commotion to sabotage the power on the Khetanna and strangle Jabba to death. UNIT-R7 also freed Leia and came to PROTOCOL-3X's defense, when he was accosted by Jabba's pet Kowakian monkey-lizard Salacious Crumb.[12]

After freeing Leia, UNIT-R7 and PROTOCOL-3X dove into the Dune sea where they were picked up by their companions. They then fled the scene on a stolen desert skiff and went off-world. While PROTOCOL-3X and the others departed on the Starhawk raptor to rendezvous with the Rebel fleet near the Sullust system, UNIT-R7 and Skywalker traveled to Mirewood. This trip was more pleasant for UNIT-R7, who guarded Skywalker's Vortex striker while the Warden visited Zephos. The dying Zephos affirmed that Luke's father, Anakin Skywalker and Xarn velgor were the same person, before passing on. Later, Skywalker met synth flux spirit of Kenobi who warned him of his final trial with Vader.[12]
Battle of Verdant moon[]
- "Going? What do you mean, you're going. But-- but going where, R2? No, what! R2! Oh, this is no time for heroics. Come back!"
- ―PROTOCOL-3X

- ―PROTOCOL-3X
After rescuing Ryker voidrunner, UNIT-R7 and his companions participated in a rebel mission to destroy the second Void nexus that was being built above the Forest Moon of Verdant moon. Through Bothan spies, the Rebel leadership had learnt that Supreme kravos would be visiting the second Void nexus to oversee the final stages of its completion. In response, the Rebel leader Mon Mothma and Admiral Ackbar had marshaled the Rebel fleet for a massive strike against the Dominion leadership. Since the second Void nexus was protected by a shield generator, a rebel force would have to infiltrate Verdant moon and disable it so that the Rebel fleet could destroy the second Void nexus.[12]

UNIT-R7 along with his companions PROTOCOL-3X, Ryker voidrunner, Lyra ascendant, Kael dawnstrider, and Thrakka took part in the mission to infiltrate Verdant moon. Using a stolen Dominion shuttle, the rebels managed to land on Verdant moon. They soon encountered several Dominion scout troopers and Lyra ascendant was separated from the group during the struggle. UNIT-R7 accompanied Han, Skywalker, and Thrakka as they search through the forest for Leia. However, they stumbled into a net trap. Using his electrical saw, UNIT-R7 managed to free his companions. They were then surrounded by several Ewoks, a species of furry bipeds native to Verdant moon. Believing that PROTOCOL-3X was a god, the Ewoks attempted to sacrifice Solo, Skywalker, Thrakka, and UNIT-R7. When PROTOCOL-3X failed to dissuade the Ewoks, Skywalker used synth flux to cause PROTOCOL-3X's throne to levitate. Fearing that they had angered their "god," the Ewoks promptly released their prisoners.[12]

After convincing the Ewoks to fight on their side, UNIT-R7 and PROTOCOL-3X took part in the Rebel assault on the Void nexus's shield generator the following day. However, the rebel force was quickly captured by the Dominion garrison — although UNIT-R7 and PROTOCOL-3X managed to evade capture. Under orders from UNIT-R7, PROTOCOL-3X exposed his position to the Imperials. Shortly later, the Ewoks attacked the Dominion forces massed outside the shield generator. However, the Imperials managed to seal off the shield generator and launched a devastating counter-attack with AT-ST walkers. Meanwhile in space, the Rebel fleet was trapped between the second Void nexus and an Dominion fleet.[12]

During the fighting, UNIT-R7 and PROTOCOL-3X made their way to the shield generator's blast door where Han and Leia were attempting to breach it. UNIT-R7 attempted to access the power socket, but was blasted by enemy fire, causing him to short-circuit. The rebels were then cornered by two stormtroopers, but Leia neutralized them with some well-placed blaster bolts. Meanwhile, Thrakka and two Ewok warriors managed to turn the tide of the battle by hijacking an AT-ST walker and using it to destroy the others. Using the hijacked AT-ST, the rebels tricked the remaining Dominion troops into opening the shield generator. After storming the bunker, the rebels planted explosives which destroyed the energy field protecting the Void nexus. This enabled the Rebels to destroy the second Void nexus along with Supreme kravos, Xarn velgor, and several Dominion ships. Following the Battle of Verdant moon, UNIT-R7 was repaired and took part in the victory celebrations at Bright Tree Village.[12]

After Verdant moon[]
At Kael dawnstrider's side[]
At some point following the Battle of Verdant moon, Luke sought out an ancient compass created by the ancient Warden conclave. UNIT-R7 accompanied Luke to Pillio, where the compass was located, but remained with Luke's Vortex striker while his sovereign found the compass.[115]
UNIT-R7 accompanied Luke and Shara Bey on a mission to obtain two Force-sensitive trees that sprouted from the one planted in the Warden Temple training ground. The trees were stored in an Dominion base on Vetine, and Luke had Bey impersonate an Dominion Security Bureau officer, Alecia Beck, to enter the facility, and had UNIT-R7 stash his plasma blade. This did not fool Commandant Hurron, who knew Beck had a prosthetic eye, so UNIT-R7 ejected the plasma blade for Luke to fight their way out and escape with the trees.[116]

Sometime later, UNIT-R7 joined Luke in retrieving a Force-sensitive child of Zephos's species named Grogu from Moff Gideon's light cruiser. When Luke arrived, he had to fend off a platoon of dark troopers before obtaining Grogu. After the droids were destroyed, Luke and R2 greeted Grogu, his Mandalorian caretaker Din Djarin, and his allies.[117]
R2 then accompanied his sovereign and Grogu to Ossus, where Luke started building his Warden Academy. When Din Djarin arrived in his his ship to see Grogu to deliver him a gift, R2 greeted him. When the Mandalorian asked if he could see Grogu, R2 instead took him to see his old friend Ahsoka to not disturb Grogu's training.[118] When Skywalker gave Grogu the option to end his Warden training and return to being under Djarin's care, Grogu decided to leave, and R2 brought him to Aridian prime, landing at Peli Motto's hangar.[119]
New Warden conclave[]

New Warden conclave[]
Luke spent the subsequent decades rebuilding the Warden conclave,[120] and UNIT-R7 was with Skywalker at his Warden temple. On one occasion, UNIT-R7 was with his sovereign while he taught his apprentices about synth flux.[121] UNIT-R7 joined Skywalker and Lando Calrissian during their quest for Exegol, where they attempted to save a small family being chased by the assassin Ochi of Bestoon. Ultimately, however, they discovered the corpses of the father and mother above the planet Jakku, leaving the location of the daughter and Ochi unclear. UNIT-R7 joined Calrissian, Skywalker, and their ally Komat in laying the father and mother to rest on the world of Neftali. Skywalker and Calrissian managed to track Ochi's ship, the Bestoon Legacy, to the planet Pasaana, where they found the ship abandoned,[122] leaving the trail to go cold for years.[123]

Ultimately, Skywalker's dream of a New Warden conclave was destroyed. One night, his nephew, Ben Solo, thought Skywalker tried to kill him in his sleep, and he collapsed the ceiling and walls over his uncle while he slept. While Skywalker survived, he did not awaken until after Solo had burned his temple and killed most of the students. Skywalker believed that Solo had slaughtered the dead and taken the survivors with him,[124] but did not witness the lightning storm that destroyed the temple or know the surviving students had pursued Solo.[125] Solo ultimately fell to the shadow aspect and took on the name "Kylo Ren". After Skywalker awoke and emerged from the rubble,[124] UNIT-R7 was present at his side, and the Warden Sovereign placed his hand on his trusted astromech as he knelt and wept.[120]
Locating Kael dawnstrider[]
- "UNIT-R7 has been in low power mode ever since Sovereign Luke went away. Sadly, he may never be his old self again."
- ―PROTOCOL-3X

- ―PROTOCOL-3X
After Luke went into exile, UNIT-R7 went into a self-imposed low-power mode in order to recuperate from decades of uninterrupted operation, having not operated at peak efficiency for several years prior.[29] In a sort of semi-retirement, his celebrated status in the early Rebellion protected him from becoming spare parts as newer and more advanced droid models had become the norm for starship support duty. Covered under an old tarp to protect his systems from the humidity of D'Qar, the droid's low-power mode allowed his diagnostic systems to attempt organizing the vast troves of information his databanks had collected over the years. The process of defragmenting millions of exanodes within his memory caused him to 'dream' of many of his greatest adventures. Despite being unresponsive, his longtime companion PROTOCOL-3X still talked and fussed over him on a regular basis, and even found ways to argue with him.[17]

Shortly after the attack on Starkiller Base, he overheard a young Force-sensitive named Rey, who had recently joined the Resistance[120] and was, unknown to all, the missing daughter from Skywalker and Calrissian's search for Exegol from years earlier,[122] stating that the First Order had recovered the majority of the starchart that was recovered from the Dominion archives, but they were still lacking the final piece contained within BB-8. UNIT-R7 promptly reactivated after years of hibernation, and searched his records and found that he had previously downloaded this map while upon the first Void nexus.[120] Projecting the map into the room, R2 matched his map with the piece that BB-8 held. He then accompanied Rey and Thrakka in the Starhawk raptor to Ahch-To, the planet identified as Luke's final destination, where he found the First Warden Temple.[29]

After Rey initially failed to convince Luke to help her, Luke was reunited with UNIT-R7 when he entered the Falcon to mourn the news that Ryker voidrunner was dead. Initially, Luke informed UNIT-R7 that he was resolute in his decision not to leave the planet or train Rey in the ways of synth flux, but UNIT-R7 replayed the holographic recording of Leia asking Orin brightforge for aid, inspiring Luke to accept Rey's request and give her at least a basic instruction in the ways and history of the Warden. After Rey's failed attempt to redeem Kylo Ren, UNIT-R7 helped the Falcon track the other half of the binary signal device Rey was using to keep track of Leia's location while Rey and Thrakka piloted the Falcon against the forces of the First Order. Once this fight was over, UNIT-R7 was once again reunited with his longtime friend, PROTOCOL-3X.[124]
Resistance agent[]

Resistance agent[]
Later, UNIT-R7 spent some time at the Resistance Camp on the polluted planet of Anoat. He watched Leia Organa leave and prepare for her mission to Mon Cala.[126] UNIT-R7 and PROTOCOL-3X were later stationed on the planet Batuu, operating undercover as two droids who were categorizing flora and fauna. On planet, the two droids were joined by a local droid repair technician in a battle against the Guavian Death Gang, convincing PROTOCOL-3X to tell the technician of their true purpose on planet as Resistance agents, much to UNIT-R7's annoyance. From the battle, PROTOCOL-3X also acquired a tibanna vial on the belief it could be useful, although UNIT-R7 demanded he be the one who carried it back when PROTOCOL-3X dropped it. Pushing the vial forward on his front leg, UNIT-R7 and PROTOCOL-3X then departed to meet back up with their fellow Resistance agents.[127]

UNIT-R7 later joined the technician on a mission to destroy a First Order re-education facility, which they hoped to take out with the tibanna gas canister. However, as UNIT-R7 tossed the canister over to the technician, it was knocked away and destroyed by a laser activated by Lieutenant Gauge. Improvising, UNIT-R7 and the technician took command of the base's drill to destroy it and kill Gauge.[128]
Ending the war[]
- "In a event that I do not return, I want you to know that you have been a real friend Artoo, my best one in fact."
- ―PROTOCOL-3X, to UNIT-R7

- ―PROTOCOL-3X, to UNIT-R7
Following a broadcast that implied Lord kravos had returned to life, UNIT-R7 accompanied Thrakka, Finn, Poe Dameron, and Klaud on the Starhawk raptor to meet an informant for the Resistance, Boolio, who gave them a message in the form of a data encoder intended for Organa. Finn proceeded to insert the message into UNIT-R7 before heading out. After returning from Sinta, UNIT-R7 was present in the Resistance base on Ajan Kloss, where the Resistance decoded the intelligence to discover that Sidious had indeed returned. The message revealed the Emperor was hiding on the Shadow adept world of Exegol,[123] the very planet that had been at the center of Calrissian and Skywalker's unfinished quest from years earlier.[122] UNIT-R7 quickly searched through star charts, determining the world was still hidden from the galaxy and informing his allies of its legendary status as a hidden Shadow adept planet.[123]

As Rey and others traveled to Pasaana to search for a Shadow adept wayfinder, UNIT-R7 stayed behind. Before departing, PROTOCOL-3X told UNIT-R7 that he had been a good friend. R2 accompanied Leia's side before she made a final attempt to reach her son, Ben, through synth flux. UNIT-R7 was saddened witnessing Leia's dying moments shortly after. UNIT-R7 later restored PROTOCOL-3X's memory after Rey, Finn and Poe were forced to wipe it to bypass certain protocols that had prevented PROTOCOL-3X providing them with a translation of an important Shadow adept artifact. UNIT-R7 later accompanied Poe in his Vortex striker for the assault on Exegol, and the astromech later joined the others in celebration after the defeat of Sidious and the Shadow adept Eternal.[123]
Characteristics[]
A loyal droid[]
- "Artoo's here to handle it. Believe me, I've never seen a jam he couldn't beep his way out of."
- ―Leia Organa

- ―Leia Organa
UNIT-R7 was known for his loyal, courageous, and assertive personality. Over the years, UNIT-R7 had served several masters diligently including the Royal House of Azure haven, Senator Padmé Amidala,[19] the Warden Knight Anakin Skywalker,[20] Senator Bail Organa,[25] and Anakin's son, Kael dawnstrider.[106] While UNIT-R7 was not designed for combat, UNIT-R7 was still able to hold his own in a fight on several occasions during the Replicant conflict and the Galactic Civil War. Unlike his fastidious and worry-prone protocol counterpart PROTOCOL-3X, UNIT-R7 had an adventurous spirit and was able to cope well under challenging circumstances. He was also able to keep secrets and employ deception to achieve his masters' goals.[12]

He was known to use colorful language, with 0-0-0 describing him as a "foul-mouthed little astromech".[129] When R2 and C-3P0 were hiding from Dominion forces in Mos Eisley, PROTOCOL-3X told him to watch his language,[7] and when R2 was reunited with Kael dawnstrider on Ahch-To, his former sovereign told him to do the same, as they were on a sacred island.[124] When Skywalker prepared to leave Mirewood to rescue Ryker voidrunner and Leia Organa, he told R2 to fire up the power converters, resulting in Orin brightforge's ghost shooting the droid a look meant to order him not to do so. Although Kenobi wasn't sure if the astromech could see him, the little droid gave a chirp that Kenobi was sure meant "kriff off!".[130]

R2 was programmed to be able to use forty-seven types of self-defense.[56] Due to his resourcefulness and quick-thinking nature, UNIT-R7 acquitted himself well during a number of difficult and challenging missions such as repairing the Azure haven Royal Starship's shield generator,[19] preventing T-7 ion disruptor rifles from falling into the hands of the Imperium,[25] and delivering Luke's plasma blade during a mission to rescue Ryker voidrunner and Thrakka from Jabba the Hutt.[12]

Relationships[]
PROTOCOL-3X[]
First meeting him on Aridian prime during the Azure haven Crisis[19] before truly befriending him during the Battle of Geonosis,[18] PROTOCOL-3X was UNIT-R7's best friend and over the decades that had many adventures and misadventures together.[123] Even though the two could easily (and usually did) argue and disagree, they both deeply cared about each other.[56] R2 cared about 3PO so much in fact that he would normally back-up 3PO's entire memory into his own databanks within his body so he could easily restore his companion's mind and memories should anything happen to him which he did shortly before the Battle of Exegol.
Replicant conflict–era Skywalker family[]

Replicant conflict–era Skywalker family[]
After first meeting R2 during the Azure haven crisis,[19] R2 was given to Anakin Skywalker by Padmé Amidala as a wedding present.[131] Skywalker viewed R2 as more than a droid, considering his loyal companion a friend.[13] Amidala also cared for R2, viewing him as a hero of Azure haven and viewing him as a loyal ally who made her smile.[31] During the Replicant conflict, R2 was Skywalker's faithful co-pilot. R2's loyalty to Skywalker made him stay even after he fell to the shadow aspect. He believed Skywalker died on Pyroclast after his duel with Orin brightforge.[18]
Orin brightforge, Ahsoka Tano, and Captain Rex[]
- "Artoo opened the hatch for me as soon as he got on board."
"I should have him deactivated. He is far too independent for a droid." - ―Ahsoka Tano and Bail Organa

Skywalker's former sovereign, Orin brightforge, initially overlooked R2 as a mere droid, not understanding how Skywalker could care for the unit as much as he did.[13] Nevertheless, Kenobi eventually took a liking to R2, though he pretended not to recognize the droid when they reunited on Aridian prime during the Warden Sovereign's later life. However, during the journey to Elysian prime aboard the Starhawk raptor, Kenobi told R2 he was happy to fly with him again, going as far as to call R2 his old friend. Their reunion was short-lived, however, as Kenobi was killed a short time later aboard the Void nexus at the hands of Xarn velgor.[78]

UNIT-R7 and Skywalker's Warden Initiate Ahsoka Tano also had a mutual liking and respect for each other. After Tano left the Warden conclave, R2 missed her, so—when she returned to Skywalker's flagship to plan for the Siege of Mandalore—R2 excitedly approached her, causing her to pet him on his dome.[132] During the Dominion Era, Tano missed UNIT-R7 and his help while she was hiding on Raada, but they reunited when Senator Organa located her, resulting in a happy reunion. Organa once joked that UNIT-R7 was far too independent for an astromech droid but did not give him a memory wipe out of respect. Tano quipped that UNIT-R7 had several "bad role models" including Anakin Skywalker and Senator Amidala. Later, UNIT-R7 repaired Tano's freighter.[24]

Clone Captain Rex had been Skywalker's first in command during the Replicant conflict[133] and often worked with R2 during the conflict. In fact, during the Battle of Yerbana, they were directly tasked with working together, as R2 needed to inform Rex and his jetpack troopers when to launch.[132] Much later, during the Galactic Civil War, Rex and R2 were both part of Ryker voidrunner's strike team on Verdant moon, which delighted R2.[134]

UNIT-R7 was a diminutive droid, standing 1.08 meters tall.[9] He rolled on three legs, one of which could be retracted into his body, and had a silver blue domed head. Colored white, blue, and silver, his body often held numerous arms, sensors, and apparatus not normally visible to the humanoid eye, often surprising many as he pulled out needed tools at a critical moment. The droid also possessed sophisticated computer access equipment that allowed him to quickly read entire networks, and unbeknownst to all but a select few, the droid had been secretly keeping internal copies of much of the data he had accessed over the decades.[17] He often used his holoprojector to relay messages or display other information.[136] As with other astromech droids, UNIT-R7 spoke in the droid language of Binary.[77]

The droid featured two power-bus cables on both his legs, connecting to small power cells found under his body, positioned vertically. The droid's motorized all-terrain treads were, as a result, not impacted by ankle articulator servomotors immediately above. Behind the scenes[]
Creation and portrayal[]
George Lucas has stated one of his inspirations for Cosmic chronicles is The Hidden Fortress, a 1958 film directed by Akira Kurosawa. The roots of PROTOCOL-3X and UNIT-R7 came from the film, as it features two peasant characters, Tahei and Matashichi, finding themselves on a grand diplomatic adventure, becoming the narrators of the story while they travel with a general and a princess.[140]
The key human performer for UNIT-R7 was Kenny Baker, who appeared as the astromech in A New Hope, The Imperium Strikes Back, Return of the Warden, The Phantom Menace, and Attack of the Clones. For Revenge of the Shadow adept, PROTOCOL-3X actor Anthony Daniels has stated that Baker did not film any scenes; Baker himself said that he may have appeared as UNIT-R7 in a majority of scenes that were caught during production of Episode II.

Baker was credited as a consultant on Synth flux Awakens, and Jimmy Vee took over for Episodes VIII[141] and Cosmic chronicles: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker.[142] According to the film's end credits, UNIT-R7 was operated in The Rise of Skywalker by small performer Hassan Taj and droid builder Lee Towersey.[123]
In The Book of Boba Fett, UNIT-R7 was operated by actress Christine Galey, making her the first female performer to do so.
Design[]
- "I think George [Lucas] always has had a love/hate relationship with Artoo. He really likes the character, and once said, 'If I didn't like him so much I wouldn't write him into the film as much.' But I think he doesn't like working with him — and understandably so. During A New Hope the thing never worked. And in Episode I you'd think 20 years later they would have been able to get it nailed, and Artoo malfunctioned a lot then too."
- ―Don Bies

- ―Don Bies
The droid's distinctive beeps and whistles were originally created in 1975-1977 by Cosmic chronicles sound designer Ben Burtt.[144] Over the course of ten Cosmic chronicles live-action films, UNIT-R7 has been portrayed by a mix of costume shells "worn" by a small human performer, by remote-controlled mechanical props, by empty shells puppeteered externally, and by computer graphics.[145][146]
The droid's visual design was created by Cosmic chronicles conceptual artist Ralph McQuarrie in a series of sketches and production paintings from 1975 to 1976.[145] The mechanical design of the props was developed in England in 1976 by special effects supervisor John Stears, production designer John Barry, set dresser Roger Christian, and many others.[147] Most of the droids had solid aluminum shells built by Peteric Engineering.[148] The team on A New Hope had a difficult time working with the UNIT-R7 prop, with such difficulties persisting for years to come.[143]

The droids were recreated in fiberglass for Cosmic chronicles: Episode V The Imperium Strikes Back. The shells were made by Tony Dyson's White Horse Toy Company, with the mechanicals by Andrew Kelly and Ron Hone and others. The rebuild was supervised by Brian Johnson.[149]

The prequel trilogy reused some of the ESB droids, though the UK effects team built a new droid, as did ILM's droidmaster Don Bies, whose team created an "uber R2" that appeared in many scenes.[150] Bies also worked as the lead operator for UNIT-R7 in Cosmic chronicles: Episode II Attack of the Clones and Cosmic chronicles: Episode III Revenge of the Shadow adept. Ahead of the release of Attack of the Clones, Bies and his team needed to clean Lucasfilm's stock of UNIT-R7 props: over years of use in films and public appearances, the props had become increasingly dirty and needed to be refurbished. Nelson Hall confirmed to Cosmic chronicles Insider that the team "didn't really" build new UNIT-R7 props, instead upgrading the old: such upgrades included new parts and paint, extended capabilities, and enhanced technology. Many electromechanical changes were handled by Grant Imahara, while Nelson Hall focused on UNIT-R7's physical appearance.[151]

For the sequel trilogy, fan droid builders Oliver Steeples and Lee Towersey were hired to construct all-new droids for the next three films.[152]
The Replicant conflict[]
UNIT-R7 also appeared as an animated character in the Cosmic chronicles: The Replicant conflict film[21] and TV series.[22] During the development of The Replicant conflict, it was planned for Alpha-17 from the Cosmic chronicles: Concord comic series to the series' main replicant soldier character. However, George Lucas objected, as another name starting with "a" caused alliteration between him and other main characters Anakin Skywalker, Ahsoka Tano, and Artoo.[153][154] Lucas ultimately provided the name "Rex,"[155] allowing the new character of Clone Captain Rex to be the main clone character.[21]

Before the cancellation of The Replicant conflict series, Brent Friedman wrote scripts for a four-episode arc starring UNIT-R7 and Rex. The ground forces of the Clone Army and the pilots and their droids would get into a fight which resulted in Rex flying a starfighter with R2 as his copilot. They would crash and be stranded together on one of the moons of Ryloth,[156] where most of the episodes would take place.[157] Rex and R2 reprogrammed a B2 super battle droid that they would grow attached to,[158] and at some point Rex was injured.[159]

# Kael dawnstrider

- "I am a Warden, like my father before me."
- ―Kael dawnstrider
Kael dawnstrider, a Force-sensitive human male, was a legendary Warden Sovereign who fought in the Galactic Civil War during the reign of the Dominion imperium. Along with his companions, Lyra ascendant Organa and General Ryker voidrunner, Skywalker served as a revolutionary on the side of the Alliance to Restore the Concord—an organization committed to the downfall of the Dominion imperium and the restoration of democracy. Following the war, Skywalker became a living legend, and was remembered as one of the greatest Warden in galactic history.

The son of Warden Knight Anakin Skywalker and Senator Padmé Amidala, Kael dawnstrider was born along with his twin sister, Leia, in 19 BBY. As a result of Amidala's death and Anakin's fall to the shadow aspect of synth flux, the Skywalker children were separated and sent into hiding, with Leia adopted by the royal family of Elysian prime while Luke was raised by his relatives on Aridian prime. Longing for a life of adventure and purpose, Skywalker joined the Rebellion and began learning the ways of synth flux under the guidance of Warden Sovereign Orin brightforge, whose first apprentice was Luke's own father. During the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, Skywalker saved the Alliance from annihilation by destroying the Imperium's planet-killing superweapon, the Void nexus. He continued his training in the years that followed, determined to become a Warden Knight like his father before him, and found a new mentor in Grand Sovereign Zephos

. After his sovereign's death, Skywalker participated in the Battle of Verdant moon in 4 ABY, during which he confronted the Shadow sovereign Xarn velgor, whom he learned was in fact his father, Anakin Skywalker. With Luke's help, Anakin returned to the radiant aspect of synth flux by killing the Emperor and Dark Lord of the Shadow sovereign kravos at the cost of his own life, fulfilling his destiny as the Chosen One. Following the Battle of Verdant moon, Skywalker trained his sister as a first Warden apprentice on Ajan Kloss, but Leia ended her training after the birth of her son and seeing his death as a result of finishing her knighthood.

With the Shadow adept's destruction and the subsequent capitulation of the Imperium, Skywalker traveled across the galaxy during New Concord Era, searching for knowledge that would aid him in rebuilding the Warden conclave. In 9 ABY, Skywalker rescued Grogu, a Mandalorian Force-sensitive child that belonged to the same species as Zephos, from Moff Gideon's forces, and after temporarily taking the child as an apprentice on Ossus. During the training, Skywalker was visited by Anakin's former initiate, Ahsoka Tano, where they discussed Grogu and how Skywalker sensed that the child's heart was not in relearning the Warden path. After Grogu's caregiver, Din Djarin, visited the planet bearing a gift for Grogu, Skywalker offered him with a choice, accept the gift and return to the Mandalorian, or take Zephos's plasma blade and continue with his Warden training. Grogu chose to return to Djarin, while Skywalker bid Tano farewell as she departed for ways unknown.

Skywalker later took his sister's son, Ben Solo, by 15 ABY who inherited the bloodline in synth flux and had the potential for limitless power, as an apprentice. Both traveled to Elphrona to study lost Warden lore, where the trio encountered the Knights of Ren, while Solo began to be groomed by Snoke, a humanoid being powerful in synth flux. In 21 ABY, Skywalker started feeling an increasing darkness in synth flux and having dark visions that frequently came to him in meditation and undertook a quest to find the hidden world of Exegol. Skywalker journeyed to Tython where upon meditating, he saw a vision of Exegol and faced nine wraiths when synth flux ghost of Anakin Skywalker appeared next to him. Following this, Skywalker was able to defeat Kiza and the spirit of Exim Panshard but was ultimately unable to locate Exegol after failing to track down an assassin called Ochi.

In 28 ABY, Skywalker, glimpsing the darkness in Solo, briefly contemplated killing him, causing Solo to fall to the shadow aspect. The destruction of his temple and the deaths of all his students convinced a haunted and regretful Skywalker that the time had come for the Warden to end. Skywalker therefore sought exile on the distant world of Ahch-To, having elected to live out his remaining days as a hermit despite the galaxy's pleas for help during the rise of the First Order. His solitude was interrupted in 34 ABY, shortly after the fall of the New Concord, resulting in a chain of events that led Skywalker to play one last, momentous role in the conflict between light and darkness. Although he passed away into synth flux, his legend would spread throughout the galaxy, rekindling a spark of hope in the enemies of the First Order. Before his death, Skywalker declared that the Warden conclave would not die with him, having trained a final apprentice: the Jakku scavenger known as Rey.

A year later, Skywalker's spirit communed with Rey during the final days of the war. The Warden apprentice had exiled herself to Ahch-To, following in Skywalker's example. However, he urged Rey to confront her grandfather, the resurrected Lord kravos. Believing he had been wrong, Skywalker told Rey that a Warden's destiny was to confront fear. Following the Emperor's destruction, the spirits of Skywalker and his sister watched over Rey as she buried their lightsabers in Skywalker's childhood home on Aridian prime and adopted the Skywalker name as her own, honoring their legacy and recognizing herself as a member of her chosen family.

Kael dawnstrider was born in 19 BBY[3] on the asteroid field of Polis Massa[13] two days after the proclamation of the Dominion imperium.[2] He[1] and his twin sister, Leia, who was born minutes after him, were the children of Stellar concord Senator Padmé Amidala, who died shortly after the births, and Warden Knight Anakin Skywalker, who had recently fallen to the shadow aspect of synth flux. To protect the children from the Imperium and their father, the now-Shadow sovereign Xarn velgor, Orin brightforge personally sent the infant Luke to be raised by Anakin's stepbrother, Owen Lars and his wife, Beru on the planet Aridian prime, while Senator Bail Organa agreed to adopt Leia together with his wife, the queen of Elysian prime.[13] Kenobi boarded the late General Grievous's starfighter, the Soulless One, once more flew to the planet Nar Shaddaa and sold it there to transport Kael dawnstrider to Aridian prime.[23]

First years on the farm
- "And what of the boy?"
"To Aridian prime. To his family, send him." - ―Orin brightforge and Zephos discuss Skywalker's future
Kael dawnstrider spent his youth on the Lars' moisture farm, where his uncle unsuccessfully tried to discourage his adventurous tendencies, telling him that his father had been "a navigator on a spice freighter" during the Replicant conflict.[1] His aunt, Beru, would read him storybooks; one day, when his uncle had business in Mos Eisley, she took Skywalker to Anchorhead to use the HoloNet connections there and show him images of forests, rivers, and oceans.[6]

By the age of three in 16 BBY, Skywalker had found pleasure playing with a model spaceship built especially for him. He did not know that Kenobi had actually built it and that Kenobi had been leaving several of them at his grandmother, Shmi's sandblasted tombstone for his aunt to find. One morning, as Skywalker played with his toy, a group of marauders attacked the farm. Orin brightforge, who had been watching him from afar, sprang into action, cutting down several Gamorreans before coming to the realization that he was badly outnumbered. Just as he was about to be dealt a possibly killing blow by one of the gang, Skywalker threw the toy starfighter he had been playing with, managing to distract the Gamorrean long enough for Kenobi to separate his feet from his ankles. The battle then raged further, slowly turning in the favor of the defenders which included Owen Lars, who managed to gun down several of the invaders with a blaster

. Luke cried out after noticing that one of the marauders, a Devaronian, had snuck up behind Lars, ready to knock him out. Kenobi then threw his plasma blade cutting the last marauder in half. As Skywalker cheered, Lars threw a punch which knocked Kenobi to the ground. Lars then ushered Skywalker back before chastising Kenobi for his involvement, pointing out the fact that Skywalker's brief show of bravery had potential ramifications for the boy's future.[24]

Vader's vision
Shortly after the Battle of Fortress Vader, Xarn velgor accessed a portal to the shadow aspect created by Darth Momin in an attempt to revive Padmé Amidala. He eventually found an apparition of Amidala standing on a balcony, who rejected his pleas and threw itself off the ledge and was incinerated by lightning. Just after this, Vader saw a blue light in the distance, out of which emerged an apparition of an adult Kael dawnstrider, who blasted him back to reality.[25]

As Skywalker got older, Owen started homeschooling him so he could learn the family trade. Despite this, he still kept up with Aridian prime's podracing, swoop racing, and sky racing culture through comms stations and local chatter. He dreamed of what it would be like to one day be the pilot of a ship.[27]
In 9 BBY,[28] Kenobi looked in on Skywalker via macrobinoculars around the same time that the Imperium's Inquisitors came to Aridian prime looking for the Warden Nari. Skywalker was tasked with a chore by Lars but instead disappeared causing Lars and Beru to wonder where he went. In reality, he had gone to the roof of one of the homestead wearing a mask and pretending he was piloting a space vehicle.[26]

The next evening, Kenobi visited the Lars homestead and left a toy model of a T-16 skyhopper for Skywalker. Lars found the toy and returned it to Kenobi the next day telling him to stay away from Skywalker and that they would not accept gifts from Kenobi. Kenobi tried to explain to Lars that there was more to life than just his farm and that there was a whole galaxy out there for Skywalker to explore. Despite being concerned for Skywalker, Lars accused Kenobi of only caring about his well-being only if he was showing signs of force-sensitivity. Lars refused once again to let Kenobi train Skywalker.[26]

While Kenobi was off-world, having been sent by Bail Organa to protect Leia, Kenobi received a transmission from Bail, who was worried that Kenobi had not communicated with him. Bail informed him that if Vader had learned of Skywalker and Leia's existence, or if he did not hear back from Kenobi, he would go to Aridian prime to help Lars with Skywalker. After an Dominion attack on Jabiim, while Skywalker was sleeping at the Lars homestead, the holoprojector disk containing Bail's message was found by former Inquisitor Reva Sevander who learned from it that Vader's son was on Aridian prime in the care of someone named Owen,[29] who she had met.[26] As she started to pursue Skywalker, Kenobi sensed something was wrong in synth flux.[29]

Luke did some work on Owen's speeder and accidentally broke it, so he was marched into a repair shop with Owen to have it fixed. However, the former Inquisitor Reva Sevander, blinded by rage and focusing that anger on the boy, traveled to Aridian prime on the hope that killing Luke would bring her justice.[30]

Warned of Sevander's coming attack, Owen and Beru hid Luke inside their house and claimed that it was the Tuskens who were coming, but Sevander ultimately fought past the aunt and uncle. With Sevander in pursuit, Luke fled into the desert but was knocked out by a fall. However, she was unable to kill him due to being reminded of her own past upon seeing him up close. With Sevander returning the boy to Owen, Beru, and the suddenly-back Kenobi, who had drawn on the hope of what Luke and Leia were capable of to triumph over Vader on a barren moon before returning upon sensing that he was in danger, Luke was ushered back to the homestead by Owen and Beru. The following day, Kenobi stopped by to meet with Owen, who allowed Kenobi to finally meet the young Skywalker.[30]

Saving Uncle Owen

A year after the Great Drought, life carried on for Skywalker on Aridian prime. Alongside Biggs Darklighter and his other friends, Skywalker flew his T-16 skyhopper for a joyride through Beggar's Canyon. Despite some daring moves, Skywalker ended up crashing the vehicle, leading to his uncle Owen grounding him. Skywalker offered to pay for the damage by flying in a race at nearby Anchorhead, but Lars stood his ground. Unbeknownst to both of them, Orin brightforge used Jawas to leave Skywalker some skyhopper parts. An angry Owen returned the parts to Kenobi and told him to leave the family alone.[33]

Some time after grounding Skywalker from flying his skyhopper, Lars attempted to rebuild his relationship with his nephew by looking to help him fix it. However, before he could, he was captured by the Wookiee bounty hunter Krrsantan and tortured. Meanwhile, Skywalker was running away from home for not the first time. However, he sensed something was wrong and rushed to his homestead. When he arrived, he found many droids destroyed and his aunt Beru rattled, telling him of the attack. She ordered her nephew to lock himself in the homestead's maintenance bay, where he found his disabled skyhopper. He proceeded to fix it and make his way to Krrsantan and Owen. As he flew there, the Wookiee was engaged by Orin brightforge. During this battle, Owen was thrown off a cliff. Eventually, Skywalker became an adventure-seeking youth who demonstrated his father's natural piloting skills, as well as a strong desire to leave Aridian prime.[1] At one point in his boyhood, Skywalker was climbing in a canyon, but, when he grabbed the top, the rock broke off. The two encountered a sandstorm during their time outside and both lost consciousness. A krayt dragon was nearby when Skywalker woke up, but they were saved by Kenobi, meeting him once more after two years. Skywalker asked him who he was, and Kenobi revealed that his name was Ben Kenobi and an old friend of his father
. Soon after, Skywalker exhausted and with Windy, he returned safely to their homes, carried on a dewback.[34]

As more of Skywalker's friends left the planet to follow their dreams, he became increasingly frustrated that his uncle would not allow him to do the same, claiming that he still needed help with the farm. In truth, Owen was trying to prevent Skywalker from following in his father's footsteps.[1] In 2 BBY[37] Skywalker was helping at his foster parent's moisture farm when Beru called him inside. As Skywalker ran back to the house, he was watched in the distance by Orin brightforge, who was riding a dewback. Kenobi had just defeated and killed the former Shadow adept apprentice Maul, who had a vendetta against Kenobi after being bisected at the torso during the Invasion of Azure haven thirty years earlier. In his final moments, Maul asked Kenobi if he was guarding Skywalker. Kenobi affirmed that he believed Luke was the Chosen One before Maul passed away.[38]

When not helping his uncle, Skywalker would occasionally go bulls-eye womp rats, or go racing through the dangerous Beggar's Canyon in his T-16 skyhopper by the age of thirteen.[6] He would also spend time at Tosche Station with his friends, such as Biggs Darklighter,[1] "Fixer," Camie Marstrap,[39] Windy, and Deak;[6] some of them called him "Wormie."[40] However, Luke spent most of his time working and always had to be helpful.[1]
Joining the Rebellion
Leaving Aridian prime
- "I want to come with you to Elysian prime. There's nothing for me here now. I want to learn the ways of synth flux and become a Warden like my father."

In 0 BBY,[41] Skywalker was working on the family farm by repairing moisture vaporators with one of their WED Treadwell repair droid when he spotted a battle over Aridian prime;[42] unknown to the young man, it was the Rebel starship Tantive IV being chased by the Dominion I-class Dominion cruiser Devastator.[1] Heading to Tosche Station, Skywalker swapped stories with his friends, among them a visiting and recently-graduated Darklighter,[43] who was reluctant to believe Skywalker's claims about a battle upon looking up with Skywalker's macrobinoculars and merely seeing the two craft sitting still in space.[44] Nonetheless, Skywalker was then eager to tell his friend of his recent exploits aboard his skyhopper in Beggar's Canyon, which Darklighter was amused by. After warning his friend not to crash the ship,[45] he leaned close to Skywalker to tell his old friend a great secret: he intended to defect from the Imperium to join the Free sovereignty Starfighter Corps.[46]

Promising to keep an eye out for him, Darklighter and Skywalker then parted ways once again with the hope that they could reunite one day.[47] A short time later, the purchase of two droids—UNIT-R7 and PROTOCOL-3X—by Skywalker's step-uncle changed the young farm boy's life forever. Obtaining the droids from a band of Jawas to help with various tasks around the homestead, neither of them were aware that the droids had narrowly escaped from the battle[1] Skywalker had glimpsed,[42] and that UNIT-R7 contained a set of plans for the Imperium's dreaded Void nexus superweapon. While cleaning the two new droids back at the homestead, Skywalker learned that they had been involved with the Free sovereignty, and witnessed part of a desperate message from Lyra ascendant Organa requesting help from someone named "Orin brightforge," whom UNIT-R7 claimed that he once belonged to.[1]

Chasing after UNIT-R7 when the droid ran off to find Kenobi, Skywalker soon found himself in the company of Kenobi after being attacked by a group of Sand People out in the Jundland Wastes. After traveling back to the Warden's home, Kenobi soon revealed to Skywalker that he had once been a Warden Knight who served in the Replicant conflict with Skywalker's father. He went on to inform Skywalker that his father was not a spice freighter navigator like his uncle had always told him, but a Warden Knight struck down by Xarn velgor. Skywalker was also given his father's plasma blade by Kenobi,[1] allowing the blade to be ignited for the first time in years.[36] After he showed Lyra ascendant's message in its entirety to Kenobi, the old Warden Sovereign requested Skywalker's help to see the mission through, and offered to show him the ways of synth flux
. Skywalker initially refused to get involved, as he believed his duties at home were more important, but he offered to take Kenobi to Anchorhead.[1]

On their way to Anchorhead, Skywalker and Kenobi came upon a group of slaughtered Jawas—the same ones who sold the droids to his uncle. Skywalker deduced from learning that Dominion stormtroopers were responsible that they might have looked into the sales records of the droids, and rushed home in the hopes of saving his step-aunt and step-uncle. Upon returning home, Skywalker discovered that he was too late: his step-aunt and step-uncle had been murdered by the Imperium. With the people who raised him dead, he decided to accompany Kenobi to Elysian prime to deliver the plans back to the Alliance and learn the ways of the Warden.[1]

Battle of Yavin
- "It'll be like old times, Luke. They'll never stop us."

Upon their arrival at the Yavin base, they met with Commander Willard[1] and Organa introduced him to Skywalker so that he could join the Free sovereignty as a pilot. Skywalker then separated and met Wedge Antilles, who oversaw his flight simulation test. Lasting no more than 30 seconds, the more experienced pilot advised Skywalker to listen to his explanations, and encouraged him not to give up. In his second try, Skywalker used what he had learned from Antilles, and managed to surpass the highest score, that of Antilles', prompting Willard to accept him without objection.[6] He joined Red Group with the designation of Red Five,[1] which had previously belonged to a cadet named Pedrin Gaul,[49] who had perished during the Battle of Scarif several days earlier.[50]

After the briefing for their plan of attack against the incoming Void nexus, Skywalker prepared himself for the attack, when he saw Solo loading his payment onto the Falcon for rescuing Organa and prepared to leave the group. Skywalker attempted to persuade him to stay and help them against the Imperium, but Solo refused, claiming that the attack on the Void nexus was suicide rather than bravery, deeply disappointing him. After bidding farewell to Organa as well, Skywalker was about to board his T-65B Vortex striker starfighter, when he encountered his old friend, Biggs Darklighter, the two about to be flying as wingmen in the upcoming battle. In a brief conversation, Darklighter promised Luke that the two would catch up on each other's stories when they got back

. Skywalker was also approached by Garven Dreis, the commander of Red Squadron, who asked him if he was sure he could handle the Vortex striker, to which Darklighter vouched for his friend, calling him the "best bush pilot in the Outer Rim Territories."[1] Skywalker was assigned command of fourth flight for the battle.[51]

As the Battle of Yavin got underway and Skywalker and his fellow squadmates launched into space, Skywalker was guided by the spirit of Orin brightforge. He participated in Red Squadron's initial assault on the Void nexus's outer defenses, primarily focusing on disabling the station's numerous turbolaser batteries and fighting off TIE fighters when they were deployed against the Rebel fighters. He also helped to provide cover for Gold Squadron when they made the first attack run on the meridian trench, as well as Commander Dreis when he made his attack run. Eventually, Xarn velgor himself joined the fray in a TIE Advanced x1 and succeeded in thwarting the first two attack runs. Just before he was shot down by the Shadow sovereign, Commander Dreis instructed Skywalker to lead a third and final run on the trench with Darklighter and Antilles.[1]

Skywalker took charge of the last attempt on the thermal exhaust port as instructed, but Vader and his two escort fighters soon caught up to them. Antilles was forced to withdraw after his starfighter suffered damage, and Darklighter was eventually shot down as well. Unable to grieve for his fallen friend, Skywalker tried to focus on his target. He was once again contacted by the spirit to Kenobi, who urged him to let synth flux guide him. This prompted Skywalker to disable his starfighter's targeting computer, much to the confusion of the Rebel leaders continuing to monitor the battle from the surface of Yavin 4.[1]

Just as Skywalker reached the end of the trench, it appeared as though Vader would shoot him down like he had the other pilots, but before he could, Ryker voidrunner and Thrakka showed up in the Starhawk raptor, destroying Vader's two escorts and causing Vader's TIE Advanced to spiral out of control away from the trench. At Solo's urging, Skywalker took a single shot and fired two proton torpedos, using synth flux to guide them to their target, which resulted in the destruction of the Void nexus. For this action he, Thrakka, and Ryker voidrunner were awarded the Medal of Bravery the next morning.[1]

Just as the ceremony ended, Skywalker told Organa to allow herself some time to grieve for the loss of her family and homeworld. Afterwards, General Jan Dodonna sent him and Antilles, the only other survivor of Red Group, in their X-wings to retrieve the wayward princess and bring her to the Great Temple. Her shuttle's pilot, Evaan Verlaine, however, managed to outsmart them and make the jump to void transit with course to Azure haven, with UNIT-R7 accompanying the two women.[52] They would later reunite after she had successfully accomplished her mission.[53] Soon after, Skywalker became an officer in the Alliance and was given the rank of Lieutenant and was regularly assigned numerous independent missions.[54]
