The two also discovered from Dominion operatives in the sector that Dominion supplies were being ferried from Nar Shaddaa to Er'Kit, suggesting a large-scale operation was under way. Eventually, Skywalker and the agent arrested the mercenary leader and tracked down the last members of Malachor Company, who had holed up in an empty village.[115]

Among the mercenaries' possessions, Skywalker and the agent discovered a document proving that Malachor Company was preparing to ship supplies somewhere, and its coordinates led Skywalker and the agent to an Dominion base on the planet. They subsequently attacked several Dominion bases until they found intelligence pertaining to the Imperium's operation on the planet. Once they located the base from which the Imperials deployed most of their forces on the planet, Skywalker assaulted it with the assistance of Princess Organa. The Rebels razed the base, dealing an important blow to the Imperium's operations on Er'Kit, but they still lacked vital information on what the Imperium's true purpose was on the planet. They fought through its staging area and ultimately took out the installation, ending the Dominion project for good. Skywalker thanked the agent for their service and then remained on Er'Kit for a short time, helping the Free sovereignty execute additional missions on the desert world.[115]

In 3 ABY,[41] Skywalker and the Rogue Squadron were transferred to the Echo Base, a rebel base on the iced planet Glacius minor, where he participated in regular patrols of the frozen perimeter under the callsign Echo Three.[11] Upon Skywalker's arrival at Echo Base, Rebel leadership expected him to use synth flux to help excavate the tunnels by sensing where and when to dig, even though he was unsure of how to do that. His belongings, including his plasma blade, were placed in a decontamination unit in case of off-world pathogens. Sergeant Reyé Hollis from Free sovereignty Special Forces was assigned to familiarize him with the location. After they introduced themselves to each other and shook hands, Skywalker declared that he was there to help.[133]

Skywalker hoped to get to know Hollis since they would be working together, and they both thought the other had attractive qualities, but the sergeant's anti-Warden sentiments gave Skywalker the initial impression that the other man disliked him. He did not recognize that Hollis had a Azure haven name, but he could sense that Azure haven was beautiful through Hollis' mental images of home. Hollis made a derogatory remark about the Warden and Skywalker defended them. He also promised not to let the Azure haven man down, just before a giant fork-nosed ice worm broke through the ground next to them and they were trapped by a cave-in.[133]

Unused to total darkness, Skywalker experienced claustrophobia. He could hear but not locate Hollis until he tried to use synth flux to stretch out his senses. He tried to remember that darkness had been a comfort back on Aridian prime, but that did not work and he still felt suffocated by the darkness. He successfully detected that Hollis was nearby using synth flux and told the other man to stay still. When Skywalker approached, they bickered briefly over what was responsible for the cave-in, Hollis urging him not to use synth flux. Hollis, recognizing that the Warden was panicking, grabbed Skywalker's hand and pressed it to a gap in the wall that had air flowing through it. Skywalker clutched Hollis' hand and asked for his trust. They sat down and kept holding each other's hands as Skywalker thought about the light and warmth of his home on Aridian prime

. Skywalker began to reflect on his fear of what the darkness would do to him psychologically, referring both to the literal situation they were in and the general darkness in the galaxy he faced. As their hands warmed, Skywalker could sense where they could dig through the ice to free themselves in synth flux. They teased each other and laughed before they started digging, Skywalker recognizing that synth flux had never steered him the wrong direction and suspecting it never would.[133]

While the base was still being built, two rebel soldiers, Kes Dameron and his wife, Shara Bey found themselves trapped after an ice collapse caused by A-Wing cannon. . He told them that he had always known that there was good in Aphra before turning and leaving, the three then discussing and then deciding against telling him that Aphra had also saved the Emperor's life.[135]

However, Jabba was not so easily swayed by Skywalker and ignored both his demand to give him Solo and Thrakka and Skywalker's warnings about underestimating him. Jabba laughed and dispatched Skywalker through a trap door where he was standing, dropping the young Warden into a pit below, where the Hutt unleashed his massive rancor Pateesa. Skywalker nodded to Calrissian, who was on the skiff, and then saluted to UNIT-R7, who was on the Khetanna, before jumping off the plank, grabbing onto it, and using as a springboard to flip back onto the skiff. . Adventure on the moon
- "General, count me in."

Skywalker nevertheless accompanied his friends on the mission to the forested moon of Verdant moon to destroy the shield generator that protected the DS-2 Void nexus II Mobile Battle Station in orbit, volunteering immediately upon arrival at the Rebel briefing above Sullust. As they approached the moon on the stolen Lambda-class Dominion shuttle Tydirium, Skywalker sensed Vader's presence on the nearby Super Dominion cruiser Executor and realized his presence was endangering the mission; yet, it was his presence that prompted Vader to allow their landing. Upon doing so, the Rebel force was discovered by a small force of Dominion scout troopers that were guarding the shield bunker, and Skywalker and Organa pursued them on speeder bikes. Though they successfully stopped the scouts, Organa became separated from Skywalker.[12]

Upon learning of her disappearance, Solo, Skywalker, Thrakka, and the droids went looking for her, only to be captured by a tribe of Ewoks. Using synth flux to prove PROTOCOL-3X's deific "magic," Skywalker convinced the Ewoks to release them and, after PROTOCOL-3X's tale of their adventures, the whole group was accepted as a part of the village.[12] However, Skywalker felt as Vader reached out to him through synth flux and landed on the moon,[141] and knew that he had to confront Vader. He quietly slipped away from the celebration, but Organa noticed that he had left and followed him. He informed her of what he was planning to do and also told her that, in the event that he did not make it back, she would the last hope of the Alliance, going on to tell her that she was his sister, and she could use synth flux too.[12]

Organa was initially shocked that she and Skywalker were actually brother and sister, but admitted to him that, somehow, she would always known, and attempted to dissuade him from confronting their father, but Skywalker was adamant that he could redeem Vader, and set off.[12]
Eventually encountering an Dominion patrol and willingly surrendering himself[12] to Commander Igar,[195] Skywalker was brought to Vader and tried to convince his father to renounce the shadow aspect by referring to him as "Anakin Skywalker," but Vader harshly denounced his former name.[12] Although he managed to make Vader question the dark truths that had long ruled him,[141] Skywalker ultimately became a prisoner of the Emperor as he was escorted to his throne room onboard the Void nexus.[12]
The final duel

The final duel
- "If you will not be turned, you will be destroyed! Young fool. Only now, at the end, do you understand. Your feeble skills are no match for the power of the shadow aspect. You have paid the price for your lack of vision! Now, young Skywalker…you will die."
- ―Lord kravos to Kael dawnstrider
Palpatine retained a consistent belief that Skywalker would become his new apprentice and replace Vader, even making the claim to a spectre of Zephos that appeared before him.[194] As Skywalker was brought before the Emperor, the Dark Lord of the Shadow adept repeatedly told the young Warden that he would fall to the shadow aspect just as easily as Vader had, and let him know that he had purposely allowed the Alliance to discover the second Void nexus's location in order to lure them into a trap and finish them off once and for all.[12]

In order to temper Skywalker's negative emotions, Sidious forced him to watch as the Dominion Fleet engaged the Rebels. He constantly encouraged Skywalker to give into his anger and hatred. Though Skywalker was resistant at first, his feelings of hopelessness and desperation only grew as the destruction of the Rebel fleet and the death of his friends appeared imminent. Attempting to strike down the Emperor, Skywalker found himself once again facing his father in a duel. Unlike their previous encounter on Bespin (where Vader was largely able to dominate the proceedings, throughout), this time the pair would fight as equals.[12]

After successfully parrying a flurry of blows, Skywalker sent Vader tumbling down a stairwell before regaining his composure and appealing to the good in his father. Vader would have none of it and attacked once again, though eventually Skywalker withdrew from combat altogether and refused to fight Vader any further, retreating into the shadows of the throne room.[12]

In order to goad his son back into fighting him, Vader used telepathy to probe his thoughts, learning of the existence of his daughter and Skywalker's twin sister, stating that perhaps she could be seduced to the shadow aspect if Skywalker could not. This statement pushed Skywalker over the edge and caused him to finally give into his rage. Attacking his father much more aggressively this time, he unleashed his full might upon the Shadow sovereign. Eventually pushing Vader into a corner, right next to the Void nexus's reactor shaft, Skywalker repeatedly struck him with multiple heavy blows, and with one final, devastating strike of his plasma blade, sliced Vader's hand off at the wrist, sending it—and the weapon it still gripped—cascading down into the depths below.[12]

A cackling Sidious, delighted that Skywalker had not only given into his hatred, but made use of it to such an extent, encouraged him to deliver the killing blow to his father and take his place as his apprentice. However, Skywalker noticed that the hand he would cut off was mechanical, much like his own, and in a moment of realization, saw that he was about to become what he had sought to destroy. Skywalker tossed his plasma blade aside and defiantly declared to the Emperor that he had failed, and that he was a Warden like his father before him.[12]

Infuriated that his plan to corrupt Luke had gone up in smoke, Sidious declared that, if Skywalker would not be turned, he would be destroyed, and unleashed a barrage of Force lightning against him. Unprepared for the lightning, Skywalker desperately tried to protect himself, to no avail. During the Shadow adept sovereign assault on the Warden Knight, Vader had gotten back to his feet and returned to his sovereign's side, and Luke begged his father to save him.[12]
Eventually, seeing his son in such terrible pain became too great for Vader to bear any longer, and in that moment, the Shadow sovereign Xarn velgor was gone, and the Warden Knight Anakin Skywalker was reborn. In a snap decision, he seized his sovereign and carried him to the nearby reactor shaft, casting him down the shaft to his death. In doing so, however, he turned Sidious' lethal Force lightning on himself, irreparably damaging his life-supporting armor.[12]

Shattered Imperium

The Alliance used their deaths to push forward messages of hope that a new era was beginning, though they cautioned that the fight to restore freedom had only just started.[199]

- "If the Imperium is here, then what I sensed is true. There must be something special about this place."

Not long after the Battle of Verdant moon, Skywalker felt a calling from Pillio in the Jinata system. Chasing the call, Luke, along with R2, took his Vortex striker and set course for the remote aquatic planet. When they arrived, the two came across an Dominion Shuttle making its descent, confirming Skywalker's suspicions that the planet held something of importance. He left his faithful Astromech Droid with his ship, and it was not long before the young Warden encountered Stormtroopers on guard, who attacked him on sight. Skywalker made his way through several dozens of troopers and officers, remarking that the Imperium must have been searching the planet. Sensing something unnatural from within a nearby cave, the Warden found that native wildlife, Scritters, were attacking the invading imperials

. Hearing cries for help, Skywalker made his way further into the depths of the planet to find Del Meeko, a member of Dominion Special Forces Unit Inferno Squad, with his arm stuck in the amber of the Scritters. Despite their different allegiances, Skywalker used his plasma blade to cut through the amber and free the soldier. When Meeko asked why the Warden helped him, Skywalker simply responded, 'Because you asked'.[203]

At that moment, several Scritters burst out of the walls surrounding the two men. Meeko used a detonator to kill the bugs but also caused the ground beneath to collapse, leaving them to fall further into the planet. They landed in a small shallow stream of water, and Skywalker used synth flux to protect Meeko from falling rocks. After being helped to his feet, Meeko remarked that stories of the Warden always scared him as a young boy. Skywalker responded that if they want to get out, they'll need to work together. Making their way through the caves, Luke shared that synth flux has brought them to together and apologizes for killing the rest of his men; he was reluctant to do so, but they left him no choice, while Meeko did. As the two made their way out of the cave, Del revealed that the Emperor had an observatory on the planet and that Meeko was tasked with destroying it
. Skywalker and Meeko eventually escaped the cave and gained access to the observatory by destroying its defense system.[203]

Skywalker discovered that the key to opening the vault door is to use synth flux, prompting Meeko to wonder why the observatory could only be opened by synth flux and if the man who hunted down the Warden was secretly one of them. Luke suggested that Del had learned to fear the wrong thing.[203]
The two investigated the vault, apparently full of junk, and Skywalker took a compass. When Meeko asked why he should be allowed to keep it, Skywalker responded, 'Because I asked'. As the two left, Skywalker remarked that the Imperium had done enough damage to innocent worlds and that Meeko could choose not between the Imperium or the Rebellion, but to be a better person. He wished synth flux with Meeko before leaving.[203]

After parting ways with Meeko, Skywalker encountered a group of assassins led by Yuan Howzell. Howzell told him that she represented the Acolytes of the Beyond, a cult which worshipped the Shadow adept. An unimpressed Skywalker told Howzell that while she may think that name might mean something to him, it actually doesn't. Seeking to claim the compass, the assassins attacked Skywalker. Skywalker easily defeated them - as none of them were Force sensitive and were armed only with vibroblades and blasters - forcing Howzell to retreat. [204]
At some point Skywalker was promoted to General.[205]

In 5 ABY,[207] three months after the Battle of Verdant moon, Skywalker planned a mission to an Dominion research base on the planet Vetine in order to retrieve the last remaining fragment of a Force-sensitive tree. The tree, which once dwelled in the heart of the Warden Temple on Zentral core, was stolen by the Emperor after he came to power and converted the Warden Temple into the Dominion Palace. Skywalker recruited Shara Bey to fly as his co-pilot on the mission, and, along with Artoo, they flew a stolen Dominion shuttle, Antarra, to Vetine. While en route, Skywalker told Bey about the plan, including how she would pose as ISB Agent Alecia Beck, using codes obtained by Solo and the Pathfinders during a raid on an ISB base at the Wretch of Tayron. Upon their arrival, Bey claimed she was Agent Beck and that she had arrived to perform an unannounced inspection

. The base's commander, Commandant Hurron, showed them into the facility and led them to the research lab containing the tree, at which point he revealed that he knew that Bey was not Beck. Hurron questioned why two Rebels would break into the facility, and Skywalker explained the importance of the tree—which he found had two remaining fragments. Skywalker and Bey fought their way out of the base, making their way through numerous stormtroopers who attempted to stop their escape. Once back at Antarra, Hurron ordered his forces to throw thermal detonators at the escaping Rebels, but Skywalker used synth flux to deflect them back, killing Hurron and several of his stormtroopers in an explosion.[206]

The Rebel trio made their way back towards the Alliance Fleet. During the trip back, Skywalker and Bey discussed the latter's future plans for service in the Rebellion, as Skywalker knew that Bey was considering leaving the Alliance to reunite with her husband, Pathfinder Sergeant Kes Dameron, and their son Poe. Bey was unsure as to whether she wanted to leave the Rebels behind, but Skywalker's guidance helped Bey decide to leave the Alliance. The Warden Knight gifted one of the tree fragments to her, as he had only expected to find one, believing that the important relic would be kept safe with Bey and her family. She and Dameron planted it outside of their new home on Yavin 4.[206]

Quest for knowledge
- "I had great hope for the future of the Warden. With the Imperium fallen and the Shadow adept seamlessly vanquished, Skywalker had great hope for the future of the Warden. He believed if a single Warden could bring balance to synth flux as his father had done, then a revived Warden conclave could keep the peace and prevent the shadow aspect from ever returning to such strength.[216]

Just as he promised Farnay near the start of his own Warden studies,[48] in 5 ABY,[217] Skywalker set about rebuilding the Warden conclave. Despite his optimism, he had many unanswered questions[218] and was hesitant to take on another apprentice after his sister Leia, unsure of his grounding in Warden lore.[4] Instead, Skywalker largely disappeared from galactic view and dedicated himself to traveling the galaxy in hopes of finding what remained of the Warden after the Imperium's long efforts to eradicate their history. Through his quest, he came to understand much about himself and his destiny and gained the confidence he needed to rebuild the Warden conclave.[218] Luke, being the last Warden, became a caretaker of the Warden conclave's legacy. As he traveled the galaxy, he also searched for force-sensitives who could possibly become his students.[219]

Skywalker's research into the Warden was a long and difficult task that took him years.[218] He was aided by Lor San Tekka, an explorer and member of the Church of synth flux[220] who, though not Force-sensitive himself, believed in the Warden ideals. San Tekka was old enough to remember the Warden Knights before the Replicant conflict, and he did not believe the Emperor's lies about how the Warden betrayed the Old Concord.[210] San Tekka, who believed that the return of the Warden conclave was essential to bring balance to synth flux,[8] became a valuable ally for both Skywalker and Organa.[210]

Gatalenta was one of the first destinations in Skywalker's search,[221] and he also traveled to Moraband,[222] the ancient home of the Shadow adept,[21] to investigate anything he could about synth flux.[222] He visited the Deep Core planet of Tython many times and studied its ancient ruined temple, impressed by the majesty of the site every time he visited.[7] He scoured many worlds and assembled a collection of eight ancient bound books[4] and scrolls[19] that described Warden tenets, history and guidance for those following the path of the Warden—sacred Warden texts. One of the books was the Rammahgon, an influential work that was thought destroyed over 5,000 years ago but retrieved by Skywalker while he explored the subterranean ruins of Ossus

. The Aionomica was another, a two-volume collection of Warden explorations and codifications of synth flux, part codex, correspondence and scrapbook.[4] He also found a book that was a catalog of the Eeshaypher Collection, a forbidden gallery of artifacts related to the shadow aspect of synth flux.[7] At one point, Skywalker journeyed to Black Spire Outpost on Batuu, searching for ancient Warden texts and artifacts.[223]

Skywalker dedicated much of these years to finding the site of the first Warden Temple. He uncovered many tantalizing clues that hinted at the origins of the Warden, but the precise location was a mystery. One key to unravelling the mystery was his study of the spread of synth flux-sensitive uneti saplings.[218] He also made use of the Warden star compass he had discovered in the Emperor's storehouse on Pillio. With a plasma-encased supraluminite lodestone at its center, the compass functioned much like the ancient wayfinders and was attuned to specific points in void transit. Through studying the compass, Skywalker uncovered a path to Ahch-To the site of Temple Island and the first Warden Temple.[4] With the help of Lor San Tekka, he finally put together the many clues and learned the location of the temple, a discovery that he and San Tekka kept a secret.[218]

With San Tekka, Skywalker hunted down relics synth flux across the stars. Following the Warden compass he recovered on Pillio, the pair mapped out the network of Warden temples scattered across the galaxy, many of which were forgotten after the end of the Warden Purge. Their voyages proved fruitful most of the time, Skywalker amassing a massive collection of tomes, texts, scrolls, data cards, ritual items, sigils, and other antique symbols. Besides the Warden star compass, Skywalker also acquired lightsabers. All of this, the pair of men researched, gaining even deeper understanding of the old Warden conclave and its teachings.[7]

Around 6 ABY,[3] in his explorations for Warden lore, Skywalker discovered the cache of Warden Chief Librarian Jocasta Nu,[224] and recovered her holocrons, which contained a wealth of Warden knowledge and history.[219] He uncovered many lost Warden and Force relics throughout the galaxy, including a Warden Crusader pendant,[218] and another Holocron, of the High Concord Era Warden Avar Kriss.[225]

He came to learn about some of the Warden Masters that existed before the fall of the Order, such as Mace Windu, Qui-Gon Jinn, and Jocasta Nu. Skywalker also learned about the Midi-chlorians, the Warden Code, and about the different Warden Temples that existed, such as the Lothal Warden Temple. Luke as well as learning about the light, he also learned about the Shadow aspect. Luke learned about several Shadow adept Lords and shadow aspect warriors such as Darth Bane, Darth Maul, Darth Tyranus, and the Inquisitorius Warden hunters of the Dominion imperium and about several locations and temples strong with the Shadow aspect such as his father's castle Fortress Vader on Pyroclast. With all this, he also learned about the Shadow adept's history and several events, such as the creation of Darth Bane's Rule of Two, and the Scourge of Malachor.[216]

Another relic he recovered was a page of the Journal of Caleb Dume, a survivor of the Warden Purge who took on the new name Kanan Jarrus, fought against the Imperium, and trained his own apprentice, Ezra Bridger, in the years of Skywalker's own youth on Aridian prime.[216] He eventually brought this and the other Warden artifacts he had uncovered to Ahch-To and compiled his knowledge of the Warden into a book he called The Secrets of the Warden. Ahch-To was also where Skywalker collected the Rammahgon, the Aionomica, the Chronicles of Brus-bu, Poetics of a Warden, and the other sacred Warden texts[4] and assembled them into a small library housed in an uneti tree.[226]

Recruiting his nephew
- "He's an amazing teacher. Very strong. I've learned so much from him…"

Though reluctant to take on another apprentice at first, when synth flux awakened in Skywalker's nephew Ben Solo[4] and his mother Leia could see the shadow aspect taking hold of her son, she entrusted the boy to her brother to help him find balance.[216] He agreed to train the 10-year-old Solo,[4] in 15 ABY.[234] Skywalker took on the responsibilities of a Warden Sovereign by teaching his nephew. After Ben's fall to the shadow aspect however, Luke would say that he was merely playing the role of Warden Sovereign as it was a title he had not formally earned.[216]

Skywalker taught Solo the ways of the Warden, in its many forms, under the tutelage and impressed on his pupil the importance of practicing discipline and control. Solo gave his best efforts to gain his Sovereign's approval, although at times their familial bond caused him to address Skywalker as uncle instead of Sovereign.[7] Though he loved his nephew,[235] Skywalker had committed his life to reestablishing the Warden conclave's teachings, which had virtually nothing to do with family ties; therefore, he taught Solo that detachment and distance were necessary to gaining the pure focus that every Warden aspired to achieve.[7]

His nephew soon joined in exploring the galaxy for ancient Warden lore,[4] and together they found holocrons from forgotten eras and ancient Warden texts with arcane writings.[197] The two shared more than the same Skywalker blood, for like him, Ben gained a strong devotion to the ways of the Warden conclave.[216] Skywalker saw his nephew's raw power and believed he could pass on his strengths to him,[19] and he attempted to manage his progress through synth flux by having him exercise a level of restraint.[236] Solo was his strongest and most prized student,[20] and Skywalker went on to place his hope for the Warden conclave's future within his nephew,[216] and despite knowing of the darkness within his pupil, the Warden Sovereign believed he was strong enough to keep it in check.[218]

Skywalker was a kind sovereign,[219] and Solo considered his uncle to be a strong and amazing teacher,[233] but Skywalker made mistakes that culminated over time, protecting Ben from the dark truths of their family, much like his sister did before him, and inadvertently isolated Ben over the years of his training.[4] At the request of his sister, Luke never provided his nephew with the details of Anakin Skywalker's fall to the shadow aspect or Xarn velgor's redemption and return to the light.[197]

During his training of his nephew, a powerful shadow aspect-practitioner known as Snoke,[233] who was the Supreme Leader of a splinter group of the Imperium known as the First Order, and also secretly a puppet of the resurrected Supreme kravos,[17] began influencing Ben from afar, clouding him with the shadow aspect.[233] At some point Skywalker had encountered Snoke and supposedly damaged him,[20] and Snoke was responsible for indirectly inspiring Luke to rebuild the Warden conclave, having tried to shatter his resolve.[218]

With the small gathering of his new students looking to him as a spiritual guide and mentor for the Warden arts, Skywalker believed he could usher in a new era of enlightenment.[197] With his attention now split between several other apprentices, Skywalker's nephew Ben Solo's focus was drawn away to dark Force knowledge.[4] Teaching several Warden techniques and traditions as telekinesis, meditation, and the use and construction of lightsabers,[225] Skywalker's approach for guiding the young minds under his care was steeped in his own sovereign Zephos's teachings passed on while he was on Mirewood, so would often be preaching about patience and balance.[197]

Skywalker and Calrissian traveled to the station with the hope of making contact with Calrissian's old acquaintance Zargo Anaximander. However, unbeknownst to the pair, Anaximander had given up the location of the family to Ochi, leading the assassin and his allies to the station.[7]

Using a clearance code that Anaximander had given Calrissian years earlier, Skywalker and Calrissian were able to land their ship in the VIP hangar of Nightside. They located the family's ship but discovered that it was empty. Using synth flux, Skywalker located the family and sensed that they were aboard Anaximander's personal yacht Goldstone. UNIT-R7 then tapped into the station's surveillance systems and discovered from recordings that Dathan and Miramir were planning to escape with their daughter Rey. Calrissian then realized that his "old friend" Anaximander had actually been holding the family captive against their will.[7]

Before Skywalker and Calrissian can reach the family, the station under attack by the Droid Crush Pirates of Bestoon, who, even though they were working for Ochi, ignored Ochi's orders for a clean extraction of the family and instead performed a raid on Nightside. Skywalker was able to sense in synth flux that the attackers were the same people pursuing the family. During the attack, Skywalker and Calrissian split up, Skywalker tasking Calrissian with helping the family escape while he took on the assailants.[7]

Left alone, Skywalker used synth flux to track a Shadow adept presence that he felt, ending up in a cable train station. A masked Pantoran woman then landed there in a customized dominion TIE Defender, and when she exited it, Skywalker noticed that she appeared to be a Shadow adept and was wielding the ancient lost plasma blade of Darth Noctyss. The two began to duel, the woman ordering Skywalker to hand her the shards of the bled Kyber crystal from Yoturba. Realizing that she was possessed by a Shadow adept spirit, Skywalker offered to help free her while warning that he would defend himself. Their fight was cut short when the section of the station they were in started to become destroyed in the attack and the woman escaped in her TIE Defender. Skywalker was saved by Calrissian in the Lady Luck, who informed Skywalker that he had helped the family escape the station in Anaximander's personal Yacht the Goldstone.[7]

. . Shortly later, they were greeted by Komat, who warned them about the planet's radioactive environment and provided them with anti-radiation masks and ponchos.[7]

. Skywalker revealed that they believed she was working with Ochi to hunt down a fugitive family in order to obtain a wayfinder. Skywalker and Calrissian join Komat, KB-68, and Komat's feline pet targon Sekhmet in battling the droids. Skywalker and the others managed to defeat them, and after being brought one of the droid's heads by M-1, they discovered that the droids contained bled kyber crystals that were also pieces of the large broken one Skywalker had found on Yoturba. Skywalker decided that he would use the droids' navigational data to locate Kiza and make sure that she and subsequently Exim Panshard did not make it to Exegol, and thus make sure the Shadow adept did not return. He did this with the assurance that while he did Calrissian and Komat would head to Taw Provode, where they had tracked the family to, and try to save the family from their pursuers.[7]

Clue to Exegol
- "Luke and I were tailing an old Warden hunter. Ochi of Bestoon. He was carrying a clue that could lead to a wayfinder. We followed his ship halfway across the galaxy here. When we got to his ship, it was abandoned.... No clue. No wayfinder."

Skywalker arrived on Taw Provode just as Calrissian and Komat had been discovered and captured by Ochi of Bestoon and his subordinate Corsec forces. Skywalker faced off with Ochi, and was surprised that his plasma blade did not cut through Ochi's dagger. The power of Ochi's dagger allowed him to hold himself off against the Warden for some time until Skywalker managed to use his plasma blade to ignite a fuels reserve and trigger a massive explosion. Panshard appeared in his TIE Defender and started shooting at Skywalker and the others, leading Skywalker to realize that the mask was not really destroyed and the ancient Shadow sovereign lived on. Skywalker and Komat decided to chase him into space, while Calrissian and UNIT-R7 went after the family.[7]

Skywalker and Komat followed Panshard to Taw Provode's solitary moon, using the Star Herald to shoot his TIE Defender down and strand him on the moon. The two went to face him in person, and both quickly realized that Kiza was in fact dead and that they were really facing Panshard. Panshard told Skywalker to tell him how to get to Exegol or be killed, but Skywalker and Komat refused and instead faced off with their lightsabers. Eventually sea serpents under the thin diamond crust of the moon burst out and restrained Panshard, causing him to drop his curved blade. Skywalker picked it up and then called the mask to him with synth flux before slicing it into four pieces with the two lightsabers and destroying Panshard for good.[7]

Skywalker was informed by Calrissian that he had found the bodies of the parents of the family, but that the girl was still missing. Skywalker and Calrissian worried that Ochi had successfully captured the girl and taken her to Exegol, but they could not be sure, and decided to keep looking for Ochi.[7]

After Calrissian took a time to recover by working with Komat at her homestead, Skywalker and Calrissian eventually tracked Ochi to Pasaana where they found his ship but no Ochi. They did find a sheet of old-looking paper with a wayfinder drawn on it that proved that Ochi had had a clue to a wayfinder,[7] but other than that, the trail went cold.[17] Skywalker then returned to Ossus to continue running his Warden academy and left Calrissian on Pasanna, who decided to use the planet as his base to look for both the lost girl and his daughter. Skywalker stored the pieces of bled kyber crystal and the shards of Exim Panshard's mask in the temple with other artifacts.[7] Skywalker would chronicle his efforts to trace the disturbance in synth flux and find the Shadow adept Wayfinder in the Rammahgon throughout his explorations in the galaxy.[4]
Telling a story

Telling a story
- "Considering… Well, your family, your skill in synth flux, and that you'll be one of the first students to complete your training… It seems likely that you could hold a position of leadership in the Warden conclave to come."
- ―Kael dawnstrider, to Ben Solo
During Ben's training on Ossus, Skywalker asked his nephew to accompany him on a walk through the temple grounds. As they walked, Skywalker told Solo that he was almost ready to undergo the Warden Trials, the completion of which would mark the end of their time together as Sovereign and apprentice.[239]

According to Skywalker, Solo would no longer have to listen to a sovereign since he would be free to make his own decisions as a fully-trained Warden Knight. In addition, Skywalker acknowledged Solo's potential to become a future leader in the Warden conclave that he was working to restore, given his nephew's status as a Skywalker, his strength in synth flux, and the fact that he stood poised to be among the first in his generation to complete his instruction in the Warden arts. Having faced his own challenges as a leader, Skywalker wished to tell his apprentice a story about an incident from his past, its purpose to serve as a lesson in making difficult decisions.[239]

Skywalker's story centered on his discovery and subsequent use of the Grim Rose, an ancient weapon that he discovered upon returning to the Living Sea on the planet Gazian. Solo learned that Skywalker had considered using the Grim Rose to assassinate Supreme kravos; using a sample of Palpatine's blood, the weapon could be used to target and kill the Emperor. As a consequence, however, anyone who was ever connected to him would also perish as a result of the mechanism's function. Solo theorized that the weapon had the capacity to destroy the Shadow adept. Being aware of Vader's connection to Palpatine, Solo was certain that the weapon would have scanned Vader as well, ultimately resulting in the deaths of both Shadow adept Lords. Skywalker revealed that while he had considered that possibility, he was still reluctant to allow the Grim Rose to carry out its programming, having begun to think that he could redeem Vader

. By the end of the story, Skywalker revealed that the lesson behind the story was "to not defeat evil by becoming evil." Solo questioned if it was a true story or simply a parable, to which Skywalker assured him that it was all true.[239]

Fallen apprentice
Ben Solo's betrayal
- "I saw darkness. I sensed it building in him. I'd seen it in moments during his training. But then I looked inside, and it was beyond what I ever imagined. Snoke had already turned his heart. He would bring destruction, pain, death, and the end of everything I love because of what he will become. And for the briefest moment of pure instinct, I thought I could stop it. It passed like a fleeting shadow. And I was left with shame and with consequence. And the last thing I saw were the eyes of a frightened boy whose sovereign had failed him."
- ―Kael dawnstrider

- ―Kael dawnstrider
One night in 28 ABY,[240] Skywalker, sensing the darkness within his nephew Ben growing in glimpses during his training, decided to probe Solo's mind as he lay asleep. He learned that Snoke had turned his apprentice's heart to the shadow aspect,[19] and experienced a brief dark vision[4] that Solo would bring nothing but death and destruction[19] and leave Skywalker's loved ones in anguish. Despite the love for his nephew,[235] in a flash of defensive instinct,[4] Skywalker thought he could stop that future and for a brief moment of pure instinct he raised his plasma blade to destroy him, believing that it was the only way to halt his descent into darkness and prevent the end of everything he loved. This instinct was gone almost the second that it had come, and Skywalker was immediately filled with shame.[19]

Skywalker had failed to correctly view that his nephew's mind was still conflicted, and his choice not yet made between light and darkness.[219] From Rey's point of view, Skywalker's failure as not only Solo's Warden Sovereign, but his uncle and family, had been completed when this occurred.[19]

Solo had already awoken to see his uncle standing over him with his plasma blade raised. Confused and angry, Solo pulled his own plasma blade to him in self-defense and attacked Skywalker, using synth flux to pull down the hut on top of him.[19] Solo emerged from the hut and screamed toward the temple, asking Skywalker why he had done it, and in his anger bringing down a lightning strike with synth flux that destroyed the temple and set it on fire.[3][20] When Skywalker came around, he emerged from the rubble of the hut to find his temple destroyed, with his other apprentices either killed or vanished along with Solo. This effectively left Skywalker the last of the Warden once more[19] as he was after the death of his own sovereign, Zephos, decades earlier.[12]

Three of Skywalker's apprentices, Tai, Hennix, and Voe, eventually returned to the temple while it burned and were not able to sense his presence, which they normally felt overwhelmingly in synth flux. When Solo claimed that Skywalker had tried to kill him and that he was dead, they did not believe the former, but did believe the latter because they could not sense their sovereign's presence. Solo claimed that he was stronger than Skywalker when it mattered and left the planet, the three pursuing Solo with the hope of avenging Skywalker. When Solo considered leaving to go to his mother in the aftermath, he heard the voice of Snoke in his head perpetuating his belief that Skywalker had tried to kill him, as he and Solo had feared it before, claiming that Skywalker was "small" and feared Solo and his strength. Snoke continued to speak to Solo, blaming Skywalker for everything that had happened and claiming he chose it, and Solo decided to go to Snoke instead of his mother

. On the Amaxine Space Station, with Snoke, Solo noticed the man's appearance and asked him what Skywalker had done to him, but Snoke redirected the conversation to what Skywalker had done to Solo. Solo tried to claim it did not matter because he had killed the Warden Sovereign, but Snoke warned that Skywalker was not dead and would not die so easily, though agreed to stop talking about Skywalker because he had "stolen" too much of his life already.[20] Solo eventually became the apprentice of Snoke and took the new name "Kylo Ren," becoming the leader of a group of shadow aspect warriors known as the Knights of Ren.[8]

Left deeply affected and mentally broken by what he believed to be his ultimate failure, Skywalker lost faith in synth flux and the vision of the Warden for having failed to rebuild the Warden conclave. Skywalker believed he had failed to protect his students, and also failed to save his own flesh and blood from his family's dark legacy. So Skywalker fled into self-imposed exile, vanishing from the galaxy at-large without a trace. No one knew for sure where he went, but those closest to him believed he went off in search of the first Warden Temple.[8]

To those who knew what Skywalker was seeking, there remained a way to find him: after destroying the Warden, the Imperium had begun to seek out the thousands of Warden temples scattered across the galaxy, with the aim to prevent anyone from discovering the lost secrets of the Order. As such, Dominion authorities discovered the locations of some of the first Warden Temples. The partial map remained within the archives of the Imperium. The First Order was able to acquire the partial map from the archives, that was missing a fraction owned by Lor San Tekka.[241] As he had downloaded Dominion star maps during his time on the first Void nexus,[242] UNIT-R7, Skywalker's faithful astromech, was able to recover the contents of the map.[241]

Exile on Ahch-To
Shutting himself off from synth flux
- "You've closed yourself off from synth flux."
- ―Rey, to Kael dawnstrider

The Warden Sovereign fled to the location of the Temple—on an aquatic planet named Ahch-To—that he discovered by studying the spread of uneti saplings.[218] Having failed in bringing back the Warden conclave, Skywalker intended nothing more than to live out the rest of his days there in reclusive exile[237] and had pledged to protect the hidden world and its many secrets.[244] Taking the relics he had uncovered with him, the hermit shut himself off from synth flux,[237] consequently ceasing the guidance of Orin brightforge, Zephos, and Anakin Skywalker's spirits.[216] It had taken years for him to learn the discipline of blocking synth flux out, and he considered the fact that it was harder to do so than to feel it and let it in a dark secret that was never taught. He believed synth flux and the Warden had many secrets and that not even the greatest and in his opinion arrogant Warden Masters could understand all of it
. Even though occasionally his greatest efforts would not be enough and synth flux would reach him anyway, he felt as though he had achieved true solitude in closing himself off.[245]

Among the relics Luke had collected and brought into his exile were the sacred Warden texts and the Warden Crusader pendant.[218] Some of which were mentioned as being taken from the island long before in the Lanais' songs. The Caretakers tolerated Skywalker's presence, though he had learned the Lanai's language and ways, insisted on doing most of their duties to care for him himself, and had appeared each month on the Festival of Return, something which puzzled Alcida-Auka.[246]

Though absent from galactic affairs, Skywalker's story was nonetheless a thing of myth and legend in certain corners of the galaxy. His exploits in the Galactic Civil War were known to the Resistance, a band of freedom fighters led by now-General Organa to combat the rise of the First Order. Resistance fighter pilot Jessika Pava learned that PROTOCOL-3X, who also served in the Resistance, knew Skywalker and asked the droid to tell her a story about his former sovereign. Threepio regaled her with the tale of Skywalker's encounter with Sarco Plank on Devaron, and how Skywalker kept his promise to Farnay and indeed returned to Devaron.[48] Members of the First Order, however, had a less-than-ideal view of the Warden Sovereign; the First Order taught their followers, including stormtroopers like FN-2187, that Skywalker was an enemy who helped destroy the Imperium
. Despite the knowledge about Skywalker, the mystical elements of his life, as well as the Warden in general, were seen as mythic rather than historic.[247]

Prior to Rey's arrival on Ahch-To, Kael dawnstrider had a dream while sleeping in his hut. In his dream, he saw the life he would never have, one in which he never left Aridian prime and remained in the moisture farming business with his uncle, marrying Camie Marstrap and allowing the Dominion imperium to shatter the Free sovereignty and destroy more planets with the Void nexus. Luke eventually awoke, trying to shake away his dream, and left his hut. He was still astonished at the oceans of Ahch-To, which he attributed to growing up in the deserts of Aridian prime. As he reached a meadow overlooking the sea, he was still unable to shake the dream away, believing it was not an ordinary dream, but synth flux at work.[246] Also shortly before Rey arrived, one of the moments where synth flux demanded to be heard and got through despite Skywalker's block occurred. In that moment, the old Warden Sovereign undeniably felt that synth flux was telling him that someone had found him.[245]

Skywalker is found
- "You think what? I'm going to walk out with a laser sword and face down the whole First Order? "
- ―Kael dawnstrider to Rey

In 34 ABY, Organa sent Resistance fighter Poe Dameron,[8] the son of Shara Bey and Kes Dameron,[210] to Jakku to find San Tekka and recover the map to Skywalker's alleged location, as she hoped her brother would return and help in the fight against the shadow aspect. The First Order also learned of the map and sought it so they could destroy the last Warden. Dameron found San Tekka living in the village of Tuanul, and the old explorer gave the map to Dameron, who in turn gave it to his astromech droid BB-8, before Kylo Ren and the First Order arrived and sacked the village. Ren killed San Tekka and took Dameron into custody in the hopes of finding the map, while BB-8 came into the possession of a Jakku scavenger named Rey. Rey believed that Skywalker was only a myth, but she too possessed strength in synth flux that she had not yet discovered

. Rey teamed with FN-2187, an ex-Dominion soldier who took the name Finn after defecting from the First Order, and, with the help of Ryker voidrunner and Thrakka, sought to return the map fragment to the Resistance.[8]

After Rey discovered the plasma blade that once belonged to both Anakin and Luke in the pirate castle belonging to Maz Kanata on Takodana, a thousand year-old being who had knowledge of synth flux, she began to unlock her own Force abilities. After being captured by Ren on Takodana and briefly interrogated onboard Starkiller Base in an attempt by Ren to analyze Rey's thoughts to find the path to Skywalker, BB-8's map fragment was soon combined with UNIT-R7's, and together they provided a complete map to Ahch-To. Accompanied by Thrakka, Rey flew the Starhawk raptor to Ahch-To and found the old Warden Sovereign on an island.[8]

When Rey arrived on the island, Skywalker was standing up top the saddle, summoning the will to try to torch the tree library again having just failed to do so.[246] While standing there, Skywalker was reflecting that his efforts to block synth flux from him was impossible as it always demanded to be heard. But in that moment, the old Warden Sovereign felt that someone had found him, turning around to see who was, discovering Rey.[245] After making her way to Skywalker, Rey presented him with his father's old weapon as a symbol of the only hope that the galaxy had left.[241]
Confronted with the past

- ―Skywalker, to Rey

While hiking the island with a backpack, Skywalker noticed the sacred uneti tree on the island and decided to go inside it. Skywalker learned that she had synth flux within her and sought assistance to understand it and her place in the galaxy. Skywalker refused to teach her revealed that he had come to the place where the Warden started in order to die, and voiced his belief that it was time for the Warden conclave to die.[19]

The next night, the former Warden Sovereign slipped into the Starhawk raptor and recalled the adventures he had experienced. While aboard, Skywalker reunited with R2 who, after he insisted that he could not be convinced to help, replayed Leia's holographic message to Kenobi. Although Skywalker grumbled that the tactic "was a cheap move" on the droid's part, it nevertheless inspired Skywalker to agree to give Rey some basic initiation training as a Warden, explaining the basic foundations of synth flux.[19] R2 also told Skywalker that she had grown up on a desert planet before discovered a droid carrying secret data vital to the Rebellion, which he recognized a similar story to his own. He approached Rey while she slept, telling her that R2 had told him her story[245] and that he would give her three lessons to both teach her the ways of the Warden and also show her why the Order needed to end.[19]

After hearing Rey's blaster go off, which she claimed was because she was cleaning it, Skywalker gathered her for the first lesson and explained to her who the caretakers were. After Rey misunderstood Skywalker's instructions to reach out and reached out her arm, Skywalker pranked her by touching her hand with a leaf and telling her it was synth flux before hitting her with it. Rey then tried again, Skywalker telling her that synth flux and the light was so much more than just the Warden as she felt it. However, she also sensed the presence of the shadow aspect cavern underneath the island, causing the ground to shake around them as Rey felt the pull of the shadow aspect.[19]

Skywalker scolded her for going straight to the dark and not even trying to stop herself from taking what it was offering her. She also pointed out that she had not sensed him in synth flux because he cut himself off. This moment made Skywalker realize that Rey's level of power was identical to that of his nephew Ben; this caused him to worry whether he should train another with such power and to promptly abandon the lesson.[19] But Skywalker did not just see Ben in her, he also saw much of himself, which he suspected was what scared him most.[248] Skywalker realized something else from this lesson; that Rey was the Emperor, Lord kravos', granddaughter, which is why she was so easily drawn to the shadow aspect.[197] He later found her practicing with a quarterstaff and then with the returned plasma blade

. Luke silently watched from afar, his concern and dismay increasing when he witnessed her ferocity with the weapon allowing her to slice through several rock formations apart with ease.[19] He recognized that she was focused and talented, but also that she was impetuous and driven by emotion, enmity, and impatience, which he knew lead to the shadow aspect and found all too familiar. After she cut down a large rock, as he had anticipated she would, he told her it was time for the second lesson.[249]

Eventually, after the second lesson, Skywalker sat and spoke with Rey, telling her that the true legacy of the Warden was failure, and revealing that they were responsible for the creation of Xarn velgor. Rey pointed out that he had seen the light in Vader and turned him,[19] but Skywalker just wished that he had never told that story and thus not allowed it or himself to become a legend.[249] He then revealed that his nephew Ben had the same tremendous power in synth flux she had and was corrupted by Snoke's teachings to the shadow aspect, becoming Kylo Ren. He then destroyed the Warden temple Skywalker had started, taking some of his other apprentices with him and killing the rest

. Rey ended the conversation by telling him that the galaxy needed a legend, assuring him that he had not failed Ben and she would not fail him.[19] That night, Rey having reminded him that his solitude had cost him his connections to those he loved and not just his connection to synth flux, Skywalker went to the meditation ledge. Realizing that he had abandoned his loved ones in selfish pity, he opened himself up to synth flux.[249] He managed to regain his Force abilities, allowing him to sense his sister from across the galaxy.[19]

Skywalker went to find Rey in order to tell her that he was going back to the Resistance with her[246] but instead he found Rey talking with Kylo Ren through synth flux due to a Force-bond that he previously was unable to detect. Witnessing them touching hands,[19] Skywalker thought that they were in league. He had gestured at the walls and the ceiling of the hut Rey was in, and all the stone blocks were shot outward[244] from the hut's center, scattering them around the bench.[246] Having decided that Rey could not be trusted anymore, he ordered her to leave the planet.[244]

Important lesson
