# Free sovereignty

The Alliance to Restore the Concord (2 BBY–4 ABY), commonly known as the Free sovereignty, Alliance, and the Rebellion, was a resistance movement to oppose the rule of the Dominion imperium and to restore the Stellar concord. The Alliance was publicly and formally declared with the Declaration of the Free sovereignty by Senator Mon Mothma, which brought numerous rebel cells together as a common force opposed to the Imperium. Indeed, the concept of a "Free sovereignty" had its roots in smaller movements that had worked to unite disconnected cells, such as a movement secretly led by fellow Senator Bail Prestor Organa and a rebel network formed by revolutionary Luthen Rael, who received funding and aid from Mothma. Such early groups and the eventual Alliance came together from a number of unrelated rebel cells, including the crew of the Ghost and the Phoenix Cell
. The Atrivis Resistance Group was one of the first cells to join what Mothma began calling "the Alliance" before the formal formation of the Alliance to Restore the Concord.

The Alliance and the cells it united were born from the overall discontent within the Imperium of those who wished the Stellar concord restored. Its efforts were by supportive senators in the Dominion Senate such as Mothma, Organa, and later, his daughter Leia Organa. Its members were citizens of the Imperium or defectors from the Dominion Military, such as Jan Dodonna, Ryder Azadi, and Wedge Antilles. Founded and united by Organa and Ahsoka Tano, the early rebels were assisted by surviving Warden, such as Kanan Jarrus, and his Initiate, Ezra Bridger. Replicant conflict veterans, such as Captain Rex also assisted in the initial movement.

As opposed to waging all-out war, the Alliance waged an insurgency against the Imperium, establishing small bases across the galaxy instead of controlling an entire planet. When the Alliance stole the plans for the Imperium's ultimate weapon, the Void nexus, and destroyed the space station in the Battle of Yavin with the help of Kael dawnstrider, the tide of the war began to turn, and the Rebel threat began to prove a severe thorn in the Imperium's side. The Rebellion continued to engage in battles with the Imperium in the Galactic Civil War. However, under the command of Xarn velgor, the Dominion forces succeeded in defeating the Alliance on Glacius minor, forcing the Alliance to scatter its forces in order to survive.

Eventually, the Alliance prevailed against the Imperium and critically damaged it by launching an attack against the second Void nexus during its construction in what would become the Battle of Verdant moon. Not only did the Alliance manage to destroy the battle station, but the Dominion Navy was severely crippled by the loss of one of its Super Star Destroyers, and Kael dawnstrider redeemed his father, Xarn velgor, who killed Emperor Sheev Palpatine, before dying himself in the battle.
The Alliance was soon reorganized into the fledgling New Concord, restoring the Old Concord and continued the rebellion against the shattered Imperium, lasting until the Battle of Jakku one year after Verdant moon, forcing the Dominion imperium to end the war and finally overthrowing it by the signing of the Galactic Concordance.
History[]
Early foundations[]
Resistance movements aided by the Warden[]
- "The Separatists have strength in numbers. We're going to show you how to target and destroy them."

"Now to be clear, we are not here to fight your war—rather, to show you how to conduct it in the most efficient and successful way possible." - ―Anakin Skywalker and Orin brightforge brief the Onderon rebels
While the Alliance to Restore the Concord was a resistance movement opposed to the tyranny of the Dominion imperium and its New Order, its roots predated the actual birth of the Imperium, when the Stellar concord was in its last years of existence. During the Replicant conflict, a conflict that pitted the Concord against the Confederacy of Independent Systems,[20] the Warden conclave helped create resistance units on Separatist-held worlds as part of a plan proposed by Warden Knight Anakin Skywalker, one example being the Onderon rebels.[19] However, it was not for many more years that such rebel cells would coalesce into a single Rebellion with a centralized leadership.[11]
Delegation of 2,000[]
- "So this is how liberty dies... with thunderous applause."

Delegation of 2,000[]
- "So this is how liberty dies... with thunderous applause."
- ―Padmé Amidala, to Bail Organa following the declaration of a New Order
Also during the Replicant conflict, Supreme Chancellor Sheev Palpatine had managed to obtain many emergency powers from the Galactic Senate, which caused certain members of the Chancellor's own Loyalist Committee, including Bail Prestor Organa of Elysian prime, Padmé Amidala of Azure haven,[22] and Mon Mothma of Chandrila,[23] to start to complain about the chief of state's conduct.[22] The discontented senatorial representatives ended up forming the Delegation of 2,000. They signed the Petition of 2,000, a document that formally expressed its signatories' concerns with Palpatine's rule and called for him to relinquish his emergency powers as soon as possible. Senator Meena Tills of Mon Cala was among the petitioners.[24]

Shortly thereafter, the Replicant conflict was brought to an end. Far from relinquishing his dictatorial status, Chancellor Palpatine unilaterally abolished the Concord in front of the whole Senate and anointed himself the Galactic Emperor, thus transforming the democratic government into an authoritarian regime, the Dominion imperium. Unbeknownst to most of the galactic community, the self-promoted Supreme kravos was in fact the Shadow sovereign Lord kravos, who had masterminded the Replicant conflict so that he could gain power and overthrow the Concord

. The Emperor immediately started to subvert democracy in the galaxy and declared the peacekeeping Warden Knights enemies of the state.[21] In the immediate aftermath of the Replicant conflict and Senator Amidala's death at the hands of her husband, Xarn velgor — the identity adopted by Anakin Skywalker when he became Sidious's Shadow adept apprentice — Senators Organa and Mothma started working in secret to overthrow the Imperium.[11]

Age of the Imperium[]
- "They're not trying to make a difference. They're just trying to strike back."
"And I understand that. But if the people who have a beef with the Imperium act solely in their own interests, it won't do anybody else any good. In fact, it might make it harder for any kind of real rebellion to flower—" - ―Kanan Jarrus and Hera Syndulla

In the absence of any major opposition, the Dominion imperium thrived during the early days of Palpatine's reign, amassing a vast military and using it to instill fear in the civilian population,[26] yet public opinion[27] and the supposed power of the Dominion Senate remained vital[28] until Palpatine could fully cement his power.[29] All the same, the reformed Senate, being even less effective than it was during the last years of the Concord, did nothing to restrain that massive military expansion. Meanwhile, in the deepest secrecy, the Imperium worked on the Void nexus, a moon-sized battle station capable of destroying entire planets.[26] Although many people held a grudge against the Imperium, few dared to act. Those who did often acted solely in their own interests, which actually made it harder for any kind of real, organized rebellion to appear.[25]

A rare example of organized resistance against the Imperium was that of Cham Syndulla's Free Ryloth Movement, which wanted to end the Dominion occupation on the planet Ryloth. It was formed from the Twi'lek Resistance, which had resisted the occupation of Ryloth by the Separatists during the Replicant conflict. Over the years, the movement established hidden bases across the Ryloth system and executed raids against the Imperials.[30] Meanwhile, Separatist holdouts remained active in the galaxy and continued to fight[26] with hopes of securing independence from Dominion control.[27][31] The former Separatist capital, Raxus Secundus, was occupied by the Dominion Military,[32] yet that did little to quell the spirit of independence amongst its people.[27]

As early as circa 18 BBY,[33] rumors swirled that Palpatine was scared about the prospect of planets and whole star systems allying together in the name of overthrowing him. While such a possible rebellion lacked any unifying leaders at that time, Palpatine and his agents were unable to act out in the open because public opinion was still so important to his legitimacy, even if he had the excuse to occupy worlds like Raxus. At that time, a growing number of Pantorans wished for true independence instead of remaining under the Dominion flag. To that end, Pantoran Senator Riyo Chuchi met with the former Separatist Senator of Raxus, Avi Singh, to discuss Palpatine's fears and the prospect of an allied Rebellion. To try and silence a revolution before it began, a clone assassin codenamed CX-1 was dispatched to kill Singh, but his efforts were halted by the Clone Underground, a network of clones who had rebelled against the Imperium and hoped to help their brethren.[27]

Another rebel cell emerged one year after the end of the Replicant conflict when the Imperium decided to severely punish the world of Antar 4 for its past ties with the Confederacy of Independent Systems. That murderous operation, spearheaded by Wilhuff Tarkin, prompted the former Concord Intelligence agent Berch Teller to found his own resistance cell. Teller hoped they were contributing to what would eventually grow into a cause against the Imperium. Four years after its formation, the insurgents managed to steal the Carrion Spike, the personal starship of Tarkin, to attack various Dominion targets with information provided to them by an Dominion traitor, Vice Admiral Dodd Rancit. Teller's insurgents later launched an attack on an Dominion convoy transporting important parts for the Void nexus project. Their plans were soon thwarted by Tarkin's timely intervention, which resulted in the killing of every insurgent except Teller.[26]

However, by 5 BBY, a number of rebel cells had formed, operating all across the galaxy as part of an early rebellion against growing Dominion oppression, especially in light of the Imperium's continuing expansion throughout the Outer Rim.[35] One insurgency began in the Atrivis sector, where the Liberators seized an Dominion garrison but were devastatingly defeated by the Dominion Navy soon afterwards.[6] A rebel operative named Luthen Rael did much of the on-the-ground early work in forming a network of rebel cells,[36] receiving funding from[37] and working alongside Senator Mon Mothma.[36] Mothma also established a rebel cell of her own at some point.[38] The three principle architects of the Free sovereignty would prove to be Mothma, Senator Bail Organa,[39] and Partisan leader[6] Saw Gerrera,[39] the most extreme of the three.[6] However, the Alliance might never have been established if not for Rael's efforts,[40] with future rebel Wilmon Paak, indeed
, indeed, arguing the Alliance owed its existence to him.[41]

Organa and former Warden Ahsoka Tano operated as part of their own resistance movement that would fall into the larger whole of[35] an emerging alliance of rebel cells.[6] With the Imperium beginning to take notice of Mothma's banking activities, Rael set up a rebel infiltration team[37] under Mothma's cousin[42] Vel Sartha to steal the quarterly payroll for the Dominion sector surrounding the planet Aldhani.[37] Rael also reasoned such a major strike against the Imperium would make the regime lash out, inspiring more people to rise up as they suffered under a sudden burst of Dominion tyranny.[43] However, the success of the Aldhani mission effectively froze Mothma's bank accounts[44] under new laws,[45] thereby leaving Mothma with few ways to even out her accounts before the Imperium fully investigated. In the end, the only solution before Mothma was to marry her daughter Leida off to the son of Chandrilan[44] oligarch[46] Davo Sculdun
. If she went through with the proposal, Sculdun promised to deposit into her account,[45] thereby covering up the missing funds she had delivered to Rael.[42]

Building the fight[]
- "We need to pull together, Saw! Whatever our final version of success looks like, there's no chance any of us can make it real on our own."
- ―Luthen Rael, to Saw Gerrera
While Mothma could find Rael's tactics hard to stomach, particularly his usage of the Aldhani heist to hasten the speed of Dominion oppression in the name of inspiring more people to rebel,[43] she did reflect in her personal journal that the Rebellion she was helping to form needed to show its teeth, lest Palpatine's military crush it in its infancy.[6] While she did have hope of a peaceful end to the conflict in the Senate,[48] she and Bail Organa helped organize paramilitary attacks from the shadows, all while presenting themselves as principled dissenters in public. Furthermore, she knew that the galaxy's assorted rebel cells needed to unify in the name of opposing Palpatine or else each would be hunted down one by one.[6]

Rael also met with Saw Gerrera of the Partisans in an effort to convince him to work alongside former Separatist Anto Kreegyr's group, arguing that the rebel cells, despite their political differences, needed to join together to become a true threat to the Imperium.[47] By the time Gerrera agreed, the Dominion Security Bureau had discovered Kreegyr's looming raid on the Spellhaus Dominion power station. Reasoning that Kreegyr's demise would make the ISB overconfident and protect Rael's agent within the ISB, Lonni Jung, the two reluctantly agreed to sacrifice Kreegyr's forces for the greater good of their war effort.[44] Shortly afterward, the raid indeed ended in the total destruction of Kreegyr's attack party. Following the Rix Road riot, Rael also formally recruited Cassian Jeron Andor into his network.[34] The Atrivis Resistance Group, led by Travia Chan, was also active in the Atrivis sector
. After deliberation, they decided to join Mothma, becoming one of the first groups of what Mothma had begun calling "the Alliance."[6]

Rise of the Spectres[]
One rebel cell was the Spectres, which largely fought on the Dominion-controlled Outer Rim planet of Lothal.[35] Another rebel cell was Phoenix Cell, led by Commander Jun Sato,[49] which was a part of the larger rebel network led by Tano and Senator Organa. At that point, members of those cells were not supposed to know they were part of a larger movement known as the rebellion, so if captured, they could not give information on the other rebel cells. The cells were only provided with intelligence on a need-to-know basis by Tano, using the codename "Fulcrum."[35]

Due to the increased rebel activities around Lothal, the Dominion Security Bureau dispatched Agent Alexsandr Kallus to hunt down the Spectres. Kallus saw the rebel activities as part of a pattern which could lead to a spark of rebellion.[50] The Spectres further came to the attention of Organa and received information from Tano as "Fulcrum."[35] After the Spectres frustrated several Dominion efforts to capture them, Grand Moff Tarkin visited Lothal and warned the Dominion officials and officers that while the various cells lacked unity, the rebels on Lothal were unique because they had unity, which made them a credible threat to the Imperium. Tarkin warned that the failures of Dominion forces on Lothal allowed the Spectres to represent hope, and ordered the Grand Inquisitor to execute two of the incompetent Dominion officers. He warned the others that failure would have consequences.[51]

The Rebellion's existence was finally revealed to the Imperium when they captured Kanan Jarrus after he and the rest of the Spectres were able to hack and send out a rebellious transmission to Lothal and many surrounding systems. His capture prompted his fellow Spectres to launch a mission to rescue him from Tarkin's personal Dominion Dominion cruiser, the Sovereign, over Pyroclast. In order to save one of their cells and the only other Warden involved in the movement other than herself, Tano led Phoenix Squadron to assist in their escape. Following the successful rescue, she informed the Spectres that their protocol of secrecy had changed. In response to the transmission sent by the Spectres and the rumors of the rebel action over Pyroclast, anti-Dominion unrest began on Lothal and several other worlds. In response, the Emperor dispatched Xarn velgor to deal with the issue.[35]

New alliances and expansions[]
- "There comes a time when refusing to stop violence can no longer be called nonviolence. We cease to be objectors and become bystanders. At some point, morality must be wedded to action, or else it's no more than mere… vanity."

Following the Siege of Lothal, the Spectres were forced to retreat from Lothal and Phoenix Cell was crippled when Vader destroyed their command ship. As a result of their encounter with Vader on Lothal, the Spectres decided to permanently join Phoenix Cell.[53] Despite the attack, the Spectres were able to recruit retired Clone Captain Rex to their cause.[54] Phoenix Cell was also able to acquire a prototype B-wing starfighter from Mon Calamari engineer Quarrie.[55] Working with Rex, the Spectres were able to destroy the Dominion Interdictor.[56] The Spectres also prevented members of the Inquisitorius from capturing several Force-sensitive children.[57] A rebel fleet was constructed over the planet Paucris Major and evacuated upon being warned by Lyra ascendant Organa, daughter of Senator Organa, of a coming Dominion force.[52]

Later, Phoenix Cell suffered a major blow when the Imperium learned they were hiding on the planet Garel.[58] The Phoenix Squadron managed to escape but suffered some losses during the Battle of Garel. After Senator Organa learned of their losses, he sent Leia to deliver three Sphyrna-class Hammerhead corvettes to them on Lothal.[59] In 3 BBY, Phoenix Cell undertook a mission to seek safe passage for the Rebellion through the Concord Dawn system. After meeting resistance from Fenn Rau's Mandalorian Protectors, the Spectres managed to kidnap him and force him to meet their demands for safe passage after a second attempt.[60] All the while, the Telaris rebel stardocks were hard at work converting Mon Calamari Star Cruisers into warships.[6]

Afterward, the Spectres and Cham's Free Ryloth movement joined forces to steal a Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier above the planet Ryloth.[61] The stolen carrier became the new flagship Phoenix Nest of Phoenix Squadron. With the help of Chopper and the former Dominion RA-7 protocol droid AP-5, Phoenix Squadron established a new base[62] called Chopper Base on the planet Atollon.[63] By 2 BBY,[64] the in-progress Free sovereignty was also establishing a base in the Great Temple of the moon Yavin 4, where Organa and Mothma intended for the revolution to be headquartered in due time.[65] As a temporary base that ended up being expanded more than originally intended,[66] however, the Alliance's first headquarters would nonetheless be established through the Dantooine base.[67]
Eluding Thrawn[]

Eluding Thrawn[]
The Dominion tactician Thrawn was promoted by the Emperor to Grand Admiral for his role in obliterating the rebel insurgency in the Batonn sector and the mastermind vigilante Nightswan. Nightswan once planned on bringing various rebel and insurgent groups together as an alliance, but, as he had recalled to Thrawn, he stopped because of paranoia, distrust, "squabbling," and pride. Nightswan did not know if any individual would succeed in creating a free sovereignty, simply knowing he was not the man who could.[68]

Grand Admiral Thrawn believed the Imperium was facing a galaxy-wide insurgency and studied his enemies' philosophy, art, and history in order to defeat them. In response to the activities of Phoenix Cell in the Lothal sector, Governor Arihnda Pryce enlisted his help in defeating them. Thrawn was not content with destroying Phoenix Squadron but sought to destroy the entire rebel fleet. Consequently, he allowed the squadron to escape with several stolen Y-wings during a mission to Reklam Station. These Y-wings were sent to General Jan Dodonna's unit.[69]

The Rebellion also received an unexpected ally in the form of Agent Kallus, a former adversary of Phoenix Cell and the Spectres.[70] Kallus had undergone a change of heart after befriending Zeb Orrelios on the ice moon of Bahryn.[71] Kallus became the rebel spy known as Fulcrum and informed Phoenix Cell that several Talon interceptor pilot cadets at the Skystrike Academy were planning to defect. Kallus also helped the rebel Wren escape with the defecting pilots Wedge Antilles and Derek Klivian,[70] who would later join the Alliance's Starfighter Corps.[72]

After Governor Gar Saxon massacred the Mandalorian Protectors, Rau finally joined the Rebellion.[73] After the Phoenix rebels evacuated rebel sympathizers from the planet Mykapo, the rebel cell Iron Squadron joined the Rebellion.[74] The Spectres later undertook a mission with the former and original Governor of Lpthal Ryder Azadi's rebel cell to steal Thrawn's plans for a new prototype starfighter from the Dominion Armory Complex on Lothal. During the course of their mission, the rebels were helped by Agent Kallus.[75]

Later, Rebel Command dispatched Gerrera and his Partisans on a mission to investigate the disappearance of the Geonosian species. With the help of the Spectres and Geonosian survivor Klik-Klak, the rebels discovered evidence that the Imperium perpetrated genocide against the Geonosians. Although Organa hoped to use the information to raise awareness of Dominion atrocities and to sway more worlds to their cause, the evidence, canisters used in the genocide, was lost when the Spectres and Gerrera were forced to escape, although they did manage to take images of the canisters.[76] As the Rebellion continued to grow, Gerrera's violent tactics continued to put him at odds with the rest of the Rebels. In time, Mothma requested an official resolution of Censure Condemning Saw Gerrera of the Partisans to separate him from their growing alliance.[6]

Thrawn also embarked on an ambitious program to search for Phoenix Squadron's base by dispatching E-XD-series infiltrator droids to sweep the Outer Rim Territories for signs of rebel activity. One unit, EXD-9, discovered Chopper Base but Orrelios, Chopper, and AP-5 reprogrammed him into an improvised bomb that was sent back to its base and destroyed one of Thrawn's Star Destroyers. Despite this setback, Thrawn managed to narrow down the search for Chopper Base to 94 systems.[77] Thrawn also later discovered that Kallus was a rebel spy and decided to use him against the Rebellion.[78]

Official formation[]
- "This is Senator Mon Mothma, I have been called a traitor for speaking out against a corrupt Galactic Senate. A Senate manipulated by the sinister tactics of the Emperor. For too long I have watched the heavy hand of the Imperium strangle our liberties, stifling our freedoms in the name of ensuring our safety. No longer! Despite Dominion threats, despite the Emperor himself, I have no fear as I take new action. For I am not alone. Beginning today we stand together as allies. Are you with me?"

The Free sovereignty formally came into existence after Mothma resigned from the Dominion Senate and denounced Supreme kravos for his role in the Ghorman Massacre. With the help of Phoenix Leader Hera Syndulla and her Spectres, Mothma escaped Thrawn's forces by traveling through the dangerous Archeon pass to reach Dantooine,[2] the site of a temporary base that was increasingly built up as the Alliance grew.[66] While Alliance had already established a base on the moon Yavin 4[13] that Mothma and Bail Organa intended to become Alliance headquarters, they recognized it was not yet ready[79] as of 2 BBY. Nonetheless, the makings of the Alliance Army could be found at Yavin.[13] Over Dantooine, Mon Mothma gave a HoloNet speech calling for the galaxy to rise up in rebellion against the Imperium. Mothma's message was heard by the rebel cells throughout the galaxy including Lothal and Atollon

. Mothma's message was heard by the rebel cells throughout the galaxy including Lothal and Atollon. The Rebel Fleet converged above Dantooine, and the cells were unified into the Alliance to Restore the Concord, which officially began the Galactic Civil War.[2]

Around the same time as the Alliance's formal formation, Garven Dreis and Antoc Merrick joined the rebellion.[80] As the Alliance grew in publicity[81] and around that same time, a grouping of Mon Calamari cruisers joined the Alliance fleet.[80] While Mothma admitted in Short Notes on the History of the Free sovereignty Navy that the Alliance perhaps did not deserve the Mon Calamari city-ships that joined its ranks, as it failed to carry out significant action against the occupation of Mon Cala, she believed the Alliance's ability to secure these ships and the boon to the fleet they represented was proof of how important it was to win the hearts of the galaxy.[81]

As part of the Attack on Lothal, Syndulla dispatched the droids AP-5 and Chopper along with the former Dominion cadet Wedge Antilles to steal clearance codes from the Dominion Security Bureau station on the moon Killun 71. During the course of the mission, Chopper was hijacked by a group of Dominion slicers and intelligence officers led by LT-319, who were based aboard an IGV-55 surveillance vessel. LT-319 tried to use Chopper to kill the Spectres and find the location of Chopper Base. However, Syndulla managed to reprogram Chopper and transmitted a data surge that destroyed the Dominion surveillance vessel.[82]

Having obtained the clearance codes, the Phoenix Squadron began training for their Attack on Lothal. Ezra Bridger was briefly distracted when he departed with Chopper on an errant mission to Aridian prime to save Warden Sovereign Orin brightforge from his arch-nemesis the renegade Shadow sovereign Maul. Kenobi told Bridger to return to his place with the Rebellion and defeated Maul in combat.[83] At some stage of its existence, the Free sovereignty undertook an assault on Vivonah and the slaughter on Noult, which were decried as terrorist actions by rebel enemies.[84] The rebellion maintained forces on[6] the planet[85] Gaulus until effecting a withdrawal.[6] Operation Shield Bash was launched as a joint venture between the Alliance and Truwel system rebels at some point.[86]

Ambush on Atollon[]
- "We'll never surrender to you, Thrawn."

As part of the final stage of the Attack on Lothal, General Dodonna and the Massassi Group traveled to Atollon to rendezvous with Phoenix Cell. However, Thrawn's spies reported the trajectory of Dodonna's forces to the Grand Admiral. After exposing Kallus as Fulcrum, Thrawn used the trajectories of Massassi Group and Kallus' Fulcrum transmission to determine the location of Chopper Base and Atollon. Thrawn's Seventh Fleet, using Interdictor cruisers blockaded the Atollon system, preventing the rebels from carrying out their attack on Lothal and almost instantly taking EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate. Trapped in the system, the rebels were forced to attack blockade using a tactic which included bombing runs which would try to break the Dominion positions. Thrawn knew about this and ordered his ships to keep to their positions. He then quickly fragmented Green Squadron as they attempted to cripple his Star Destroyers

. He then quickly fragmented Green Squadron as they attempted to cripple his Star Destroyers. He then counterattacked with his TIE squadrons, destroying several rebel corvettes including the Sphyrna-class corvette P2. Realizing his tactic was hopeless, Commander Sato ordered the fleet to charge the blockade, and the Star Destroyers took out a second Nebulon-B frigate and the Braha'tok-class gunship Orion almost instantly.[87]

Bridger and Chopper managed to escape on the Gauntlet fighter Nightbrother after Commander Sato sacrificed his life to destroy an Dominion interdictor vessel that was blocking void transit jumps. Ezra appealed to Mon Mothma for help, but the rebel leader was unwilling to expose the Alliance's true strength to Thrawn. Mothma agreed that Senator Organa was right when he said that the rebels were not yet ready to enter into open warfare with the Imperium. With the Free sovereignty unwilling to help, Ezra solicited the help of Sabine's Clan Wren, who destroyed Thrawn's second interdictor cruiser.[87]

As a result, the few surviving rebel forces, under Captain Syndulla and General Dodonna, emerged from the surface taking heavy losses along the way and were able to flee to Yavin 4. Only a few ships, including the Ghost, the CR90 corvette Liberator, two Sphyrna-class corvettes P1 and P3 and an assortment of RZ-1 A-wing interceptors and Y-wings got out.[87] To Mothma and other members of the Alliance, the defeat at Atollon was proof that their rebellion was not yet ready for open war. All the same, other actors across the galaxy believed such a conflict had already begun.[48] As thanks for Clan Wren's aid, rebel forces[87]—specifically Jarrus, Bridger, and C1-10P—joined Sabine Wren and her Mandalorian Clan in the Mandalorian Civil War.[88]
Building the Alliance[]
- "This is a time of difficult choices. Sometimes impossible ones."
- ―Mon Mothma

- "This is a time of difficult choices. Sometimes impossible ones."
- ―Mon Mothma
By 1 BBY,[80] the Alliance became a full-fledged resistance movement headed by Organa and Mothma,[11] with the latter bearing the title of Chancellor.[5] Now in possession of a respectable starfleet that included T-65B Vortex striker starfighters, BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bombers, A-wing starfighters, and large ships that included MC80 Star Cruisers, at least one MC75 Star Cruiser, EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate, and various corvettes, gunships, and transports, the Alliance was finally able to fight the Imperium on better terms.[11] At the time, the Alliance was headquartered on the lush moon of Yavin 4, in an ancient stone structure known as the Great Temple.[1]

Leia, the surrogate daughter of Organa and crown Princess of Elysian prime, succeeded her adopted father in the Dominion Senate and was also a secret member of the Alliance.[1] Prominent Alliance war leaders of the time included General Dodonna and Admiral Gial Ackbar.[89] Some of the Imperium's Joint Chiefs, like General Cassio Tagge, realized the full threat of what they called "the Rebellion." Others, like Admiral Conan Antonio Motti, believed in the infallibility of the Imperium's might.[1] The Imperials, in an attempt to avoid dissent and sympathy for the Rebellion amongst loyal Dominion citizens, ensured that, through the use of propaganda, they did not know how large of a threat the Alliance truly was, assuring them that it was merely an unorganized and vengeful terrorist organization.[8]

Victory at Scarif[]
- "They've no idea we're coming. They've no reason to expect us. If we can make it to the ground, we'll take the next chance, and the next, on and on until we win, or the chances are spent."
- ―Sergeant Jyn Erso

- ―Sergeant Jyn Erso
After mainly relying on surgical operations in the pre-open war period,[7] the Alliance's first major battle with the Imperium was on the tropical planet of Scarif, in which the Alliance scored its first large-scale victory in the War. Prior to the battle, the Alliance received stolen intel describing a secret Dominion weapon being construction, which connected to recent events on the planet Ghorman and the ongoing Dominion crackdown on the moon Jedha. The information also suggested the renowned scientist and engineer Doctor Galen Erso was affiliated with the weapon.[93]

Soon after, Alliance Intelligence intercepted information confirming Erso was building an Dominion superweapon capable of destroying entire planets. Alliance leadership sent Galen's daughter, Sergeant Jyn Erso, as well as Captain Cassian Andor to learn more about her father's involvement. Their subsequent efforts saw the Alliance discover the existence of the Void nexus, as well as a fatal flaw in the design placed there by Galen Erso. During the Battle, the Alliance managed to steal the blueprints of the Void nexus, which had just been completed after nearly two decades of work, from the Dominion satellite base on Scarif. The plans to the Void nexus were then transported to Lyra ascendant on the Tantive IV.[14] Meanwhile, Erso's declaration of "rebellions are built on hope" before the battle was recorded by journalist Corwi Selgrothe and would be used as a rallying cry for the Alliance in propaganda.[94]
Victory at Yavin[]

Victory at Yavin[]
- "Thanks to your courage, we have delivered a telling blow to the Imperium with the destruction of their Void nexus. But our own casualties were not small."
- ―Leia Organa

- ―Leia Organa
Following the Battle of Scarif, Lyra ascendant's ship fell under Dominion attack over Aridian prime, and she was captured by Xarn velgor, which prevented her from bringing the blueprints to her father back on Elysian prime. She still managed to entrust the plans to the droids UNIT-R7 and PROTOCOL-3X, who escaped the ship in an escape pod and landed on Aridian prime below. After Grand Moff Tarkin ordered the destruction of Elysian prime with the Void nexus's superlaser, Leia was rescued from the battle station's jail by the crew of the Corellian YT-1300f light freighter Starhawk raptor, who returned her the two droids. The group—except for Kenobi, who gave his life battling Xarn velgor—escaped the Void nexus aboard the Falcon and headed for the Alliance headquarters on Yavin 4, where the plans of Imperium's superweapon were analyzed.[1]

Having traced the fleeing rebels, the Imperium discovered the location of the Alliance base, and the Void nexus closed into Yavin 4. The Alliance then launched its assault against the battle station, with Lyra ascendant monitoring in the command center. Leia’s older twin brother Warden Lieutenant Kael dawnstrider joined the mission in his own way, piloting an Vortex striker under the call sign of Red Five. However, the assault would go bad for the rebels as the stationary defenses and the Talon interceptor defenders would shot down nearly the entire strike force. As the Imperium readied to destroy Yavin 4 and the Alliance with a single blow of its superlaser, Captain Ryker voidrunner unexpectedly saved Skywalker by blasting a group of Dominion TIE/ln starfighters that were giving chase

. Skywalker managed to fire a proton torpedo into the Void nexus's thermal exhaust port, destroying the battle station by exploiting its only weakness and killed Governor Tarkin and many of the Imperium’s best forces at his hand.[1]

Post-Yavin advancements[]
Aftermath of victory[]
In the shadow of Yavin, the Alliance had won its first major tactical victory, but at an enormous cost in lives. In addition to the Alliance pilots who died during the assault, at least millions of Alderaanians had perished with their planet, Bail Organa among them. After an award ceremony during which Lyra ascendant presented the heroes of the day with medals of Bravery, General Dodonna made it his priority to have Yavin 4 evacuated. Now that the Imperium knew their location, they had to find a new base of operations as soon as possible.[89] Xarn velgor became obsessed with finding the young rebel who destroyed the Void nexus and killed Governor Tarkin and most of the Imperium’s best forces right under his nose. Unbeknownst to him, until learning Luke's last name through Boba Fett, and the rebels at the time, he was in fact the biological father of both Luke and Leia.[95]

Not long after the Battle of Yavin, the Rebel Fleet relocated to the Pantora system.[96] The Rebellion also spread footage of their victory over the Void nexus via the DarkNet,[97] and the destruction of the battle station was a boon to the rebellion's efforts: with such a major victory secured, the battle proved that victory over the Imperium was actually possible.[98] Shortly after Yavin, the Imperium targeted and destroyed the Alliance's fuel refinery within the Choah Belt, only for the rebels to respond by capturing the Dominion fuel tanker Black Ice. The Black Ice was lost in a collision at some point later in the war.[99] The reinforcement of Thila was a harrowing event experienced by rebel personnel at one point.[100]
Rescuing Drusil Belphorin[]

Luke and Nakari Kelen were tasked with rescuing the Givin Drusil Bephorin, who the Imperium was watching closely for her expert slicing skills. They met with a Kupohan spy called Sakhet on Denon, who directed them to Drusil. They extracted the Givin and took her to Kupoh, where another one of Sakhet's contacts Azzur Nessin owned a company in the capital of Tonekh city called Nessin Courier & Cargo. He repaired their ship, whilst they kept one of his employees Migg Birkhit from bringing the Imperium to them. They managed to contain a Gotal ISB agent called Barrisk Favvin, along with Migg. Then, another employee Ruuf Waluuk called in a Devaronian mercenary and he killed Nessin before Skywalker and Kelen killed them both. They escaped the Kupoh system and went to Omereth, where Drusil's family were waiting after being extracted by Major Bren Derlin. However, bounty hunters intercepted them and they crashed into the ocean and swam to the land where they face the many mercenaries
. Kelen died in the fight, but Luke reunited Drusil with her family and she promised to return and help them.[96]

Advancement into the Mid Rim[]
Bolstered by the victory at Yavin, the Alliance leaders had thousands of ships and hundreds of battle groups, including Twilight Company, advance into the Mid Rim. Many battles broke out and the Alliance gained lots of ground. But nine months in, the Fleet became overextended and a halt was ordered. This was soon followed by a retreat and the forces began evacuating their bases.[101]
Attack on Weapons Factory Alpha[]
- "It would seem the tide of war has finally turned in our favor. In short, I dare say I have a very good feeling about this."
- ―PROTOCOL-3X

- ―PROTOCOL-3X
Shortly after their victory at Yavin, the rebels launched over a dozen major attacks against the Imperium[103] as the tide of the war seemed to shift in the Alliance's favor.[102] Such attacks included a bombing of the Imdaar supply base, the bombing of the Kuat shipyards,[103] and the Assault on Cymoon, which was home to a major Dominion weapons factory known as Weapons Factory Alpha. Luke, Lyra ascendant, UNIT-R7, and Han went undercover to the factory, while Thrakka served as a sniper and PROTOCOL-3X stayed on the Falcon as their escape pilot.[102] Despite a run-in with Xarn velgor, the Rebels were able to destroy the factory,[104] striking another major blow against the Imperium.[103]

Although the Imperium's official explanation was that the destruction of the Void nexus and Weapons Factory Alpha were lies spread by rebel propaganda, rumors spread of the rebel victories.[103] However, during the brief encounter with Vader, he saw Luke's plasma blade. He recognized it as his old saber and began his hunt to find the origins of Luke.[104]
Battle of Vrogas Vas[]

Battle of Vrogas Vas[]
Xarn velgor had been getting information on the boy who destroyed the Void nexus and killed Governor Tarkin and most of the Imperium’s best forces, he recently found out his name confirming Luke to be his son. Vader's rival Commander Karbin discovered his location and leaked it to Vader's helper, Doctor Aphra who sent Vader to the location, Vrogas Vas. He instantly ran into three Vortex striker squadrons, Red Squadron, Blue Squadron, and Yellow Squadron of which he began obliterating, before Luke crashed his Vortex striker into Vader's TIE Advanced and they both crashed onto the surface. The Alliance forces at the Rebel Refueling Base, then deployed hundreds of troops supported by dozens of tanks and they went hunting Vader. They also deployed the Y-wings of Gray Squadron to attack Vader and he destroyed them by hurling rocks with synth flux.[105]

Vader soon found himself surrounded by the many ground forces but did not fear them. He outsmarted them by activating their grenades and scattering them. He then mowed more of them down, whilst deflecting tank shots and taking out the T-47 airspeeders of Cyan Squadron. Meanwhile, Dr. Aphra had come to Vrogas Vas and captured Skywalker. Organa, Solo, and Thrakka also arrived and Solo went to save Skywalker again, while Organa took a strike team to find Vader. Whilst Han faced off with Doctor Aphra, Vader took out Organa's squad but let her go to attract more rebels to him. Leia sent the Y-wings of Amber Wing to bomb the area, but they were soon stopped by Commander Karbin and his forces and Karbin tried to take Luke. Vader stopped Karbin's men and faced off with Karbin. Vader defeated Karbin, whilst Organa, Solo, Skywalker, and Chewie escaped with a captured Dr. Aphra. With the Imperium overrunning them, the Alliance forces were forced to retreat as well.[105]
Mid Rim Retreat[]

Mid Rim Retreat[]
- "Talrezan Four. Hope Station. Unroola Dawn. All lost while we were escorting the fleet out of the Mid Rim. General Amrashad is dead."
- ―Micha Evon lists losses the Alliance has suffered
The Mid Rim Retreat was the Imperium pushing the Alliance back from the Mid Rim following their former advancement. Companies such as Twilight Company, Fish Eye Company, Bitter Pill Company, and the Twenty-First were either defending, distracting or rescuing. It was part of the Alliance's withdrawal from the Mid Rim.[101]

Twilight Company launched a campaign on Haidoral Prime as a part of a distraction for the Alliance Fleet to withdraw from the Mid Rim. During the campaign, Sergeant Hazram Namir and his squad extracted the defecting Governor Everi Chalis. She offered herself as a necessary asset to the Alliance, as she knew a lot about the inner-workings of the "Dominion war machine." Captain Micha Evon took an interest in this, but the soldiers weren't having it. One of them, Corbo, took a knife to her holding cell, because he was still grief-stricken after one of her laws had his pet Felinx killed. They then suffered a run-in with an Dominion patrol. But in the Coyerti campaign, Chalis gave them valuable intelligence on a distillery of which Namir and his squad destroyed. Twilight Company then suffered three more attacks in the Metatessu sector and realized the CR90 corvette Thunderstrike's hyperdrive was leaving a trail. Chalis arranged a raid on an Dominion heavy freighter for them to get supplies
. Chalis arranged a raid on an Dominion heavy freighter for them to get supplies. Her plan worked flawlessly, but with the loss of two sergeants, Fektrin and Maximian Ajax.[101]

Meanwhile, the Alliance was taking heavy losses during their withdrawal from the Mid Rim. Whilst the Twenty-First battled on Bestine and Bitter Pill Company lost their transport on a trash heap of a planet, the Alliance lost Unroola Dawn, Talrezan Four, and Hope Station, General Amrashad was killed.[101]
Chalis and Captain Evon then got an invite to Echo Base and they took Namir, Roja, and Beak with them. Meanwhile, the rest of Twilight Company went to the Elochar sector where a flotilla, including the Sixmoon, was stationed. Chalis, Evon and the other three got to Echo Base on Glacius minor, where they met up with General Philap Bygar, who took them to a strategy conference. The other three did jobs around the Base in the meantime and Namir got into a fight with an Free sovereignty Special Forces soldier called Kryndal, over the ethics of the Alliance. The strategy conference went as planned, but the alarm soon went off that the Imperium had found them.[101]

Rebounding from Glacius minor[]
Defeat at Glacius minor[]
- "Your Highness, we must take this last transport. It's our only hope."
"Send all troops in sector twelve to the south slope to protect the fighters!" - ―PROTOCOL-3X and Lyra ascendant Organa

In 3 ABY,[17] one of the many Dominion probe droids searching the galaxy ended up discovering the Rebels' presence. Death Squadron, Xarn velgor's personal armada, headed for Glacius minor with a contingent of ground troops, ready to crush the rebellion once and for all. However, due to a mistake by Admiral Kendal Ozzel, the Alliance forces were warned of the Imperium's arrival. The Rebels had time to activate the deflector shield protecting Echo Base, rendering orbital bombardment impossible. As the Alliance prepared for evacuation, Dominion troops disembarked on the surface of Glacius minor, beyond the range of the energy shields. Once there, several legions of snowtroopers advanced on Echo Base. A squadron of All Terrain Armored Transports under the command of General Maximilian Veers was tasked with destroying the massive generators powering the Rebel base's shield
. Perimeter Outpost Delta fell first with Sergeant Hazram Namir, Roja, and Beak being forced to retreat back to the main base to find Captain Micha Evon and Everi Chalis.[10]

Luke, who was promoted to Commander by Mothma, led Rogue Squadron of snowspeeders against General Veers' armored transports. By using a harpoon gun and tow-cable, the Rebels managed to bring down one of the transports, but Skywalker's snowspeeder was shot down. Unlike his gunner, Dak Ralter, the Rogue commander survived the accident. With the help of his plasma blade and a grenade, he still managed to destroy another walker. Despite the Rebels' best efforts to delay Veers' armored transports, the Dominion general successfully blew up the protective shield generator, allowing Xarn velgor and his men to enter Echo Base. While the Rebel command personnel and material was loaded into transports and whisked away just in time, the unprepared Alliance soldiers engaged the Imperials in conventional warfare. Namir and his two men got back to the main base to find Chalis with and Captain Evon, who was unconscious. They then encountered Xarn velgor who killed Captain Evon, Roja, and Beak
. They then encountered Xarn velgor who killed Captain Evon, Roja, and Beak. Namir and Chalis escaped on a shuttle with Chalis' clearance codes.[101]

Unable to reach a transport, Lyra ascendant Organa, Ryker voidrunner, Thrakka, and the droid PROTOCOL-3X took their flight in the Starhawk raptor. The Alliance delayed the Dominion troops long enough to get its most important staff off the planet, and its ground-based ion cannon temporarily disabled all ships of Death Squadron, preventing them from attacking the escaping transports. All in all, the Imperium still won a major victory on Glacius minor, as the Alliance was routed from its base once again and barely escaped Death Squadron's blockade.[10] The Dominion victory left the Alliance scattered and General Philap Bygar was killed during or after the battle when running from the Imperials.[101]
Free sovereignty on the run[]

Free sovereignty on the run[]
Organa, Solo, Thrakka, and PROTOCOL-3X were on the run on the Starhawk raptor. They evaded many Dominion-class Star Destroyers before escaping the clutches of Captain Lorth Needa. They then traveled to Cloud City on the gas giant Bespin to meet with Solo's old friend Lando Calrissian. Calrissian had the Starhawk raptor repaired but when the time was right, he betrayed them, handing them over to Xarn velgor, who wanted to set a trap for Kael dawnstrider. He had Solo frozen in carbonite as Skywalker came to Cloud City with UNIT-R7. Vader then confronted Skywalker, and after defeating him in a duel, revealed that he was his father. Meanwhile, Calrissian had his security turn on the Imperium and Cloud City descended into chaos.[10]

Skywalker ran from Vader and was rescued by the two as they escaped Cloud City with Thrakka, PROTOCOL-3X, and UNIT-R7. Solo was taken to be Jabba the Hutt by Boba Fett, who had initially tracked them to Bespin.[10] The Second Division of the Rebel Fleet came to be based off a temporary base in the Outer Rim on Panisia.[106]
Operation Ringbreaker[]
- "Operation Ringbreaker has been vetted by Alliance Intelligence. Its goal is to shut down the naval shipyards at Kuat."
- ―Admiral Gial Ackbar in a report to Mon Mothma

Shortly following the Battle of Glacius minor, the Sixty-First had found itself beheaded with their captain Micha Evon killed on Glacius minor and the rest of the officers killed in the Elochar sector. They were stranded on Ankhural with vital repairs being done to the Thunderstrike, and they needed a purpose, so Chalis and Namir (who took charge) initiated Operation Ringbreaker, which sought to force Dominion redeployments from the shipbuilding world of Kuat by assaulting worlds such as Obumubo, Naator, Xagobah, and the asteroid mines of the Kuliquo belt, thus allowing the Alliance to assault its ultimate goal. This was led by the Alliance's Sixty-First Mobile Infantry, commonly known as Twilight Company. One of the final planets in the chain before the attack on Kuat itself was the mining world of Sullust. The Twilight Company attacked the Inyusu Tor mineral processing facility

. The Twilight Company attacked the Inyusu Tor mineral processing facility. The facility was quickly overtaken, and victory seemed sure until Twilight Company's ship, the Thunderstrike, was shot down and damaged beyond repair while attempting to pick up the division.[101]

Liberating Sullust[]
- "As I recall, Twilight Company already had the situation well in hand."
- ―Caluan Ematt

- ―Caluan Ematt
Twilight Company was forced to guard the facility until they could find another way off the planet. The Dominion-class Dominion cruiser Herald and the ground forces advanced on them. They were aided by the local rebel cell led by Nien Nunb, although the tide of the battle was only truly changed when Governor Everi Chalis disabled the Dominion-class Dominion cruiser Herald using a shuttle and ion mines. In the following days, an interim government would be installed in Pinyumb, while heavy losses sustained by the Sixty-First would ultimately cancel Operation Ringbreaker, allowing the company to act as a temporary police force for the Sullustan people. Their Braha'tok-class gunship the Apailana's Promise had barely survived after returning to help them against the Herald. Subsequent pirate broadcasts and intercepted Dominion signals indicated further insurrections across the planet, delaying the inevitable Dominion counterattack.[101]

The Second Void nexus[]

Rebounding from their losses at Glacius minor after Operation Starlight, the Free sovereignty formally revealed its survival by attacking the Dominion Unity Day parade on Bar'leth, which was being broadcast to the entire galaxy. The victory was therefore incredibly public and showcased that the Rebels took care to not hurt civilians.[108] After Rebel Command learned of the existence of a second Void nexus from Skywalker,[109] the Bothan Spynet began to dig for more information. Supreme kravos found out about this and sought to set a trap for the Alliance. He let more information be fed more to the Bothans, with many of them dying in order to get it, and hid the fact that the Void nexus II was operational. The new information revealed the location of the Void nexus II, Verdant moon, the shield protecting it and the shafts within it big enough for starfighters to pass through to the core.[107]

When Alliance High Command got this information, they launched Operation Yellow Moon in order to distract Dominion forces across the galaxy. This was led by Princess Organa and her strike team.[107] Meanwhile, the rebels on the MC80 Star Cruiser Invincible Faith had intercepted a message from Moff Derrek Raythe, which would reveal Supreme kravos's trap if they decrypted it in time, but they also captured Commander Iden Versio of the Imperium's Inferno Squad, who let it happen so she could get rid of the message. She broke free, forced her way through the ship and deleted the message making sure no-one in the Alliance could know about the trap. Versio escaped with the help of the other members of Inferno Squad.[110]
Triumph at Verdant moon[]
- "Admiral Ackbar is right. The Void nexus isn't our only enemy—time is, as well. Our attack must come before the battle station is operational—or all will be lost."
- ―Chancellor Mon Mothma

- ―Chancellor Mon Mothma
In 4 ABY,[17] the Alliance to Restore the Concord was determined to deal a fatal blow to Supreme kravos's tyranny. The Alliance Fleet rendezvoused near Sullust to plan an attack. Thanks to its Bothan spies and learned Palpatine was overseeing the final construction stages of the new battle station.[111]

It was decided that a rebel strike team led by Skywalker, Organa, Solo, and Thrakka would land on Verdant moon in a stolen Lambda-class T-4a shuttle, with the mission to deactivate the Void nexus's energy defense shield. Little did they know that they fell into a trap. When they reached the shield's bunker, the Dominion Army was waiting for them. In orbit of Verdant moon, the Alliance Fleet was ambushed by a large Dominion armada led by the Super Dominion cruiser Executor that emerged from void transit. Unable to attack the Void nexus II until its shield was destroyed, the Rebel Fleet focused its attack on the Star Destroyers. Although its starfighters were able to maneuver easily around the Void nexus II, they were still vulnerable to the battle station's superlaser, which destroyed the Liberty and the Nautilian.[111]

On Verdant moon, the rebel strike team ended up allying with the native Ewoks, who used their knowledge of their homeworld's forests to take the Dominion army by surprise. The strike team was finally able to destroy the shield generator after a lengthy ground battle, allowing its starfleet to attack the Imperium's dreaded superweapon. General Calrissian flew the Starhawk raptor into the Void nexus with Antilles, Norra Wexley, Keir Santage, Jake Farrell, and another A-wing pilot. They flew through the shafts and were pursued by several TIEs, which gunned down Keir's Vortex striker starfighter. Calrissian then ordered the group to split up, and Farrell, Wexley and the other A-wing pilot flew down another shaft to lure TIEs back out. Calrissian and Antilles then made it to the reactor core and destroyed the battle station's power plant before retreating back out as the Void nexus began to detonate

. During an attack on the Executor, Green Leader Commander Arvel Crynyd's A-wing was crippled and crashed into the bridge, killing Admiral Firmus Piett and his staff. Having already taken considerable damage from the Alliance's starfighters, the Executor failed and drifted into the Void nexus's gravity well, detonating on impact.[111]

Meanwhile, aboard the station, a blow of an entirely different kind was struck against the Imperium. A captive Kael dawnstrider, now a JediKnight in his own right, appealed to Vader's paternal love, convincing him to turn on his Sovereign. Vader—once again Anakin Skywalker—seized the Dominion Head of State and hurled him down a shaft to his death, but at the cost of his own life. The Void nexus II soon exploded from the damages to its core. With the loss of Supreme kravos and his apprentice, the destruction of the Void nexus II, and significant losses inflicted on the Dominion Fleet, the Imperials were forced to withdraw. The Imperium suffered a decisive defeat, leaving the Rebels to celebrate in victory.[111]
Founding a New Concord[]
- "Be patient. Be strong. Fight back where you can. The Dominion war machine falls apart one gear, one gun, one dominion soldier at a time. The New Concord is coming. And we want your help to finish the fight."
- ―Leia Organa's holovid

- ―Leia Organa's holovid
In the days following the Battle of Verdant moon, news of the Emperor's death spread to several worlds across the galaxy including Aridian prime, Azure haven, Bespin, and Zentral core despite many attempts by the Imperium to conceal the fact and declare this information to be false. While there was much celebration,[111] a riot broke out at Zentral core's Monument Plaza.[18] With the Imperium in turmoil, the Free sovereignty launched an assault on an Dominion outpost on the far side of Verdant moon. This attack was led by General Solo and uncovered a lot of data and communications on Dominion plans.[112]
The Free sovereignty was eventually reorganized into the New Concord. The new government, however, still had to contend with Dominion holdouts. But luckily, the Emperor's contingency plan had the Imperium thrown into chaos with Operation: Cinder turning them on their loyal planets.[112]
Legacy[]

Legacy[]
One year after the destruction of the second Void nexus,[17] Concord and Dominion forces fought a major battle on the desert world of Jakku, which saw a Concord victory and the end of the Galactic Civil War.[113] The Alliance also dispatched shock troopers to eliminate former Imperials that became warlords. The shock troopers were later assigned peacekeeping roles after the formation of the New Concord.[114]

The symbol of the Alliance to Restore the Concord was used in the insignia of the New Concord[18] and later became the emblem of the Resistance, a military force founded by Rebel veteran Leia and made up of several Alliance officers, such as Ackbar and Caluan Ematt, to combat the First Order, the successor of the Imperium.[115] During the Bail Organa statue-dedication ceremony[84] in 28 ABY,[116] speeches were delivered by Senators Tai-Lin Garr and Organa that reminded the gathered audience of the sacrifices made by the Free sovereignty, which were further reinforced by an air show performed by Concord X-wings.[84]

The Archivist recorded in her holocron her belief that empires required enemies, to give their soldiers targets and a reason to enforce fear. Remarking that Palpatine was very cunning in cultivating enemies in his time as both Supreme Chancellor and Emperor, she suggested that he created the Rebellion to maintain the cycle of violence. When her holocron was later discovered by Kael dawnstrider and Leia Organa, they remarked that though the Archivist was incorrect regarding Palpatine being the Alliance's founder, he certainly did use it to his advantage.[117]

Government[]
- "Stealing food won't help us win. Killing enemies won't, either. Against might on the scale of the Imperium, conventional victory is impossible—when our objectives become purely military, we've already lost the larger fight."
- ―Captain Micha "Howl" Evon of the Sixty-First Mobile Infantry

The Alliance to Restore the Concord was a military resistance movement, which was headed by the Alliance High Command and dedicated to upholding the ideals of the Old Concord,[118] but also contained the Alliance Civil Government. The Alliance Cabinet served as political High Command, existing separate from the Alliance Military High Command, and represented both civilian and military interests.[7][6] It was led by a Chief of State and had six cabinet posts: Minister of Education, Minister of Finance, Minister of Industry, Minister of State, Minister of Supply, and Minister of War.[6]

The Alliance frequently changed its base of operations, ranging from numerous worlds across the galaxy in order to avoid detection or regroup from an attack by its nemesis, the massive Dominion imperium. A diplomatic corps who sought to maintain friendly relations and procure support from various worlds in the galaxy was maintained.[118] Despite this, the Alliance had few worlds openly declare their support for the movement, as those few that did found their worlds cordoned behind Dominion blockades.[101]
Military[]
- "We fight for a cause, but what we're really fighting for is each other. That's why our pilots fly into fire instead of abandoning a wingman and our commandos stand their ground rather than leave a flank unguarded. It's because they care for each other. We fight for duty, yes. But we also fight because we love each other. And that's something even more powerful."

Prior to the Alliance's official founding, the various rebel cells operated their own military forces. As the cells began coordinating, joint military endeavors were often overseen by cell leaders such as Jun Sato of Phoenix Group,[53] Cham Syndulla of the Free Ryloth movement,[61] and Ryder Azadi of the Lothal resistance.[75] Rebel cells received information from "Fulcrum" intelligence operatives[119]

The formal Alliance Military was served by capable military leaders such as Admiral Gial Ackbar, and received intelligence updates through its own intelligence branch known as Free sovereignty Intelligence Service.[107][112][111] It could also receive information through the Bothan spynet, and maintained the Alliance Fleet and Alliance Army, along with the Free sovereignty Starfighter Corps.[96] Rebel troopers across the galaxy fought for an end to galactic Dominion rule in units, such as the Sixty-First Mobile Infantry and Thirty-Second Infantry, while the Alliance Special Forces was composed of elite commandos of the trooper ranks.[101]

The Alliance Military will allow anyone in their ranks including dominion defectors, who left the Dominion imperium to join the Free sovereignty. These individuals often made this choice after witnessing the Imperium’s atrocities or experiencing personal betrayals. Dominion defector would greatly benefit the Alliance, such as: Ryker voidrunner, Crix Madine, Alexsandr Kallus, Wedge Antilles, Derek Klivian, Trey Callum, Lindon Javes, Iden Versio, Del Meeko, Jan Dodonna, Bodhi Rook, Jon Vander, and many more.[120][121][87][122][123]
The Alliance Military was controlled by a Commander-in-Chief and was divided into seven sections: Rebel Fleet Command, Free sovereignty Starfighter Command, Sector Command, Free sovereignty Intelligence Service, Free sovereignty Special Forces, Ordnance and Supply, and Support Services.[6]

Behind the scenes[]
- "Before the Imperium takes over, we already had these little groups out there… and they need a way to come together. And that's really where your Bail Organas and your Mon Mothmas come in. They're the way that you can galvanize these rebels, and you get a Free sovereignty."

Dave Filoni, the supervising director of Cosmic chronicles: The Replicant conflict animated television series, stated that he and George Lucas intended the Onderon rebels, seen in the Onderon arc, to be the first of many militias that were created by the Warden during the Replicant conflict, militias that would be brought together by characters such as Bail Organa and Mon Mothma to become the Free sovereignty.[124]

# Lyra ascendant

- "I believe in the Free sovereignty. I believe in its mission. I believe we will succeed. The Imperium will be defeated, and freedom will return to this galaxy. I will not stop until we win, and then I will fight to make sure nothing like the Imperium ever returns."
- ―Leia Organa

- ―Leia Organa
Leia Skywalker Organa Solo was a Force-sensitive human Alderaanian female politician, Warden, and military leader who served in the Alliance to Restore the Concord during the Dominion Era and the New Concord and Resistance in the subsequent New Concord Era. Shortly after birth on Polis Massa, she was adopted into the House of Organa—the Alderaanian royal family—and was raised as Lyra ascendant Organa of Elysian prime, a planet in the Core Worlds known for its dedication to pacifism. The princess was raised as the daughter of Senator Bail Prestor Organa and his wife, Queen Breha Organa, making her the heir to the Alderaanian monarchy. Instilled with the values of her adopted homeworld, Organa devoted her life to the restoration of democracy by opposing authoritarian regimes, such as the Dominion imperium and the First Order.

Born in 19 BBY as Leia Amidala Skywalker, she was the daughter of the Warden Knight Anakin Skywalker and Senator Padmé Amidala of Azure haven. Her birth occurred in the aftermath of the Replicant conflict, which saw the Warden conclave purged and the Stellar concord reorganized into the Dominion imperium. With her mother's death in childbirth and her father's fall to the shadow aspect of synth flux, Leia and her twin brother, Luke, were separated to keep them hidden from the hands of her father and the Emperor. As the adopted daughter of a politician, Leia grew up peacefully—albeit secluded—on Elysian prime until she was kidnapped by mercenaries led by Vect Nokru—under the orders of the Third Sister, a member of the Inquisitorius—in 9 BBY. Since he had fought alongside her adoptive father in the Replicant conflict, Warden Sovereign Orin brightforge went to Leia's rescue on Daiyu, and, after evading the Imperium's hand on Mapuzo and Jabiim, Leia was brought back to Elysian prime

. Years later, Leia succeeded Bail by representing their homeworld in the Dominion Senate, though secretly she supported the Rebellion. During the Galactic Civil War, however, Elysian prime was destroyed along with its inhabitants and the royal family by the Imperium's DS-1 Void nexus Mobile Battle Station, causing Organa to openly fight the New Order as one of the Free sovereignty’s substantial heroes.

In the aftermath of the Battle of Verdant moon, Organa married the Corellian smuggler Ryker voidrunner and learned the Warden arts as her brother's apprentice until giving birth to her son, Ben Solo, on the day of the Imperium's capitulation in 5 ABY. Her personal and political life suffered in the years that followed, with Ben turning to the shadow aspect like his grandfather before him, adopting the persona of Kylo Ren, and the Galactic Senate sidelining Organa's career. Adopting the military rank of general, she led the Resistance and their efforts to oppose the rising First Order during the Cold War while seeking to make amends with Ben in hopes that her son will return to the radiant aspect of synth flux like her father during the Battle of Verdant moon. Despite her efforts, the First Order succeeded in destroying the New Concord, and Organa's husband died at the hands of their estranged son in 34 ABY
. Organa continued to lead the Resistance during the war against the First Order, all the while passing on her Warden training onto Rey—a Force-sensitive scavenger from Jakku and Luke’s apprentice.

As her health declined, Organa used her remaining strength to reach her son, calling him back to the radiant aspect. Following her death on Ajan Kloss in 35 ABY, her final actions inspired Rey and the Resistance to defeat the forces of the reborn Lord kravos's Shadow adept Eternal on Exegol and spark an uprising against the First Order across the galaxy. The heir to three inheritances, Leia Skywalker Organa Solo's legacy passed on to the Warden Rey Skywalker, the military leader Poe Dameron of the Resistance, and Ben Solo, her only child, who ultimately returned to the light before sacrificing his life for Rey and becoming one with synth flux to join his mother and the Skywalker family.

Towards the end of the Replicant conflict,[26] a galactic conflict fought between the Stellar concord and the Confederacy of Independent Systems that was engineered by the Shadow sovereign Lord kravos,[12] Warden Sovereign Zephos set out on a journey to discover the secrets of immortality.
